nodes.stake: The Archbishop is cooling under the bourdon bell, his ledger is still warm, and boots are coming up the stair.
nodes.page: The Archbishop cools beneath the massive iron shadow of the bourdon bell, his blood pooling silently on the dust-choked floorboards. You slip the ticking, brass-geared Architect’s Ledger into the deep pockets of your Night-Crow ulster, its intricate metal casing still strangely warm against your ribs. You are entirely unarmed, possessing neither blade nor firearm to defend yourself in this cramped belfry. Below, heavy boots begin to thud rhythmically against the spiraling stone stairwell, echoing closer with every second.

nodes.stake: Warm hands, cold rings: whatever killed him left the signet and took nothing at all.
nodes.page: You kneel beside the fallen prelate, noting the unnatural heat still radiating from his skin. His hands remain warm, yet the heavy gold rings adorning his fingers are icy to the touch, proving whatever killed him left the signet and took nothing at all. The ornate ring of his office remains perfectly aligned on his thumb, a glaring oversight for a common thief. You must decide what to pull from this corpse before the footfalls reach the landing.

exits.label: Lift the signet from his thumb

nodes.stake: The first column of the book is a list of people who are still alive, and the third name is a magistrate.
nodes.page: The brass clasp of the ledger yields with a sharp, mechanical click that echoes too loudly in the cramped tower. You unfold the heavy parchment, noting immediately that the first column of the book is a list of people who are still alive. The ink is fresh, and the third name down belongs to the district's presiding magistrate. Time is slipping away as the ascending boots strike the final spiral of the stone stairs.

nodes.stake: Lantern light climbs the stairwell; the hatch has one bolt and one bell-pin, and both are within reach.
nodes.page: Lantern light climbs the stairwell, casting erratic, swinging shadows across the Archbishop’s remains as the guards approach. The heavy oak hatch separating you from them has exactly one bolt and one bell-pin, and both are within easy reach. Neither locking mechanism will hold back a determined squad for long, but they might buy you the seconds you need. Shouts echo up the spiraling stone, ordering the perimeter sealed before the killer can slip away.

exits.label: Wedge the hatch with a bell-pin

nodes.stake: Sable holds out a second harness on the parapet, the Guard is at the hatch, and the dead man's cloak is on its hook.
nodes.page: Rain lashes through the open parapet where Sable holds out a second harness, her boots balanced perfectly on the wet stonework. The Guard is violently rattling the hatch behind you, the rusted iron hinges groaning under the sudden, furious assault. To your left, the murdered Archbishop's heavy, velvet-lined cloak hangs undisturbed on a wrought-iron hook. You must choose how you leave this belfry before the heavy oak door finally splinters inward.

nodes.stake: Two ropes, one anchor, a hundred feet of wet stone, and Sable setting the pace below the louvres.
nodes.page: You buckle into the leather straps, committing to two ropes, one anchor, and a hundred feet of wet stone. Sable is setting a grueling pace just below the louvres, expertly navigating the slick masonry in the howling storm. The anchor holds taut, but every gust of wind threatens to smash you against the bell tower's sheer face. The shouts of the Guard fade into the roar of the gale, leaving only the rhythm of your desperate ascent.

exits.label: Pace her rope hand over hand
Drop the bell to cover the climb

nodes.stake: Slats give under your boot and the chapter-house lead roof is one swing away in the rain.
nodes.page: The rotted wooden slats give under your boot, forcing you to kick off the stonework as the masonry crumbles into the abyss. Below you, the sprawling, rain-washed chapter-house lead roof is exactly one terrifying swing away through the darkness. Sable is already moving ahead, her silhouette blurring against the storm as you calculate the necessary pendulum momentum. You must commit your weight to the rope now or fall with the breaking woodwork.

nodes.stake: A gutter run above a street filling with lanterns; whichever way you go down, you go down dressed as somebody.
nodes.page: You haul yourself into a deep copper gutter run above a street that is rapidly filling with Guard lanterns and searching hounds. Whichever way you go down into that maze, you will have to go down dressed as somebody who belongs there. The metal groans under your combined weight, threatening to tear away from the chapter-house eaves if you linger too long. You scan the descending architecture for a viable path into the shifting chaos of the district.

exits.label: Follow the gutter to the lane

nodes.stake: One street, three ways to stop being the shape they are hunting — and only one cover per night.
nodes.page: The chapter-house roof slopes down toward one street, offering exactly three ways to stop being the shape they are hunting. Down one alley, a disgraced tailor’s shop leaks yellow light; across the yard, rough porter livery hangs unattended. Closer to the square, the opera house's side door stands ajar, offering access to the galleries. You can only choose one cover per night, and the whistles are drawing closer.

nodes.stake: A disgraced tailor will dress you both tonight if the debt ledger goes back in his drawer.
nodes.page: You slip through the window, startling a disgraced tailor who will dress you both tonight if the debt ledger goes back in his drawer. He recognizes the danger you bring, but his eyes dart immediately to the ledger protruding from your coat pocket. His scissors remain on the cutting table, close to his shaking hand, as he waits for your terms. You hold the leverage to force his compliance, or the means to buy it cleanly.

exits.label: Let him sew weave into the lining

nodes.stake: Porter's canvas smells of coal and gets you through gates, provided you carry something heavy.
nodes.page: You pull on the rough porter's canvas, noting it smells intensely of coal and gets you through gates provided you carry something heavy. It is a lowly uniform, but the abrasive fabric makes you instantly invisible to the sentries looking for assassins. The district gates are already narrowing, guards checking faces only when a worker isn't breaking their back under a load. You adjust the heavy collar and step out into the muddy yard.

exits.label: Carry a crate through the gate

nodes.stake: The opera's sleeping-gas valve is already missing, and the usher coats hang unattended by the gallery stair.
nodes.page: The opera house corridors smell of greasepaint, and you quickly realize the sleeping-gas valve is already missing from the wall. The empty bracket suggests someone else has prepared the building for a much quieter tragedy tonight, while the usher coats hang unattended by the gallery stair. You adjust the embroidered lapels, knowing this uniform grants you access to every tier of the distracted audience. The heavy brass doors loom ahead, leading back out toward the cordons.

nodes.stake: The Archbishop's almoner stops dead in the colonnade: he saw your face in the tower an hour ago.
nodes.page: You step into the grand colonnade, only to freeze as the Archbishop's almoner stops dead directly in your path. His eyes widen as they lock onto yours; he saw your face illuminated in the tower barely an hour ago. He takes a sharp breath, his hand instinctively dropping toward the silver whistle chained to his vestments. You have a fraction of a heartbeat to silence him before his shout brings the Guard down on you.

exits.label: Buy his silence with the signet
Let him run and move fast
Walk him to the roof edge

nodes.stake: An alley behind the lamp-yard: the book in your coat, a pigeon line overhead, and a hurdy-gurdy playing patrol times.
nodes.page: You drag yourself into a suffocating alley behind the lamp-yard, the stolen book heavy in your coat. Overhead, a taut pigeon line hums in the wind, while down the lane, a hurdy-gurdy is playing patrol times disguised as music. Sable crouches on a nearby rain barrel, pointing toward the sprawling roofline of the Exchange rising to the east. The city is tightening its grip, and you need to secure your next route quickly.

nodes.stake: Clockwork pigeons roost in a loft above the Exchange, each with a brass capsule of somebody's orders.
nodes.page: You scale the brickwork into a loft where clockwork pigeons roost, each carrying a brass capsule of somebody's orders. The delicate cipher wheels sit abandoned on a workbench, leaving the city's communications entirely vulnerable to your interference. You can alter the flow of the night's manhunt by intercepting the right capsule or injecting a forgery into the stream. The loft smells of brass oil and ozone, a quiet haven above the searching lanterns.

nodes.stake: The blind player hears patrols two streets before they show, and he sells what he hears cheap.
nodes.page: The blind player pauses his tune just as you step near, proving he hears patrols two streets before they show. For a small price, he sells what he hears cheap, offering safe passage through the closing net of the authorities. He tilts his head, listening to a secondary vibration in the cobbles that suggests a hidden path toward the painter's district. You grip a coin in your pocket, weighing his information against the time it takes to negotiate.

exits.label: Follow his tune to the painter

nodes.stake: A portrait artist inks tunnels into his backgrounds; one canvas shows a stair nobody admits exists.
nodes.page: The painter's studio reeks of turpentine, filled with canvases created by an artist who inks tunnels into his backgrounds. One half-finished canvas clearly shows a subterranean stair beneath the Exchange that nobody in the city registry admits exists. He watches you study the piece, a knowing smirk playing on his lips as he wipes a brush on his apron. You can buy the canvas outright or commission him to draft the remaining details.

exits.label: Commission the tunnels into a portrait

nodes.stake: At the bottom of the painted stair is a door with no keyhole and a grandmaster's plate.
nodes.page: You follow the painter's route down a pitch-black shaft, arriving at the bottom of the painted stair to find a door with no keyhole. A grandmaster's steel plate covers the mechanism, a clear sign that whatever lies beyond is severely protected. You have lock shims and a vial of flash-powder, but a mistake here will trigger a collapse in the tunnel above. The metal is cold under your fingers as you prepare to defeat the lock.

nodes.stake: Shelves of counter-ledgers, a plinth, a strongbox, and dust that has not been walked in for nine years.
nodes.page: The heavy door swings inward, revealing a chamber filled with shelves of counter-ledgers, a plinth, and a strongbox. The pristine layer of grey dust on the floor proves this room has not been walked in for nine years. The information in this room could cross-reference everything in the Architect’s Ledger, exposing the foundations of the city. You must extract what you need before the surface watch rotates and seals the upper tunnels.

exits.label: Climb out before the watch turns

nodes.stake: Silk-Weaver receipts and Iron Syndicate warrants are written in one hand — the two houses are one cabal.
nodes.page: You spread the documents across a table, realizing the Silk-Weaver receipts and Iron Syndicate warrants are written in one hand. The terrifying truth is undeniable: the two houses are not at war, they are one cabal manipulating the entire city. A fresh chalk mark on the wall summons you to a meeting, indicating they already know you breached the vault. You must choose how to wield this revelation against the masters of Veridia.

exits.label: Copy both hands onto one sheet

nodes.stake: Chalk marks on the Exchange chimneys: both houses want a meeting tonight, before the eclipse.
nodes.page: You pull yourself up onto the expansive slate roof, finding fresh chalk marks on the Exchange chimneys. Both houses want a meeting tonight, desperate to secure the ledger before the impending eclipse plunges the city into darkness. The drone wires stretch southward, offering a treacherous path away from the negotiations if you choose to ignore them entirely. The sky above is already beginning to dim as the celestial alignment approaches.

nodes.stake: Two rooms, one night: whoever you sit with learns you have the book, and the other learns you chose.
nodes.page: You stand in the narrow corridor connecting the wings, facing two rooms, one night, and a brutal calculation. Whoever you sit with learns instantly that you have the book, and the other learns that you made a choice. There is no neutral ground left in this building once you cross either threshold. You can make a kingmaker's pact, or reject them both and keep climbing into the fading light.

nodes.stake: Valerius offers protection, a name, and a price, and keeps glancing at Sable's boots on his carpet.
nodes.page: Lord Valerius pours wine in the opulent hall, offering protection, a name, and a price for the book in your pocket. However, he keeps glancing at Sable's muddy boots on his immaculate carpet, calculating her value as leverage. He is too calm for a man whose empire is currently burning, suggesting he already controls the exits. You must lock in your demands before his hidden guards step out from behind the tapestries.

nodes.stake: Rigg talks over the hammers, offers iron instead of silk, and admits she keeps the gaol lists.
nodes.page: Matron Rigg talks loudly over the drop hammers, offering unyielding iron protection instead of silk wealth. She casually admits she keeps the gaol lists, sliding the warrants for Sable's brother onto the table like a loaded pistol. The heat of the molten iron below forces sweat into your eyes as you weigh her brutal honesty against her ruthless nature. You need to secure her token or extract the brother's name before she loses her patience.

exits.label: Demand the brother off her lists
Walk out onto the crane arm

nodes.stake: The sun is going out over Veridia and every lamplighter in the district is running the wrong way.
nodes.page: The sky above Veridia turns bruised as the sun is going out, plunging the city into premature twilight. Every lamplighter in the district is panicking, running the wrong way to ignite the gas mains early. The sudden plunge creates a massive, chaotic blind spot across the upper spans of the city. You must exploit this celestial darkness before the authorities realize their watchmen are completely blind.

nodes.stake: Half-dark on the high ridgeline, with a guard nest on the gable and the last span still to cross.
nodes.page: You navigate the high ridgeline in the terrifying half-dark of the eclipse, the slate tiles slippery with condensation. A fortified guard nest sits directly on the gable, and you have the last span still to cross before reaching safety. The air grows noticeably colder, your breath pluming in the sudden temperature drop as you evaluate the sentries. You have to cross this stretch without drawing the attention of the panicked riflemen.

nodes.stake: Press house one way, a live brazier the other, the harbor road north: the list is about to be something forever.
nodes.page: You balance on the apex, seeing the press house one way, a live brazier the other, and the harbor road north. The ink on the Architect’s pages is about to become something forever, depending entirely on the direction you walk. You can print the secrets, destroy them entirely, or vanish into the fog with the knowledge intact. The heavy ledger feels like an anchor as you prepare to make your final decision.

exits.label: Carry the pages to the press
Carry the pages to the brazier
Keep the book shut, go north

nodes.stake: A night printer, a case of type, and one hour before the Guard thinks to check press yards.
nodes.page: You break into the shop, finding a night printer, an open case of type, and exactly one hour before the Guard checks the yards. The names in the ledger are damning enough to collapse the government if you can get them set into the plates. The smell of ink and solvent fills your lungs as you prepare to make the Archbishop’s secrets undeniably public. You must decide whether to run the presses or simply nail the proof where everyone will see it.

exits.label: Set the Architect names in type
Nail a proof to the cathedral door
Pull the plates, take the ledge

nodes.stake: A watchman's brazier on the eclipse ledge, coals white, and rag paper burns very well.
nodes.page: You approach a watchman's brazier on the eclipse ledge, noting the coals are white-hot and that rag paper burns very well. Destroying the book entirely erases the targets, but also destroys your only leverage against the cabal hunting you. You can slide the entire volume into the fire, or selectively burn only the Architect leaf to alter the narrative. The heat blisters your skin as you hold the brass-bound spine over the hungry flames.

exits.label: Feed the pages to the coals

nodes.stake: The colossal brass statue's crown, a mooring chain, and a barge that leaves before the sun comes back.
nodes.page: You scale into the colossal brass statue's crown, looking down at a mooring chain and a barge that leaves before the sun comes back. The ledger sits heavy in your coat, a weapon of mass destruction that you have chosen to simply walk away with. The city will tear itself apart looking for the book, completely unaware that it is floating down the estuary. You must finalize your escape before the eclipse breaks and the dockward lanterns find you.

exits.label: Take the night stair off the crown

nodes.stake: The dead man's cloak is heavier than it looks, and the Guard climbing toward you have never met him close up.
nodes.page: The dead man's cloak is heavier than it looks, and the Guard climbing toward you have never met him close up. You descend the spiral stairs, relying entirely on the authority of the silhouette to push through the tightening net. A sergeant pauses on the landing, his eyes narrowing slightly at the dark stains soaking into the cuffs of the holy garment. You must project the absolute arrogance of the church to push past his suspicion.

exits.label: Bless the boy with the lantern

nodes.stake: Two hundred feet of nave at a priest's pace, with mourners already gathering at the west door.
nodes.page: You step into the cavernous nave, staring down two hundred feet of polished marble at a measured priest's pace. Mourners are already gathering at the west door, their heads bowed in prayer, entirely unaware of the blood on your sleeves. The hollow echo of your boots seems deafening, but breaking into a run now will instantly shatter the illusion. You keep your hands clasped together, using the heavy velvet to obscure the stolen ledger.

exits.label: Leave the almsbox open behind you

nodes.stake: Wet cobbles, whistles two streets off, and a cloak that only works until somebody who knew the hem looks twice.
nodes.page: You emerge onto wet cobbles, hearing whistles two streets off, wearing a cloak that only works until somebody who knew the hem looks twice. You follow the drainage slope toward the Exchange, keeping to the deepest shadows cast by the flickering gas lamps. The perimeter is closing rapidly, and the heavy velvet is becoming a soaked, dangerous liability. You must decide whether to shed this skin or commit to wearing the disguise into the fire.

exits.label: Follow the drain toward the Exchange
Listen for whistles at the crossing

nodes.stake: The cloak got you out; it will not get you across the district. One cover, chosen now.
nodes.page: The cloak got you out of the immediate cordon, but it will not get you across the entire district. You stand in an alleyway, evaluating your options; one cover, chosen now, will dictate your survival. A disgraced tailor's shop sits nearby, offering bespoke garments if you can leverage his debts. Across the yard, coarse porter livery hangs unattended on a clothesline, promising the invisibility of manual labor.

exits.label: Lift porter livery off a line

nodes.stake: Wearing a murdered archbishop through his own district is either brilliant or nine minutes from over.
nodes.page: Wearing a murdered archbishop through his own district is either brilliant or exactly nine minutes from over. You stride directly into the grand colonnade, forcing the scattering crowds to part out of sheer religious reflex. Every step requires absolute conviction, pretending the blood on your cuff is merely spilled communion wine. You prepare to bless the very patrols that are currently hunting for your head.

exits.label: Bless a patrol to pass it

nodes.stake: He wants his debt ledger back more than he wants to know whose blood is on your cuff.
nodes.page: You shove the tailor’s own damning debt ledger onto his table; he wants it back more than he wants to know whose blood is on your cuff. He moves with practiced speed, pulling dark, unmemorable wool over your shoulders to replace the vibrant cloak. He does not ask questions, but his needle shakes as he sews a concealed pocket into the lining. You leave his debt open on the table, a silent threat ensuring his absolute silence.

exits.label: Let him sew weave into the lining

nodes.stake: Porter canvas, a crate of nothing, and a gate clerk who checks faces only when the roll is short.
nodes.page: You pull on the damp porter canvas and heft a crate of nothing, approaching a gate clerk who checks faces only when the roll is short. The heavy weight crushes your posture into that of a laborer, making you instantly invisible to the sentries. The smell of wet wool and coal dust masks the scent of the belfry's blood perfectly. You shuffle toward the checkpoint, keeping your eyes locked firmly on the muddy ground.

exits.label: Carry a crate through the gate

nodes.stake: The deacon who dressed the Archbishop this morning is looking at your hem, your hands, then your eyes.
nodes.page: You freeze as the deacon who dressed the Archbishop this morning is suddenly looking at your hem, your hands, then your eyes. He knows instantly that the garment is on the wrong shoulders, and his mouth opens to scream for the Guard. The space between you is too wide for a blade, but narrow enough for a bribe or a sudden push. You must neutralize his recognition before he draws the breath to end your escape.

exits.label: Buy his silence with the signet
Let him run to the Guard

nodes.stake: A rented garret, one candle, nobody to watch the stair, and a pigeon cage rattling on the sill.
nodes.page: You break into a rented garret, lighting one candle, relieved there is nobody to watch the stair. A pigeon cage rattles fiercely on the sill, its mechanical occupant eager to deliver orders across the city. The isolation allows you to finally breathe, the brass gears on the book's spine clicking faintly in the silence. You survey the avenues of escape from the window, knowing the peace will not last.

exits.label: Follow a hurdy-gurdy down the lane
Take the ridge to the Exchange

nodes.stake: Somebody's clockwork bird has been carrying orders over the Exchange all night, and it will carry yours.
nodes.page: You open the cage; somebody's clockwork bird has been carrying orders over the Exchange all night, and it will carry yours. You possess the cipher key to rewrite these instructions, turning the city's own communications network against them. The intricate gears whir in protest as you carefully unspool the tiny, encrypted message. You have seconds to forge a new truth before the recipient realizes the drone is missing.

exits.label: Follow the tune to the corner

nodes.stake: The blind player names the patrol he can hear, then asks whose coin you are carrying.
nodes.page: You stand at the corner as the blind player names the patrol he can hear, then calmly asks whose coin you are carrying. He knows you are not a local, and his silence is a commodity that fluctuates based on the weight of your purse. The rain slicks the cobblestones as you calculate how much of the truth he can deduce from your breathing alone. You must purchase his navigational rhythm or test the limits of his loyalty.

nodes.stake: The painter sells faces to the rich and tunnels to whoever notices the backgrounds.
nodes.page: You step into the brightly lit studio of a painter who sells faces to the rich and tunnels to whoever notices the backgrounds. He recognizes the desperation in your posture and calmly wipes a sable brush on his smock, waiting for your offer. You can buy an old canvas cheap, or commission him to draft the specific subterranean route you need. The smell of linseed oil is overpowering as you negotiate your escape.

exits.label: Commission the tunnels in the background

nodes.stake: The painted tunnel ends at a plated door that the city insists is a coal chute.
nodes.page: You follow the painted map to an alley, stopping before a plated door that the city insists is merely a coal chute. The locking mechanism is military-grade, betraying the immense value of whatever lies sealed beneath the street. The lock plate can be delicately shimmed, or the hinge pins can be blown with flash-powder. A mistake will echo through the district, pulling every patrol directly to your location.

nodes.stake: Cold air, shelved duplicates, and a strongbox on a plinth nobody has dusted since the last archbishop.
nodes.page: You drop into the freezing cold air, surrounded by shelved duplicates and a strongbox on a plinth nobody has dusted since the last archbishop. The Architect’s Ledger in your pocket begins to softly click in resonance with the mechanisms hidden within the room. You must cross-reference the names or steal the box entirely before the surface watch rotates and seals the vault. The silence here preserves the secrets of Veridia's elite perfectly.

nodes.stake: Silk and iron sign with the same pen-cut: there is one cabal wearing two names, and the book proves it.
nodes.page: You realize that Silk and iron sign with the same pen-cut: there is one cabal wearing two names, and the book proves it. The realization hits you like a physical blow, turning the ledger from a dangerous artifact into an absolute weapon. You can merge the evidence onto a single sheet, or carry this revelation into the meetings they are demanding. The power dynamic of the entire city just shifted into your hands.

exits.label: Copy both hands onto one sheet
Slip through the heavy side door

nodes.stake: From the Exchange ridge you can see both houses' lamps burning and both their runners looking for you.
nodes.page: From the Exchange ridge you can see both houses' lamps burning brightly and both their runners desperately looking for you. The chalked summons near the chimney explicitly dictate where you must go if you wish to negotiate your survival tonight. To the south, the precarious drone wires offer a dangerous alternative route, bypassing the cabal entirely. You crouch against the brickwork, deciding who gets to control the narrative of the morning.

nodes.stake: Two letters under the same slate: sit with one house tonight and the other files you forever.
nodes.page: You find two letters under the same slate: sit with one house tonight and the other files you forever as an enemy. If you answer Lord Valerius, his silk empire will shield you; if you answer Matron Rigg, the iron foundry protects you. Both houses demand exclusive ownership of the ledger, and leaving both letters unanswered guarantees they will unite against you. The wind howls over the ridge as you trace the crests.

nodes.stake: Valerius pours for one and asks, politely, how much of the book you have already memorized.
nodes.page: You step into the silk annex, where Valerius pours for one and asks, politely, how much of the book you have already memorized. His tone is conversational, but the question is a direct threat; he needs to know if killing you silences the information. The heavy drapes muffle the sounds of the city, isolating you entirely within his sphere of influence. You must cement your leverage in writing before he decides your memory is a liability.

exits.label: Name your price as a seat
Pocket the silk seal and go

nodes.stake: Rigg keeps the warrants, the gaol books, and an opinion about men who wear dead priests.
nodes.page: You walk onto the gantry where Rigg keeps the warrants, the gaol books, and an opinion about men who wear dead priests. She controls the physical force of the city, and she is offering you an iron token that guarantees absolute immunity. The roaring furnaces below cast brutal shadows across her face as she waits for your submission. You must take her protection or challenge her authority regarding the names she fears.

exits.label: Leave by the foundry side door

nodes.stake: The sun is going and the whole district's lamps are still cold; nobody is watching upward for an hour.
nodes.page: You climb higher as the sun is going and the whole district's lamps are still cold; nobody is watching upward for an hour. This celestial anomaly grants you absolute freedom of movement across the treacherous slate roofs toward the northern ridge. The massive clock face of the Exchange provides a perfect, shadowed lattice to ascend before the lamplighters correct their mistake. You move with aggressive speed, exploiting the blindness of the watchmen below.

exits.label: Step into the morning fog alone

nodes.stake: Dark sun, wet slate, a nest on the gable, and nobody at all covering the angles behind you.
nodes.page: You navigate the high gable under the dark sun, noting the wet slate, a nest on the gable, and nobody at all covering the angles behind you. The guards inside the nest are panicked by the eclipse, arguing over the failing light and completely ignoring their perimeter. You have a narrow window to clear the nest quietly or simply cross under the cover of the unnatural darkness. The wind at this altitude is deafening, masking the sound of your approach perfectly.

nodes.stake: Press yard, buyer's parlor, harbor road: whatever you do with the list, you do it with no witness.
nodes.page: You stand at the zenith of your escape, choosing between the press yard, a buyer's parlor, or the harbor road: whatever you do with the list, you do it with no witness. You can print the secrets, trade them for immense wealth, or simply walk away and leave the city in ignorance. The heavy, brass-bound ledger feels like an anchor dragging you toward a permanent decision. The ink on the Architect’s pages is about to become history, gold, or a ghost's burden.

exits.label: Carry the pages to the press
Carry the list to a buyer
Keep the book shut, go north

nodes.stake: Type case open, signet in your pocket, and the ugly realization that the book can be edited as easily as printed.
nodes.page: You drop into the quiet press yard, type case open, signet in your pocket, and the ugly realization that the book can be edited as easily as printed. You can run the presses with the absolute truth, or use the blank margins to forge your own enemies into the narrative. The ink rollers wait to crush whatever reality you assemble into the plates. You hold the power to become a nameless martyr, or the new architect of the city.

exits.label: Set the Architect names in type
Nail a proof to the Exchange board
Ink your own hand into the margins

nodes.stake: Three added pages in a dead man's script, and not one person left alive who could find the seam.
nodes.page: You sit at the dimly lit desk, flawlessly imitating the dead man's script across three added pages, and not one person left alive who could find the seam. You seamlessly integrate your own targets into the ancient list, rewriting the political reality of Veridia with every stroke of ink. You press his stolen signet into the hot wax, authenticating a lie that will execute dozens of innocent people. You have ceased to be the hunted; you are now the author.

exits.label: Seal the forged leaf with his signet

nodes.stake: Brandy, a fire, an offered chair, and a price already written on a card face-down.
nodes.page: You step into the parlor to find brandy, a fire, an offered chair, and a price already written on a card face-down. The buyer simply waits for you to hand the list to either the silk hall or the foundry representative. The transaction is bloodless and utterly cynical, trading the city's future for your own absolute comfort. You can take the staggering wealth, or walk out and leave their empires starving.

exits.label: Hand the list to the silk hall
Hand the list to the foundry

nodes.stake: The brass colossus, a coal barge at the chain, and a book that has cost four lives and told nobody anything.
nodes.page: You pull yourself into the brass colossus, a coal barge at the chain, carrying a book that has cost four lives and told nobody anything. You have the power to destroy the regime, yet you are choosing to simply take their secrets across the sea. The colossal statue watches blindly as you prepare to slip away before the sun returns. You wrap your cloak tighter, securing your passage as a ghost.

exits.label: Book passage under a false name
Leave through the oak side door

nodes.stake: The bolt is thrown, her fist is on the underside of the hatch, and the Guard lanterns are already at her level.
nodes.page: The bolt is thrown, her fist is on the underside of the hatch, and the Guard lanterns are already at her level. She trusted you to hold the line, and you have mathematically traded her life for a three-minute head start. You must climb the outer face of the belfry alone while they break her down on the landing below. The cold rain masks the sound of the splintering wood as you turn your back on the door.

The information inside is too dangerous to sell and too damning to publish, transforming you into a permanent fugitive. You sleep with a pistol beneath your pillow, waking at every creak of the floorboards. You never use the same name at a tavern, and you never sleep in the same bed twice.

nodes.stake: The list survives; the climber does not.
nodes.page: The printing presses run hot all night, scattering the protocol's secrets to every corner of Veridia's slums. You stand alone on the cathedral's slate roof, watching the city awaken to the truth of its own subjugation. There is no one left to cover your blind spots. The crack of the rifle echoes across the square a second before the heavy caliber round shatters your ribs. You collapse against the gargoyle, bleeding out with a bitter smile as the streets below erupt into a revolution you will never see.

nodes.stake: A seat at the table that the book built.
nodes.page: The heavy mahogany doors of the inner council chamber swing open, welcoming you to the table you purchased with the blood of your former allies. Handing the ledger back to the magistrates earned you a plush aristocratic seat and total immunity from the ongoing purges. You sip imported wine from crystal glasses, looking down at the very streets you used to bleed in. The edge has dulled completely, replaced by velvet cushions and heavily guarded estates. You never have to sleep with a knife under your pillow again.

nodes.stake: Forged into the protocol with no one left to spot the seam.
nodes.page: Rather than destroying the machine, you simply insert your own name into its blank spaces and claim the levers of power for yourself. You manipulate the ledger's coded blackmail to puppet the city's elites from the highest suite in the Exchange. Operating entirely alone, there is no one left alive who remembers your face from the gutters. The transition from street-level operative to the invisible hand of Veridia is completely seamless. You have become the very protocol you set out to dismantle.

nodes.stake: Published, then answered from the perch you made.

Your rival slides down from her perch, a loaded pistol leveled precisely at your chest. The ledger is public, but the final score between the two of you demands an immediate and fatal answer.

nodes.stake: Paid in rooms, collected on the landing.

You leave the political maneuvering behind, retreating to a life of silken sheets and hired guards. But paranoia is a hard habit to break, and you tense as you hear the soft scrape of boots on the landing outside your door. Your old rival steps out of the gloom, unimpressed by your newly purchased status. The gold bought you a comfortable room, but she has come to collect the debt with cold steel.

nodes.stake: You push the wooden door open, revealing a narrow brick tunnel that smells of sewage.
nodes.page: You push the wooden door open, revealing a narrow brick tunnel that smells of sewage. Sable leads the way, using the faint ambient light from a distant street grate to navigate. The rushing water beneath the grate masks the sound of your footsteps completely. You follow the tunnel until it terminates at a rusted iron ladder.

nodes.stake: You continue trailing your hand along the wall, bypassing the wooden door entirely.
nodes.page: You continue trailing your hand along the wall, bypassing the wooden door entirely. The cellar eventually narrows into a dead end, blocked by a collapsed foundation wall. Sable sifts through the rubble, finding nothing but broken glass and damp earth. You have no choice but to turn back or look for another way out.

nodes.stake: You follow the muddy footprints down the right tunnel, your boots sinking slightly into the soft earth.
nodes.page: You follow the muddy footprints down the right tunnel, your boots sinking slightly into the soft earth. Sable remains vigilant, noting that the footprints belong to at least three different people. The tunnel gradually widens, terminating at a heavy steel bulkhead door. The wheel locking the door is chained, but the padlock is visibly damaged.

exits.label: Turn back to the left tunnel

nodes.stake: You step out of the fog, drawing the attention of the two enforcers away from the musician.
nodes.page: You step out of the fog, drawing the attention of the two enforcers away from the musician. Sable moves in sync with you, flanking the guards before they can unholster their batons. You strike the first enforcer in the jaw, sending him sprawling against the cobblestones. Sable dispatches the second with a swift strike to the back of the knees.

exits.label: Drag the guards into the fog

nodes.stake: You pry the unauthorized receiver chip from the drone's logic board with your blade.
nodes.page: You pry the unauthorized receiver chip from the drone's logic board with your blade. Sparks shower briefly from the severed connections, but the drone remains completely inert. Sable pockets the chip, suggesting it could be analyzed later to track the harbor factions. The tampering leaves the drone permanently disabled.

exits.label: Search the rest of the loft

nodes.stake: You track the trench-coated figure through the plaza, keeping your eyes fixed on them from the window.
nodes.page: You track the trench-coated figure through the plaza, keeping your eyes fixed on them from the window. Sable notes their hurried gait, suggesting they are desperate to make a scheduled rendezvous. The figure disappears into the side entrance of the opera house, bypassing the main security checkpoint. They have left the hurdy-gurdy man alone in the square.

exits.label: Leave the loft and follow them
Shift focus back to the loft

nodes.stake: You cup your gloved hand over the obsidian beak, blinding the tiny camera lens.
nodes.page: You cup your gloved hand over the obsidian beak, blinding the tiny camera lens. Sable quickly works her lockpick into the roost's anchoring mechanism, detaching the micro-filament wire. With the wire severed, the camera loses its power source, shutting down completely. You slide the inert glass pigeon into your pack.

nodes.stake: You hook a finger under the micro-filament wire and pull sharply, snapping it in two.
nodes.page: You hook a finger under the micro-filament wire and pull sharply, snapping it in two. The obsidian pigeon instantly emits a high-pitched, electronic squeal. Sable curses, immediately driving her boot into the bird to crush the agonizing alarm. The sound cuts out, but the noise likely registered on the local grid monitors.

nodes.stake: You inspect the remaining brass pigeons, finding nothing but standard messenger units.
nodes.page: You inspect the remaining brass pigeons, finding nothing but standard messenger units. Sable checks their delivery logs, confirming they only fly routine routes between the tower and the Exchange. The loft is otherwise quiet, filled only with the faint ticking of idle clockwork. There is nothing else of value hidden among the roosts.

nodes.stake: You drop to one knee, sifting through the debris scattered across the tunnel floor.
nodes.page: You drop to one knee, sifting through the debris scattered across the tunnel floor. Sable shines a narrow beam of light, revealing a discarded leather satchel coated in grime. Inside, you find a collection of forged transit passes stamped with yesterday's date. They are useless now, left behind by whoever used this tunnel last.

nodes.stake: You sweep your hands over the low ceiling, feeling for any gaps in the damp masonry.
nodes.page: You sweep your hands over the low ceiling, feeling for any gaps in the damp masonry. Sable’s fingers brush against a wooden panel, pushing upward to reveal a concealed hatch. Dust rains down as you heave the hatch open, exposing a narrow shaft leading up. The air flowing down from the shaft smells of roasting meats and coal smoke.

exits.label: Go back to the wooden door

nodes.stake: You strike the damaged padlock with the butt of your knife, shattering the weakened metal loop.
nodes.page: You strike the damaged padlock with the butt of your knife, shattering the weakened metal loop. Sable unspools the heavy chain, letting it fall quietly into the mud. You turn the rusted wheel, groaning as the heavy steel bulkhead swings inward. The corridor beyond is lined with smooth, modern concrete, drastically different from the old sewers.

nodes.stake: You approach the blind musician, who is calmly turning his crank again as if nothing happened.
nodes.page: You approach the blind musician, who is calmly turning his crank again as if nothing happened. Sable asks him what the enforcers wanted, but the old man just smiles cryptically. He stops grinding the wheel, handing you a small, folded piece of parchment. "The counts have changed," he whispers, gesturing vaguely toward the Exchange.

nodes.stake: You pull away from the window, abandoning the pursuit of the mysterious figure.
nodes.page: You pull away from the window, abandoning the pursuit of the mysterious figure. Sable taps the face of her pocket watch, reminding you that time is slipping away. The loft has yielded all the secrets it’s going to offer tonight. You must press forward to the next objective before the shift change occurs.

nodes.stake: You pocket the expired passes, figuring the high-quality paper might be useful for a new forgery.
nodes.page: You pocket the expired passes, figuring the high-quality paper might be useful for a new forgery. Sable nods, always one to appreciate salvaged resources in the field. You both grab the rungs of the iron ladder, ascending out of the foul-smelling tunnel. You emerge behind a stack of shipping crates in a narrow surface alley.

exits.label: Climb the crates to the roof

nodes.stake: You unfold the parchment, finding a frantic scrawl detailing a massive raid planned for tomorrow.
nodes.page: You unfold the parchment, finding a frantic scrawl detailing a massive raid planned for tomorrow. Sable reads it over your shoulder, her expression hardening at the tactical implications. The blind man begins playing a fast, aggressive tune on the hurdy-gurdy, masking your conversation. The information is vital, but you still have to survive the night first.

nodes.stake: The descent from the opera takes you into the painted tunnels beneath the Exchange.
nodes.page: The descent from the opera takes you into the painted tunnels beneath the Exchange. Sable holds a lantern high, illuminating murals of forgotten Veridian merchants offering coins to the sea. The air smells of salt and old parchment, completely undisturbed by recent passage. She runs a gloved finger along a brass sconce, revealing a thick layer of grey powder. This is the nine-year dust, untouched since the cabal first sealed these particular corridors.

nodes.stake: You step closer to the painted walls, noting that the merchants' faces are blank, their eyes deliberately scratched out.
nodes.page: You step closer to the painted walls, noting that the merchants' faces are blank, their eyes deliberately scratched out. Sable traces the gouges, pointing out that the damage is ancient, not part of the recent unrest. A draft pulls at the flame in her lantern, drawing your attention to a narrow gap behind the plaster. The draft hints at a hollow space, likely part of the old smuggling routes used by the tailors' guild. You brush aside a loose flake of paint to find a rusted metal grate.

exits.label: Follow the draft down the corridor

nodes.stake: The painted tunnels slope steeply downward, the colorful murals giving way to bare, damp stone.
nodes.page: The painted tunnels slope steeply downward, the colorful murals giving way to bare, damp stone. Sable stays close, her footsteps barely making a sound on the uneven floor. You both know the cabal's identities already, so this infiltration is purely about finding the physical leverage to break their hold on Veridia. A heavy iron door looms at the end of the passage, flanked by two unlit torches. The locking mechanism is complex, featuring a series of interlocking brass rings that require precise alignment.

nodes.stake: With a sharp pull, the metal grate comes loose in your hands, showering your boots in brittle rust.
nodes.page: With a sharp pull, the metal grate comes loose in your hands, showering your boots in brittle rust. Beyond the opening lies a cramped service shaft smelling strongly of coal and damp earth. Sable peers over your shoulder, noting the soot stains that line the brickwork. This contradicts the public blueprints of the Exchange, exposing the coal-chute lies perpetuated by the harbor master. You slide into the narrow space, brushing against the rough walls as you descend further.

exits.label: Search the chute for discarded items

nodes.stake: You follow the chill breeze deeper into the tunnels, leaving the defaced murals behind.
nodes.page: You follow the chill breeze deeper into the tunnels, leaving the defaced murals behind. The architecture shifts, the ceiling dropping lower as you approach the perimeter of the main vault. Sable stops suddenly, her hand resting on a section of wall that appears slightly misaligned. She presses her weight against the stone, and it pivots silently on a hidden central axis. A narrow, spiraling staircase is revealed, curving sharply out of sight.

nodes.stake: The brass rings of the lock are cold to the touch and covered in a fine patina.
nodes.page: The brass rings of the lock are cold to the touch and covered in a fine patina. You manipulate the tumblers, listening to the internal clicks echoing in the quiet tunnel. Sable holds the lantern closer, pointing out microscopic scratches on the second and fourth rings. These marks indicate frequent use by someone who knew the exact combination. You align the scratched rings first, and the heavy bolt slides back with a satisfying clunk.

nodes.stake: You step back from the iron door, scanning the surrounding masonry for any weaknesses.
nodes.page: You step back from the iron door, scanning the surrounding masonry for any weaknesses. Above the door frame, a narrow ventilation slit cuts through the thick stone wall. Sable hands you the lantern and offers a boost, interlacing her fingers to form a step. You pull yourself up to the slit, finding it just wide enough to squeeze your shoulders through. The space beyond drops down into a dimly lit antechamber.

nodes.stake: You drop from the coal-chute into a small, soot-stained storage room.
nodes.page: You drop from the coal-chute into a small, soot-stained storage room. The floor is littered with broken wooden crates and scraps of canvas. Sable lands lightly beside you, her boots kicking up a small cloud of black dust. In the corner, a reinforced strongbox sits atop a sturdy oak table. The lock is surprisingly pristine, contrasting sharply with the grime of the room.

nodes.stake: The hidden stairs twist sharply, forcing you to turn sideways to navigate the tight space.
nodes.page: The hidden stairs twist sharply, forcing you to turn sideways to navigate the tight space. This architecture mimics the portrait-background stairs depicted in the governor’s manor, confirming the builder's identity. Sable murmurs a quiet acknowledgment of the design, keeping her hand on the wall for balance. The staircase ends at a solid wooden door reinforced with steel bands. Light bleeds through the gap at the bottom, suggesting an occupied room ahead.

nodes.stake: The heavy iron door swings inward on well-oiled hinges, revealing a sprawling archive room.
nodes.page: The heavy iron door swings inward on well-oiled hinges, revealing a sprawling archive room. Shelves of rotting wood groan under the weight of countless bound documents. You recognize the unmistakable bindings of the counter-ledgers, the true financial records of the city. Sable moves immediately to a desk in the center, brushing aside a layer of nine-year dust to examine a ledger. The cabal's illicit trades with the harbor colossus are meticulously detailed on the open pages.

nodes.stake: You carefully navigate the antechamber, stepping over discarded lengths of rusted chain.
nodes.page: You carefully navigate the antechamber, stepping over discarded lengths of rusted chain. The walls here are lined with iron pegs, most of them empty, save for a few rotting leather straps. Sable examines one of the straps, noting the faint impression of a Veridian crest. This area was clearly used to store secure transport gear before the cabal sealed the vault. A heavy grate in the floor provides a view of the main vault below.

exits.label: Check the walls for hidden compartments

nodes.stake: Deciding against the narrow gap, you turn your attention back to the surrounding walls.
nodes.page: Deciding against the narrow gap, you turn your attention back to the surrounding walls. The stone here is damp, patches of dark moss clinging to the mortar. Sable taps the hilt of her knife against the masonry, listening for hollow echoes. One section of the wall returns a dull thud, indicating a void just behind the brickwork. You scrape away the mortar with a heavy iron spike found on the ground.

exits.label: Search the immediate area for a tool

nodes.stake: You examine the pristine lock on the strongbox, finding it suspiciously simple to pick.
nodes.page: You examine the pristine lock on the strongbox, finding it suspiciously simple to pick. The lid pops open, revealing stacks of worthless, blank parchment and iron slugs. Sable laughs softly, realizing you have found a second strongbox that is merely a decoy. The cabal anticipated intruders, leaving this trap to waste the time of rival factions. You toss the iron slugs aside, looking for a way out of the storage room.

nodes.stake: You rummage through the broken crates, finding nothing but rotted straw and wood rot.
nodes.page: You rummage through the broken crates, finding nothing but rotted straw and wood rot. Sable directs your attention to a loose flagstone near the center of the room. Prying it up reveals a small, lead-lined compartment containing a single brass key. The key bears the intricate seal of the printing press guild. You pocket the key, knowing it will be useful in the deeper sections of the vault.

nodes.stake: You push the heavy wooden door open, stepping into a long, arched gallery.
nodes.page: You push the heavy wooden door open, stepping into a long, arched gallery. The air is dry and smells heavily of old leather and binding glue. Stacks of counter-ledgers line the walls, documenting decades of extortion and bribery. Sable quickly secures a dozen of the most damaging books in her pack. With the cabal already known, these records provide the exact dates and sums needed for their ruin.

nodes.stake: Through the iron grate in the floor, you can see the gleaming floor of the main vault.
nodes.page: Through the iron grate in the floor, you can see the gleaming floor of the main vault. The space below is vast, lined with towering pillars of polished dark stone. Sable points to a series of tripwires crisscrossing the entry points to the lower level. Navigating that space will require absolute precision to avoid triggering the alarms. You step away from the grate, looking for a safer path downward.

exits.label: Try to disable the tripwires from here

nodes.stake: You manage to dislodge several bricks, creating a hole large enough to crawl through.
nodes.page: You manage to dislodge several bricks, creating a hole large enough to crawl through. The space beyond is a narrow maintenance corridor running parallel to the main vault. Sable follows close behind, the lantern light casting long, distorted shadows on the walls. The corridor smells of stale water and copper, leading toward the mechanical heart of the building. You hear the faint, rhythmic ticking of the vault's massive locking mechanisms.

nodes.stake: You abandon the solid wall and instead examine a heavy tapestry hanging nearby.
nodes.page: You abandon the solid wall and instead examine a heavy tapestry hanging nearby. The fabric is thick and embroidered with a stylized map of the harbor colossus. Pulling it aside reveals a hidden alcove containing a small, iron-bound chest. Sable works the lock with a pair of picks, opening it to reveal a stash of uncut Veridian glass. You leave the glass behind, focusing on the heavy wooden door at the back of the alcove.

exits.label: Study the map on the tapestry

nodes.stake: The hallway stretches out, its floor laid with alternating tiles of black and white marble.
nodes.page: The hallway stretches out, its floor laid with alternating tiles of black and white marble. The silence here is absolute, the thick walls absorbing all sound from the city above. Sable stops at an intersection, checking a rough sketch she pulled from her coat. The left path leads toward the central vault floor, while the right slopes downward. She nods toward the downward slope, indicating it matches the older schematics.

nodes.stake: You step into a circular room filled with glass display cases, most of them shattered.
nodes.page: You step into a circular room filled with glass display cases, most of them shattered. The cabal clearly cleared this room of valuables long ago, leaving only broken glass and dust. Sable kneels by one of the cases, examining a scrap of fabric caught on the jagged edge. It is a piece of tailor's silk, identical to the garments worn by the inner circle. This physical evidence ties them directly to the looting of the city's reserves.

nodes.stake: You find a narrow, spiral staircase tucked behind a false bookcase in the gallery.
nodes.page: You find a narrow, spiral staircase tucked behind a false bookcase in the gallery. The steps are steep and lack a railing, dropping dangerously into the darkness below. Sable leads the way, her lantern illuminating exactly one step ahead at a time. The descent feels endless, the air growing colder with every rotation. You finally reach a landing that opens into a cavernous, pillared hall.

nodes.stake: You follow the rhythmic ticking until you reach a large brass housing bolted to the wall.
nodes.page: You follow the rhythmic ticking until you reach a large brass housing bolted to the wall. Inside, a complex array of gears and springs controls the vault's primary defenses. Sable studies the mechanism, recognizing the engineering as a product of the press guild. By jamming a metal spike into the central gear, you could disable the traps on the lower floor. However, the resulting noise would echo throughout the entire complex.

nodes.stake: You pass through the wooden door into a small, elegantly furnished study.
nodes.page: You pass through the wooden door into a small, elegantly furnished study. A massive mahogany desk dominates the room, covered in neat stacks of parchment. Sable moves to the desk, her eyes scanning the top sheet of a detailed manifesto. The document outlines the cabal's plans to manipulate the price of grain across the province. This room clearly serves as a private planning chamber for their operations.

nodes.stake: The sloping hallway ends abruptly at a sheer drop into a dark chasm.
nodes.page: The sloping hallway ends abruptly at a sheer drop into a dark chasm. A narrow stone bridge, barely a foot wide, spans the gap to the other side. Sable tests the edge of the bridge with her boot, watching a pebble fall into the abyss. There is no sound of it hitting the bottom, indicating a massive depth. You must cross the bridge to reach the inner sanctum of the vault.

exits.label: Look for an alternate route down

nodes.stake: You leave the shattered cases behind and enter a long corridor lined with iron doors.
nodes.page: You leave the shattered cases behind and enter a long corridor lined with iron doors. Each door bears a brass nameplate, listing prominent families of Veridia. Sable points out that all the names belong to known associates of the cabal. You try the handle of the nearest door, finding it locked tight. The silence in the corridor is oppressive, heavy with the weight of stolen wealth.

exits.label: Move to the end of the corridor

nodes.stake: The pillared hall is vast, the ceiling lost in the shadows far above.
nodes.page: The pillared hall is vast, the ceiling lost in the shadows far above. Row upon row of massive iron safes stand in perfect alignment across the stone floor. Sable walks among them, checking the numerical designations painted on their sides. She is looking for a specific vault number, the one detailed in the counter-ledgers you found earlier. You hear the faint sound of footsteps echoing from the far end of the hall.

exits.label: Move quickly to the opposite exit

nodes.stake: You search the landing, finding a small cache of supplies hidden beneath a loose board.
nodes.page: You search the landing, finding a small cache of supplies hidden beneath a loose board. The cache contains a coil of strong rope, a few iron pitons, and a flask of oil. Sable packs the rope, noting that it might be useful if the main stairs are compromised. You stand at the threshold of the lower hall, preparing to enter the main vault area. The air is stale, thick with the smell of old metal.

nodes.stake: You read through the manifesto, memorizing the key figures and dates listed.
nodes.page: You read through the manifesto, memorizing the key figures and dates listed. The document proves that the cabal's influence extends far beyond the borders of Veridia. Sable taps your arm, pointing to a second door in the study that is slightly ajar. Through the crack, you can see a sliver of the night sky and the slate tiles of the city. This must be an emergency escape route leading up to the surface.

nodes.stake: You navigate the final stretch of the corridor, reaching a massive circular door forged from solid steel.
nodes.page: You navigate the final stretch of the corridor, reaching a massive circular door forged from solid steel. The locking wheel in the center is as tall as a person, requiring immense strength to turn. Sable grips one side of the wheel, bracing her boots against the stone floor. Together, you heave against the rusted mechanism, groaning with the effort. With a screech of metal, the wheel turns, releasing the heavy locking bolts.

exits.label: Step back and wait for it to swing

nodes.stake: You slip into the shadows behind a towering iron safe, holding your breath.
nodes.page: You slip into the shadows behind a towering iron safe, holding your breath. The footsteps grow louder, revealing a solitary guard patrolling the vault floor with a shuttered lantern. Sable draws her knife, keeping her eyes fixed on the guard's predictable pacing. The guard turns down an adjacent aisle, completely oblivious to your presence. You have a narrow window to slip past him and reach the inner chamber.

exits.label: Wait for him to leave the hall

nodes.stake: You move quickly across the open floor, dodging between the massive safes for cover.
nodes.page: You move quickly across the open floor, dodging between the massive safes for cover. The architecture here is purely functional, designed to protect the wealth of the city's elite. Sable stops at a heavy iron gate blocking the exit, its bars thick and unyielding. The lock is a simple heavy padlock, easily bypassed with the right tools. You pull out your picks and get to work.

exits.label: Look for the gate key nearby

nodes.stake: You secure the pitons in your pack, knowing they might be the only way back up.
nodes.page: You secure the pitons in your pack, knowing they might be the only way back up. The landing offers no other exits, forcing you to commit to the path ahead. Sable adjusts the flame in her lantern, casting a brighter light into the sprawling hall. You step past the threshold, the sheer scale of the underground complex finally becoming apparent. The vault holds secrets that could dismantle the entire hierarchy of the city.

nodes.stake: The massive steel door swings open, revealing the true heart of the Veridian vault.
nodes.page: The massive steel door swings open, revealing the true heart of the Veridian vault. Mountains of raw silver and gold bullion are stacked haphazardly on wooden pallets. Sable ignores the wealth, her eyes fixed on a small, unadorned wooden box in the center of the room. This box contains the final pieces of evidence needed to completely expose the cabal. You step into the room, your boots crunching on loose coins scattered across the floor.

nodes.stake: You wait in the shadows until the guard's footsteps fade completely into the distance.
nodes.page: You wait in the shadows until the guard's footsteps fade completely into the distance. The path to the inner sanctum is now clear, free of any immediate patrols. Sable moves swiftly, leading you to a set of double doors forged from heavy bronze. The doors are unlocked, slightly ajar, inviting you into the final chamber of the complex. You push them open, ready to confront whatever lies within.

nodes.stake: You slip away from the main approach, guiding Sable down a narrow servant's path that cuts toward the manor's rear.
nodes.page: You slip away from the main approach, guiding Sable down a narrow servant's path that cuts toward the manor's rear. The stone walls here are slick with coastal fog, masking the sounds of the distant harbor colossus grinding its gears. Sable keeps her head down, her dark coat blending perfectly with the shadows of the eaves. You pause at a wrought-iron door, the metal cold against your palm. An oil lamp flickers above, illuminating a rusted keyhole.

nodes.stake: The lock gives way with a satisfying click, opening into a dusty scullery.
nodes.page: The lock gives way with a satisfying click, opening into a dusty scullery. You step inside, breathing in the scent of dried lavender and stale ash from a dormant hearth. Sable follows quietly, shutting the heavy door behind you to cut off the ocean breeze. A narrow corridor stretches ahead, leading deeper into the servant quarters. To your right, a spiral staircase twists upward into darkness.

nodes.stake: You wedge your shoulder against the iron frame, pushing until the rusted hinges groan and snap.
nodes.page: You wedge your shoulder against the iron frame, pushing until the rusted hinges groan and snap. The door swings inward, revealing a dimly lit pantry lined with empty glass jars. Sable steps gracefully over the broken threshold, her eyes scanning the shadows for movement. You hear the faint sound of footsteps echoing from a floor above. A wooden door leads into a kitchen, while a brass-handled door opens into a hallway.

nodes.stake: The spiral stairs groan under your weight as you ascend into the residential wing.
nodes.page: The spiral stairs groan under your weight as you ascend into the residential wing. You emerge into a second sitting-room, a space draped in dust covers and smelling of old paper. Faded tapestries depict Veridia's towering spires, their threads unraveling from years of neglect. Sable runs a gloved hand along a mahogany desk, displacing a thick layer of dust. A set of double doors leads toward the master suite, while a side door opens to a balcony.

nodes.stake: The corridor walls are lined with faded portraits of forgotten magistrates and silent benefactors.
nodes.page: The corridor walls are lined with faded portraits of forgotten magistrates and silent benefactors. Sable stays close to your shoulder, her breathing barely audible over the creaking floorboards. You spot a young servant huddled in an alcove, clutching a silver polishing rag to his chest. He looks up in terror, his eyes darting between you and your companion. He whispers that he just heard a mechanical book ticking inside the adjacent study.

nodes.stake: The kitchen is a cavernous space, dominated by a massive iron stove that radiates residual heat.
nodes.page: The kitchen is a cavernous space, dominated by a massive iron stove that radiates residual heat. Copper pots hang from the ceiling, catching the faint light filtering through a grime-caked window. Sable inspects a butcher's block, noting the fresh cleaver marks etched into the wood. A heavy oak door leads toward the dining hall, while a dumbwaiter shaft offers a cramped vertical route. You can hear muted voices echoing down the dumbwaiter shaft.

nodes.stake: The double doors part silently, revealing a master suite overflowing with silk cushions and discarded ledgers.
nodes.page: The double doors part silently, revealing a master suite overflowing with silk cushions and discarded ledgers. Valerius stands by the window, swirling a glass of dark amber spirits. He turns at your entrance, his sharp eyes immediately dropping to the floor. A smirk touches his lips as he remarks on the mud clinging to Sable's riding boots. He sets his glass down, demanding to know why you are trespassing in his private sanctuary.

nodes.stake: The balcony offers a sweeping view of Veridia's slate roofs, stretching all the way to the grand opera house.
nodes.page: The balcony offers a sweeping view of Veridia's slate roofs, stretching all the way to the grand opera house. The wind bites at your face, carrying the scent of salt and burning coal. Sable leans against the stone balustrade, tracking the movement of city guards on the streets below. A rusted iron ladder leads up to the slanted rooftops. A glass conservatory extends to your left, its panes illuminated from within.

nodes.stake: You corner the trembling servant, demanding to know exactly what he heard.
nodes.page: You corner the trembling servant, demanding to know exactly what he heard. He stammers, explaining that the ticking started ten minutes ago, right after a cloaked man left the room. Sable crouches to his level, offering a quiet word of reassurance that calms his shaking hands. The boy points a trembling finger toward the heavy oak doors at the end of the hall. He warns you that the cloaked man promised to return before the hour chimed.

nodes.stake: You press your ear against the mahogany door of the study, listening intently.
nodes.page: You press your ear against the mahogany door of the study, listening intently. A rhythmic, metallic ticking resonates from within, steady as a heartbeat but entirely unnatural. You turn the brass knob, stepping into a room lined with towering bookshelves and smelling of ozone. Resting on a velvet cushion in the center of the desk is a leather-bound book, its spine whirring with brass gears. Sable steps back, eyeing the mechanism with deep suspicion.

nodes.stake: You wedge yourself into the cramped dumbwaiter, pulling the frayed ropes to ascend.
nodes.page: You wedge yourself into the cramped dumbwaiter, pulling the frayed ropes to ascend. Sable follows in the adjacent carriage, her weight straining the ancient pulley system. The ascent is agonizingly slow, the wooden walls scraping against the stone shaft. You pass the first floor, catching a glimpse of a lavish dining room through the hatch. The carriage finally jolts to a halt on the second floor, directly outside a guest bedroom.

nodes.stake: The dining hall is a testament to Veridia's excess, featuring a long table set with tarnished silver.
nodes.page: The dining hall is a testament to Veridia's excess, featuring a long table set with tarnished silver. Crystal chandeliers tinkle softly overhead, disturbed by the draft you let in. Sable moves along the walls, checking the heavy velvet drapes for hidden alcoves. You spot a discarded ledger on the table, its pages filled with shipping manifests for the Exchange. A set of double doors leads back to the main foyer.

nodes.stake: You step forward, ignoring Valerius's sneer, and demand the iron token required for the vault.
nodes.page: You step forward, ignoring Valerius's sneer, and demand the iron token required for the vault. He chuckles, brushing a speck of dust from his tailored velvet coat. He claims the token was moved this morning, secured in a place you will never breach. Sable's hand drifts toward her belt, her posture shifting into a combat stance. Valerius notices the shift and casually rests his hand on a bell rope.

nodes.stake: You ignore Valerius's remarks about the boots and press him for information regarding Sable's missing brother.
nodes.page: You ignore Valerius's remarks about the boots and press him for information regarding Sable's missing brother. Valerius's smile fades, replaced by a cold, calculating stare that betrays no emotion. He admits that he saw the boy at the press docks three days ago, loading crates of illicit ink. Sable steps forward, demanding to know where the ship was bound. Valerius merely shrugs, claiming that such details are above his pay grade.

exits.label: Press him for the ship's name
Search his desk for shipping logs

nodes.stake: The iron ladder is brittle with rust, flaking red dust onto your hands as you climb.
nodes.page: The iron ladder is brittle with rust, flaking red dust onto your hands as you climb. You haul yourself onto the slate tiles of the roof, the wind threatening to push you over the edge. Sable follows effortlessly, her balance perfect despite the treacherous incline. From here, you can see the imposing structure of the tailor's guild hall just two streets over. A narrow wooden plank bridges the gap between this roof and the neighboring warehouse.

nodes.stake: The conservatory is suffocatingly humid, filled with exotic ferns and blooming orchids.
nodes.page: The conservatory is suffocatingly humid, filled with exotic ferns and blooming orchids. Glass panes rattle under the force of the coastal wind outside. Sable examines a rare blue lotus, her fingers delicately tracing its petals. Hidden among the foliage is a small marble pedestal bearing a heavy iron seal. The seal bears the crest of the foundry, confirming your suspicions about the manor's owner.

nodes.stake: You ignore the study for a moment, searching the shadows of the alcove behind the servant.
nodes.page: You ignore the study for a moment, searching the shadows of the alcove behind the servant. Tucked beneath a loose floorboard, you find a small, bloodstained pouch. Inside rests a heavy iron token, the metal cold and scored with deep scratches. Sable nods in approval, recognizing it as a vault key used by the Exchange guards. The servant whimpers, begging you to take the token and leave him out of it.

nodes.stake: You lean over the desk, scrutinizing the intricate gears embedded in the book's spine.
nodes.page: You lean over the desk, scrutinizing the intricate gears embedded in the book's spine. The ticking grows louder, vibrating through the mahogany wood and into your fingertips. Sable warns you to step back, recognizing the scent of volatile alchemical powder. You carefully pry the cover open with the edge of a letter opener. Inside, the pages have been hollowed out to house a complex copper timing mechanism.

nodes.stake: You leave the ticking book alone and rapidly pull open the heavy desk drawers.
nodes.page: You leave the ticking book alone and rapidly pull open the heavy desk drawers. The top drawer yields nothing but dried inkwells and cracked quills. In the bottom drawer, you uncover a stack of letters bearing the wax seal of the opera house. Sable snatches one up, quickly scanning the contents before cursing under her breath. The letters detail a massive payoff scheduled for this evening at the harbor.

nodes.stake: You kick open the dumbwaiter hatch and tumble into a pristine guest bedroom.
nodes.page: You kick open the dumbwaiter hatch and tumble into a pristine guest bedroom. The bed is perfectly made, though a faint layer of dust suggests it hasn't been used in months. Sable emerges gracefully behind you, immediately checking the hallway door for locks. A large wardrobe stands against the far wall, its doors slightly ajar. You hear heavy footsteps marching down the hallway outside.

nodes.stake: You pry a loose wooden panel from the back of the dumbwaiter shaft, revealing a narrow crawlspace.
nodes.page: You pry a loose wooden panel from the back of the dumbwaiter shaft, revealing a narrow crawlspace. You squeeze inside, dragging yourself through the darkness while Sable follows closely. The space is filled with dust and spiderwebs, but it provides a clear route between the walls. You peer through a crack in the plaster, looking directly down into the main foyer. A squad of city guards is currently interrogating the head butler.

exits.label: Keep crawling toward the rear wing

nodes.stake: You flip through the ledger, tracing lines of ink detailing shipments of silk and raw iron.
nodes.page: You flip through the ledger, tracing lines of ink detailing shipments of silk and raw iron. One entry catches your eye, noting a massive transfer of funds directly to the vault. Sable points out a discrepancy in the dates, suggesting the transfer is happening right now. A loud crash from the adjoining kitchen startles you both. You snap the ledger shut, ready to move.

nodes.stake: The main foyer is a grand, sweeping space with a marble staircase curving up to the second floor.
nodes.page: The main foyer is a grand, sweeping space with a marble staircase curving up to the second floor. Gas lamps cast long shadows across the checkered floor, illuminating a pair of towering mahogany doors. Rigg stands by the entrance, casually tossing a copper coin in his hand. He stops mid-toss, his eyes locking onto you before drifting over to Sable. He gives her a slow, mocking salute, clearly recognizing her from the harbor incident.

nodes.stake: You step into Valerius's personal space, lowering your voice to a dangerous whisper.
nodes.page: You step into Valerius's personal space, lowering your voice to a dangerous whisper. You detail exactly what will happen to his pristine sanctuary if he pulls that bell rope. Sable cracks her knuckles, the sharp sound echoing loudly in the quiet room. Valerius pales, his hand slowly dropping away from the crimson cord. He mutters a curse and points toward a hidden wall safe behind a tapestry.

nodes.stake: You back away slowly, offering Valerius a cut of the profits if he hands over the token.
nodes.page: You back away slowly, offering Valerius a cut of the profits if he hands over the token. He scoffs, swirling his amber drink as he considers the proposition. He names a price that would bankrupt a small merchant guild, his eyes gleaming with greed. Sable shakes her head, clearly disgusted by the attempt at negotiation. Valerius taps his glass against the windowpane, demanding an immediate answer.

nodes.stake: You refuse to let the matter drop, stepping closer to demand the name of the ship.
nodes.page: You refuse to let the matter drop, stepping closer to demand the name of the ship. Valerius sighs, clearly annoyed that his evasion tactics have failed. He admits the vessel was called the *the old syndicate*, an unregistered freighter. Sable memorizes the name, her expression hardening into a mask of pure determination. Valerius warns you that asking too many questions about that ship will get you killed.

nodes.stake: You shove past Valerius, ignoring his protests as you tear into the neatly organized desk.
nodes.page: You shove past Valerius, ignoring his protests as you tear into the neatly organized desk. Papers flutter to the floor as you search for any mention of the *the old syndicate*. Sable stands between you and Valerius, ensuring he doesn't attempt anything foolish. You find a crumpled shipping manifest indicating the vessel is docked at the eastern pier. You secure the document in your coat, having found what you need.

nodes.stake: You test the wooden plank with your boot, finding it remarkably sturdy despite its weathered appearance.
nodes.page: You test the wooden plank with your boot, finding it remarkably sturdy despite its weathered appearance. You cross carefully, the wind threatening to throw off your balance with every step. Sable glides across behind you, her movements fluid and utterly silent. You reach the neighboring warehouse roof, landing softly on a patch of mossy shingles. A skylight offers a clear view into the building's interior.

nodes.stake: You move along the edge of the roof, scouting the upper windows of the warehouse.
nodes.page: You move along the edge of the roof, scouting the upper windows of the warehouse. The glass is thick with grime, but you can make out the faint glow of lantern light inside. Sable points to a rusted latch on one of the windows, indicating it might be forced open. You pull a prybar from your coat, sliding it under the iron frame. With a sharp crack, the window pops open.

nodes.stake: You snatch the heavy iron seal from the pedestal, feeling its dense weight in your palm.
nodes.page: You snatch the heavy iron seal from the pedestal, feeling its dense weight in your palm. The metal is cold, deeply engraved with the crossed hammers of the foundry. Sable nods, acknowledging that this piece will grant you access to the lower levels. As you pocket the object, a mechanical click echoes from the base of the pedestal. The glass doors of the conservatory suddenly slide shut, locking you inside.

nodes.stake: You decide the iron seal is too obvious a trap and leave it untouched on the pedestal.
nodes.page: You decide the iron seal is too obvious a trap and leave it untouched on the pedestal. You turn back toward the hallway, eager to leave the stifling humidity of the conservatory. Sable pushes the glass door open, stepping out into the cool, dusty air of the manor. As you exit, you hear a group of armed guards marching down the adjacent corridor. You need to find cover immediately.

nodes.stake: You scoop up the iron token, brushing a layer of dried dirt from its surface.
