nodes.page: You pull your weapon and fire twice at the shifting shadow, the muzzle flash blinding you for a split second in the gloom. The shots crack loudly against the stone, but you hear no cry of pain, only the distant tolling of a buoy. The shadow was a decoy, a heavy woolen coat draped over a weather vane to draw your fire. Now she knows exactly what caliber you are carrying and where you are pinned.

exits.label: Leap the gap to the neighboring roof

nodes.stake: You drag yourself onto the flat, tarred roof of the Veridia daily press building, keeping low to the surface.
nodes.page: You drag yourself onto the flat, tarred roof of the Veridia daily press building, keeping low to the surface. The rhythmic thumping of the printing machines below vibrates through the soles of your boots. Large ventilation exhausts pump warm, inky air into the storm, creating thick plumes of white vapor. This fog provides excellent visual cover, obscuring both you and your hunter.

exits.label: Crawl into the thickest vapor cloud

nodes.stake: You inch along the dusty rafters, careful not to dislodge a century of accumulated grime.
nodes.page: You inch along the dusty rafters, careful not to dislodge a century of accumulated grime. The service shaft presents itself as a narrow brick chimney plunging into the depths of the Exchange. A thick, grease-coated iron ladder descends into the darkness, smelling faintly of sulfur. You hear the distinct, rhythmic clicking of a mechanized winch somewhere far below.

exits.label: Drop a flare down the shaft

nodes.stake: You swing down from the beam, dropping heavily onto a mahogany trading desk and scattering old inkwells.
nodes.page: You swing down from the beam, dropping heavily onto a mahogany trading desk and scattering old inkwells. The trading floor is a vast chamber of shadows, with moonlight cutting sharp geometric patterns across the marble tiles. You move between the teller cages, utilizing the heavy brass bars for cover against any plunging fire from the ceiling. A single, pristine white envelope rests on the central podium, glowing faintly in the dim light.

exits.label: Flank the podium from the shadows

nodes.stake: You ease down the corridor, your hand hovering near your holster as the temperature drops.
nodes.page: You ease down the corridor, your hand hovering near your holster as the temperature drops. The mechanical room hums with the low vibration of the building’s heating system, obscuring any subtle footsteps. You spot a heavy canvas bag shoved hastily behind a boiler, its buckles completely undone. Inside, a collection of local surveyor maps spills out, covered in furious red annotations.

exits.label: Leave the bag and check the perimeter

nodes.stake: You kneel by the rusted grate, peering through the iron slats into a dark sub-floor.
nodes.page: You kneel by the rusted grate, peering through the iron slats into a dark sub-floor. A small, waterproofed canvas pouch is wedged tightly against the brickwork, just out of arm's reach. You use the barrel of your weapon to carefully hook the strap and drag it through the opening. Inside is a detailed architectural diagram of the city's underground art tunnels, previously guarded by the painter.

exits.label: Leave the diagram and stand up

nodes.stake: You drive your heel into the door, bursting it open and rushing into the adjacent stairwell with your weapon raised.
nodes.page: You drive your heel into the door, bursting it open and rushing into the adjacent stairwell with your weapon raised. The noise is deafening, echoing up the spiral concrete shaft and ruining any element of surprise. You catch a glimpse of a black boot disappearing around the landing three floors above you. The chase transitions from a silent stalk to a desperate vertical sprint.

exits.label: Sprint up the stairs after her
Rig the bottom of the stairs with a tripwire

nodes.stake: You pull yourself higher, wedging your boots into the intricate folds of the colossus's bronze drapery.
nodes.page: You pull yourself higher, wedging your boots into the intricate folds of the colossus's bronze drapery. The wind here is ferocious, threatening to peel you off the metal and send you plummeting to the docks. Reaching the observation deck inside the statue's hollow torch, you find a small, recently abandoned sniper nest. The brass is still warm, and a hastily discarded warrant for her brother's arrest lies pinned under a sandbag.

exits.label: Scan the rooftops through the torch grating

nodes.stake: You inspect the frayed edges of the heavy hemp rope, noting the clean slice of a serrated knife beneath the rough outer fibers.
nodes.page: You inspect the frayed edges of the heavy hemp rope, noting the clean slice of a serrated knife beneath the rough outer fibers. This was not a random act of vandalism, but a precisely calculated deadfall trap waiting for a trigger. Following the remaining tension line with your eyes, you see it leads directly to the catwalk’s primary support bracket. If you step forward, the entire structure will tear itself away from the ceiling.

exits.label: Carefully back away from the trap
Try to disarm the tension line

nodes.stake: You skirt the edge of the rigging, making your way to the enclosed lighting booth suspended over the rear stalls.
nodes.page: You skirt the edge of the rigging, making your way to the enclosed lighting booth suspended over the rear stalls. The booth’s heavy glass door is ajar, and the interior reeks of burnt tobacco and stale coffee. A massive, antique spotlight dominates the room, its heavy arc-lamp currently powered down but warm to the touch. She was here recently, using the booth as an observation post to watch the stage doors.

exits.label: Turn on the grand spotlight to blind the catwalk
Search the booth for discarded intel

nodes.stake: You snatch the paper from the barrel, shaking off the rainwater to read the smudged ink.
nodes.page: You snatch the paper from the barrel, shaking off the rainwater to read the smudged ink. It is a crude receipt from the city's foremost portrait painter, detailing the sale of a comprehensive subterranean map. The painter already sold her a map to the lower vault access, meaning she isn't just hunting you—she's beating you to the objective. You crush the receipt in your fist, realizing the rules of engagement just escalated.

exits.label: Seek out the painter for answers

nodes.stake: You ignore the bait and press forward, hugging the damp brick wall as you reach the busy thoroughfare.
nodes.page: You ignore the bait and press forward, hugging the damp brick wall as you reach the busy thoroughfare. Even in the rain, nocturnal carriages and masked pedestrians move beneath the flickering gas lamps. Slipping into the crowd, you use the civilian traffic as a shield against any long-range optics. You need to reach the financial district before she can establish a new firing angle over the square.

nodes.stake: You scramble backward, your gloves tearing against the rough slate as you retreat over the roof's peak.
nodes.page: You scramble backward, your gloves tearing against the rough slate as you retreat over the roof's peak. Putting a solid mass of stone between yourself and her angle gives you a momentary reprieve to catch your breath. The rain washes away the chalk dust on your hands, leaving them numb and shaking slightly from the adrenaline. You must find a subterranean route if you want to strip away her high-ground advantage.

exits.label: Look for a basement access hatch
Return to the parapet to search for a trail

nodes.stake: You take a running start, your boots slipping wildly before you launch yourself across the terrifying gap between the buildings.
nodes.page: You take a running start, your boots slipping wildly before you launch yourself across the terrifying gap between the buildings. For a breathless second, you hang suspended above the deadly drop to the cobblestones. You crash painfully into the adjacent slates, bruising your ribs but managing to secure a grip on a heavy gargoyle. The new roof offers fresh angles and a much sturdier profile against the incoming storm.

nodes.stake: You slither on your stomach into the thickest part of the warm, suffocating vapor venting from the press room.
nodes.page: You slither on your stomach into the thickest part of the warm, suffocating vapor venting from the press room. The smell of ink and hot metal is overpowering, forcing you to take shallow, measured breaths. Inside the cloud, visibility is reduced to absolutely zero, rendering her scope completely useless for the time being. However, it also means you cannot see if she is silently approaching you with a drawn blade.

nodes.stake: You skirt the edge of the vapor plumes and yank open the heavy steel door to the emergency stairwell.
nodes.page: You skirt the edge of the vapor plumes and yank open the heavy steel door to the emergency stairwell. The interior is brightly lit by flickering fluorescent tubes, making you wince after spending so much time in the dark storm. The stairs spiral downward, offering a direct, covered route into the heart of the press building. As you step inside, you notice wet footprints leading down, the tread matching standard mercenary issue.

nodes.stake: You mount the iron ladder, descending rung by rung into the oppressive heat of the service shaft.
nodes.page: You mount the iron ladder, descending rung by rung into the oppressive heat of the service shaft. The clicking of the winch grows louder, echoing menacingly off the tight brick walls. Halfway down, you spot a bundle of heavy explosives wired directly to the ladder's support brackets, the red light blinking rhythmically. The trap is live, and climbing back up will take too much time before the timer runs out.

exits.label: Jump down to the passing winch cable

nodes.stake: You crack a chemical flare and drop it down the shaft, watching the brilliant red light illuminate the plunging depths.
nodes.page: You crack a chemical flare and drop it down the shaft, watching the brilliant red light illuminate the plunging depths. The flare falls for a long time, revealing smooth brickwork and thick steel pipes dripping with condensation. Finally, it strikes a metal grating at the bottom, illuminating a figure standing perfectly still in the scarlet glare. She looks straight up at you, raises a hand in a mock salute, and steps back into the shadows.

exits.label: Slide down the ladder in pursuit

nodes.stake: You tear open the pristine envelope, finding a crisp, heavy-stock letterhead from the Veridia Magistrates.
nodes.page: You tear open the pristine envelope, finding a crisp, heavy-stock letterhead from the Veridia Magistrates. It is the official arrest warrant for her brother, signed, stamped, and completely unredacted. She left this here to let you know her motivations have shifted from simple contract killing to a desperate blood feud. By touching the paper, you leave a clear fingerprint of your involvement on the tragic document.

nodes.stake: You ignore the envelope, suspecting a trap, and melt into the deep shadows flanking the podium.
nodes.page: You ignore the envelope, suspecting a trap, and melt into the deep shadows flanking the podium. Moving silently between the teller cages, you scan the high balconies that overlook the trading floor. A sudden glint of light from the southern mezzanine catches your eye, a momentary reflection off a polished lens. You raise your weapon, resting the barrel on a brass rail to steady your aim in the dark.

exits.label: Take a shot at the reflection

nodes.stake: You sift through the annotated surveyor maps, deciphering the frantic red lines connecting the harbor to the financial district.
nodes.page: You sift through the annotated surveyor maps, deciphering the frantic red lines connecting the harbor to the financial district. The routes highlight ancient sewer mains and forgotten pneumatic tube networks that bypass the city's modern security grids. A specific intersection near the central bank is circled heavily, marked with the phrase "Breach Point." You realize she isn't just trying to kill you; she's using you as a distraction to rob the main vault.

exits.label: Head immediately for the Breach Point
Try to memorize the secondary routes first
Move to intercept her in the ledger room

nodes.stake: You leave the bag undisturbed and sweep the perimeter of the mechanical room, checking behind every massive iron boiler.
nodes.page: You leave the bag undisturbed and sweep the perimeter of the mechanical room, checking behind every massive iron boiler. The air is stifling, and sweat begins to prickle under your heavy collar. In the furthest corner, a heavy iron grating has been removed from the wall, exposing a dark, narrow crawlspace. The edges of the tunnel are marked with fresh yellow chalk, practically screaming an invitation.

nodes.stake: You release the strap and stand up, deciding the waterproof pouch is too obvious of a snare to risk your arm for.
nodes.page: You release the strap and stand up, deciding the waterproof pouch is too obvious of a snare to risk your arm for. The moment you step back, a heavy steel spike slams down through the grate, embedding itself deep into the floorboards. Your caution just saved you from being pinned to the ground like a specimen on a mounting board. You adjust your coat and proceed down the corridor, hyper-aware of the floor beneath you.

exits.label: Check the ceiling for similar traps

nodes.stake: You take the concrete stairs three at a time, your lungs burning as you sprint upward in a desperate pursuit.
nodes.page: You take the concrete stairs three at a time, your lungs burning as you sprint upward in a desperate pursuit. The sound of her heavy boots echoes chaotically, making it impossible to gauge the exact distance between you. Reaching the fourth-floor landing, you round the corner just in time to see the roof access door slam shut. You hit the door with your shoulder, ready to burst out into the storm.

exits.label: Stop and check the handle for explosives

nodes.stake: You halt your pursuit, pulling a spool of fine monofilament wire from your tactical belt.
nodes.page: You halt your pursuit, pulling a spool of fine monofilament wire from your tactical belt. Working quickly in the dim stairwell, you string a nearly invisible tripwire across the bottom steps, securing it to the heavy railing. If she doubles back to flank you, the wire will alert you and snap her ankles in the process. Satisfied with your handiwork, you draw your weapon and wait in the shadows of the doorway.

nodes.stake: You flatten the damp warrant against the bronze wall of the torch, reading the dense legal text detailing charges of treason and sedition.
nodes.page: You flatten the damp warrant against the bronze wall of the torch, reading the dense legal text detailing charges of treason and sedition. The signature at the bottom belongs to the Chief Magistrate, a man known for his merciless sentencing. This confirms that her brother is likely facing execution, explaining her sudden, reckless shift in tactics tonight. The paper is heavy with implications, turning a simple shadow war into a desperate rescue operation.

exits.label: Fold the paper and secure it

nodes.stake: You peer through the heavy bronze grating of the torch, scanning the sprawling slate roofs of Veridia below.
nodes.page: You peer through the heavy bronze grating of the torch, scanning the sprawling slate roofs of Veridia below. The city is a patchwork of dark shadows and slick, rain-washed surfaces illuminated by sporadic lightning. You notice a rhythmic, flashing light emanating from the upper windows of the Exchange building, a signal mirror cutting through the storm. She is communicating with a partner, or perhaps trying to draw your eye to a specific window.

nodes.stake: You slowly transfer your weight backward, easing away from the compromised section of the catwalk with agonizing precision.
nodes.page: You slowly transfer your weight backward, easing away from the compromised section of the catwalk with agonizing precision. Every creak of the floorboards sounds like a cannon shot in the silent, empty theater. Once you are clear, you trace a secondary path along the reinforced steel girders that support the heavy velvet curtains. The detour will take longer, but it keeps you entirely off the sabotaged wooden riggings.

nodes.stake: You draw a small pair of wire snips and carefully approach the tensioned cord connecting the deadfall.
nodes.page: You draw a small pair of wire snips and carefully approach the tensioned cord connecting the deadfall. The line vibrates slightly, humming like a plucked guitar string beneath your fingers. You pinch the cord tightly, applying pressure to keep the mechanism from snapping back, and slice cleanly through the fibers. The catwalk groans as the weight resettles, but the structure holds firm beneath your boots.

nodes.stake: You slam your hand down on the heavy breaker switch, surging power into the massive antique spotlight.
nodes.page: You slam your hand down on the heavy breaker switch, surging power into the massive antique spotlight. The arc-lamp sputters violently before exploding into a blinding, pure white beam that cuts across the darkness of the rafters. You hear a sharp curse from the catwalks above as the intense light ruins her night vision and exposes her position. For the next few seconds, she is completely blind, granting you a critical window of opportunity.

exits.label: Draw your weapon and fire into the light

nodes.stake: You leave the spotlight alone and conduct a rapid, thorough search of the cramped booth.
nodes.page: You leave the spotlight alone and conduct a rapid, thorough search of the cramped booth. Beneath a pile of discarded schematics, you uncover a heavy brass capsule identical to the one you found earlier. Twisting it open, you find a small, intricate brass key engraved with the crest of the Veridia Central Bank. This is the key to the ledger room, proving she already has access to the most secure vault in the city.

exits.label: Take the key and head for the bank
Leave the key as a sign you were here

nodes.stake: You sprint down the slick cobblestones, weaving through narrow alleys to reach the eccentric painter's studio.
nodes.page: You sprint down the slick cobblestones, weaving through narrow alleys to reach the eccentric painter's studio. The door is already ajar, swinging lazily on its hinges, and the smell of fresh oil paint and copper fills the air. Inside, canvases are slashed, and the painter is bound to a chair, thoroughly bruised but alive. He looks up at you with a mix of terror and relief, his mouth taped shut with heavy canvas strips.

exits.label: Remove the tape to question him

nodes.stake: You find the first chalk bids slashed across the slate tiles of the Exchange roofs.
nodes.page: You find the first chalk bids slashed across the slate tiles of the Exchange roofs. The noble houses are already treating her like a prized hound, bidding for the Rival’s services while she hunts you through Veridia. You trace the powdery white lines, reading the staggering sums offered for your elimination. Valerius clearly started the bidding war, his signature crest hastily drawn next to a small fortune in gold. The numbers only climb higher as you move across the slanted roof towards the chimney stacks.

exits.label: Look for the missing gaol page

nodes.stake: Among the spiraling sums of the noble houses, one mark stands out near the gutter.
nodes.page: Among the spiraling sums of the noble houses, one mark stands out near the gutter. It is not a house crest at all, just a jagged, eyeless serpent curled around a silver coin. You recognize the street-slang symbol for an independent broker who deals in absolute silence. Whoever placed this bid wants the Rival to bring you in alive, overriding the death warrants. The rain begins to smear the chalk, forcing you to memorize the exact shape of the serpent.

nodes.stake: Rigg’s missing gaol page has to be connected to her sudden release.
nodes.page: Rigg’s missing gaol page has to be connected to her sudden release. You slip down toward the press district, weaving between the heavy iron exhaust vents of the printing houses. If Valerius paid for her freedom, the transaction would require a specialized notary to wipe the registry clean. The smell of ink and hot copper fills the alley as you approach a known document forger's stoop. A scrap of official parchment is pinned to the door with a rusted nail.

nodes.stake: You follow a trail of serpent marks down from the Exchange roofs and into the shadows of the tailor’s district.
nodes.page: You follow a trail of serpent marks down from the Exchange roofs and into the shadows of the tailor’s district. The wealthy sleep soundly here behind velvet curtains, oblivious to the shadow war playing out in their alleys. You spot another chalk serpent etched onto the brickwork of a boutique that specializes in reinforced silk armor. The door is slightly ajar, the lock cleanly picked with professional precision. She might already be inside, outfitting herself with the broker's funding.

nodes.stake: Dropping to the lower roofs, you find more terms laid out in writing on scattered broadsheets.
nodes.page: Dropping to the lower roofs, you find more terms laid out in writing on scattered broadsheets. The houses are getting desperate, offering estates, titles, and immunity to whoever claims the kill. You grab a fluttering sheet before it blows into the street, scanning the dense legal script at the bottom. The terms specify that your signet ring must be delivered to the vault beneath the opera house. It is a terrifyingly public venue for such a dark exchange.

nodes.stake: The parchment is a torn corner of the missing gaol ledger, bearing the undeniable seal of the warden.
nodes.page: The parchment is a torn corner of the missing gaol ledger, bearing the undeniable seal of the warden. It confirms that the Rival was not simply released, but entirely expunged from the prison’s history. Below the seal, someone has scribbled a meeting time and the coordinates for the harbor colossus. Valerius wouldn't leave such sloppy evidence unless he wanted you to find it. This is a deliberate breadcrumb, designed to pull you away from the safety of the upper wards.

exits.label: Ignore the trap and seek the Rival

nodes.stake: You shove the door open, snapping the fragile locking mechanism with a sharp thrust of your shoulder.
nodes.page: You shove the door open, snapping the fragile locking mechanism with a sharp thrust of your shoulder. The forger's workshop is a disaster of overturned tables, spilled acid, and scattered ledgers. The Rival was already here, violently securing the silence of the only man who knew who bought her contract. You find the forger tied to a chair, trembling and pointing a bloody finger toward the foundry district. She left him alive just to deliver a message.

nodes.stake: You slide through the boutique door, stepping carefully to avoid the shattered glass on the hardwood floor.
nodes.page: You slide through the boutique door, stepping carefully to avoid the shattered glass on the hardwood floor. Racks of expensive, ballistic-weave coats have been shoved aside in a frantic search for something specific. You find a receipt impaled on a tailor's shear, detailing the purchase of a lightweight kinetic dampener. The purchase was made with a blank promissory note, signed only with the serpent mark. The Rival is gearing up to face you head-on.

nodes.stake: The opera house looms in the distance, its gilded dome reflecting the scattered moonlight of Veridia.
nodes.page: The opera house looms in the distance, its gilded dome reflecting the scattered moonlight of Veridia. You stick to the shadow of the gargoyles, knowing every mercenary in the city is likely watching the main thoroughfares. If the terms require your ring to be delivered to the vault, the buyer must be waiting there to verify the kill. You reach the ornate roof of the theater, feeling the vibration of the orchestra playing far below. The glass skylight above the vault access is unlocked.

nodes.stake: The harbor colossus stands ankle-deep in the churning tide, a massive bronze sentinel holding a dormant lighthouse beacon.
nodes.page: The harbor colossus stands ankle-deep in the churning tide, a massive bronze sentinel holding a dormant lighthouse beacon. You scale the damp scaffolding wrapping its left leg, the salty wind tearing at your coat. The chalk bids are written on the bronze itself here, enormous numbers scrawled across the statue's shin. Someone has rigged a series of tripwires across the access ladders leading to the beacon. You pause, analyzing the tension in the razor-thin cables.

nodes.stake: You refuse to play Valerius’s game, turning your back on the harbor and heading deeper into the commercial ward.
nodes.page: You refuse to play Valerius’s game, turning your back on the harbor and heading deeper into the commercial ward. The Rival won't wait at a predetermined trap; she is a hunter who prefers the momentum of the chase. You find fresh boot prints in the ash near the towering ventilation shafts of the underground rail. She is tracking your scent, closing the distance while the houses blindly throw money at her shadow. You draw your weapon and step into the steam vent.

exits.label: Push through to the faction territory

nodes.stake: The forger gasps for air, terrified of the blade you hold loosely at your side.
nodes.page: The forger gasps for air, terrified of the blade you hold loosely at your side. He confesses that the gaol page was purchased not by Valerius, but by a proxy representing the serpent mark. The terms in writing demanded that the Rival clear all her previous debts before accepting the new contract. She took the ledger page to destroy the only leverage the warden had left over her. You cut his bonds, leaving him to vanish into the Veridia underworld.

exits.label: Track her path toward the tower

nodes.stake: The foundry district glows with a dull, rhythmic orange light as massive hammers shape steel for the Exchange.
nodes.page: The foundry district glows with a dull, rhythmic orange light as massive hammers shape steel for the Exchange. You navigate the catwalks, the heat pressing against your skin and masking your thermal signature. More chalk marks are scrawled on the cooling vats, the bids now crossing into outright treason against the crown. The Rival knows you need to pass through here to reach the upper wards. You spot a figure moving gracefully across the suspended crane tracks.

exits.label: Pursue the figure on the tracks

nodes.stake: The boutique’s back room smells of ozone and burnt fabric, the remnants of a hastily modified power source.
nodes.page: The boutique’s back room smells of ozone and burnt fabric, the remnants of a hastily modified power source. She tore apart a high-end loom to extract the industrial tension coils, likely for a custom snare trap. A map of Veridia is spread across a cutting table, with the opera house circled in thick, black grease pencil. She isn't just hunting you; she's planning a public execution to satisfy the highest bidder. You fold the map and tuck it into your jacket.

nodes.stake: You slip through the skylight, landing silently on the velvet-lined rafters high above the vault entrance.
nodes.page: You slip through the skylight, landing silently on the velvet-lined rafters high above the vault entrance. The music swells, masking the sound of your boots as you traverse the narrow wooden beams. Below, a representative of House Valerius stands nervously clutching a leather satchel overflowing with promissory notes. He is waiting for the Rival to deliver your ring, completely unaware that he is standing on a pressure plate. She has rigged the vault to collapse the moment the transaction is complete.

exits.label: Wait for the Rival to strike

nodes.stake: Circling the gilded dome, you find the sniper's nest she abandoned just moments ago.
nodes.page: Circling the gilded dome, you find the sniper's nest she abandoned just moments ago. The brass casings of custom armor-piercing rounds are scattered across the slate tiles, still warm to the touch. She wasn't aiming at the streets; the trajectory points directly toward the high windows of the central tower. The bidding war was a distraction to mask her true target in the upper echelons. You look toward the tower just as a localized power failure darkens its upper floors.

exits.label: Wait for the eclipse to start

nodes.stake: You carefully slide your blade under the lowest tripwire, severing the tension mechanism without triggering the explosive relay.
nodes.page: You carefully slide your blade under the lowest tripwire, severing the tension mechanism without triggering the explosive relay. The traps are crude but effective, designed to stall you rather than kill you outright. As you clear the final wire, you notice the serpent mark etched into the bronze casing of the detonator. She didn't set these; the broker's proxy is protecting the high ground. You pull yourself over the lip of the beacon platform, stepping into the howling wind.

exits.label: Confront the proxy on the platform
Scan the harbor for the Rival

nodes.stake: You abandon the ladder, choosing to scale the sheer, riveted bronze plates of the colossus’s thigh.
nodes.page: You abandon the ladder, choosing to scale the sheer, riveted bronze plates of the colossus’s thigh. Your fingertips ache as you find purchase in the oxidized grooves, pulling yourself up inch by agonizing inch. The wind threatens to tear you from the statue, but you manage to bypass the rigged scaffolding entirely. You haul yourself onto the beacon's lower maintenance deck, completely undetected by whoever is waiting above. A shadow moves against the dull light of the dormant lamp.

nodes.stake: The heavy steam masks your silhouette as you press your back against the scalding iron of the vent housing.
nodes.page: The heavy steam masks your silhouette as you press your back against the scalding iron of the vent housing. You hear the soft, rhythmic click of her boots on the grate, precise and utterly without hesitation. She whispers your name, the sound carrying an eerie, metallic echo through the underground corridor. A silver blade slices through the fog mere inches from your throat, forcing you into a desperate backward roll. The hunt has finally caught up to you.

nodes.stake: The central tower looms over the city, its darkened windows reflecting the chaotic glow of the streets below.
nodes.page: The central tower looms over the city, its darkened windows reflecting the chaotic glow of the streets below. You scale the exterior service elevator shaft, bypassing the locked security gates on the lower levels. The chalk bids are painted on the glass here in blood, a gruesome escalation from the powdery marks on the Exchange. You pry open the elevator doors on the fiftieth floor, stepping into a ruined administrative office. The air is thick with the smell of discharged energy weapons.

nodes.stake: You sprint across the suspended crane tracks, your boots ringing against the heavy steel girders.
nodes.page: You sprint across the suspended crane tracks, your boots ringing against the heavy steel girders. The figure ahead of you doesn't panic, maintaining a fluid, measured pace that screams of professional training. As you close the distance, the figure turns, revealing the serpent mark painted across a blank ballistic mask. It is a decoy, meant to lure you onto the unstable section of the track. The metal groans ominously beneath your feet as the support bolts begin to shear.

nodes.stake: You drop a shattered piece of slate onto the marble floor, the sharp crack echoing through the silent vault chamber.
nodes.page: You drop a shattered piece of slate onto the marble floor, the sharp crack echoing through the silent vault chamber. The Valerius representative jumps, dropping the satchel of notes and stepping off the pressure plate in his panic. A deafening metallic click echoes from the walls, but the primary explosive charge fails to detonate without the continuous weight. The Rival curses from the shadows, her perfectly timed execution ruined by a falling stone. She steps into the dim light, drawing a pair of curved ceramic blades.

nodes.stake: You hold your breath in the rafters, watching cold-bloodedly as the Rival drops from a decorative archway.
nodes.page: You hold your breath in the rafters, watching cold-bloodedly as the Rival drops from a decorative archway. She lands silently behind the representative, her blade flashing once in the dim light of the vault. The man collapses, and she smoothly catches the satchel of promissory notes before it hits the floor. She steps off the pressure plate with perfect timing, letting the vault's automated blast doors slam shut behind her. You now know exactly how fast she can move.

exits.label: Let the eclipse cover her tracks

nodes.stake: You step onto the beacon platform, your weapon drawn and leveled at the cloaked figure standing near the edge.
nodes.page: You step onto the beacon platform, your weapon drawn and leveled at the cloaked figure standing near the edge. The proxy slowly turns, pulling back their hood to reveal a face covered in intricate, ritualistic scarring. They hold up the missing gaol page, the heavy parchment snapping violently in the harbor wind. They offer it to you, speaking in a raspy voice about the serpent's true desires. The broker doesn't want you dead; they want you to take the Rival's place.

nodes.stake: You crouch behind the bronze railing, scanning the sprawling docks and warehouses of Veridia's harbor.
nodes.page: You crouch behind the bronze railing, scanning the sprawling docks and warehouses of Veridia's harbor. Through the rain, you spot a lone figure standing on the roof of the customs house, staring directly back at the colossus. Even at this distance, you can feel the predatory focus radiating from her posture. She holds up a piece of chalk, making a slow, deliberate mark on the chimney beside her. The final bid has been placed, and the auction is closed.

nodes.stake: You parry her initial strike, the clash of metal ringing sharply against the ambient noise of the city.
nodes.page: You parry her initial strike, the clash of metal ringing sharply against the ambient noise of the city. She spins, using the momentum to drive her second blade toward your ribs with terrifying speed. You manage to deflect the blow, but the razor edge slices through your coat, drawing a thin line of blood. She smiles, a cold, calculated expression that shows no trace of the woman she used to be. The bidding war was just an excuse; she enjoys this.

nodes.stake: The office is a labyrinth of shattered glass partitions and overturned mahogany desks.
nodes.page: The office is a labyrinth of shattered glass partitions and overturned mahogany desks. You find the body of a high-ranking magistrate slumped over a communication terminal, his signet ring violently removed. The screen flickers, displaying a finalized transaction routing millions of credits to an untraceable offshore account. She isn't just killing for the bids; she is dismantling the political structure of Veridia one target at a time. A shadow passes over the broken window as the sky begins to darken.

nodes.stake: You dive forward just as the crane track buckles, the heavy steel groaning before collapsing into the vats below.
nodes.page: You dive forward just as the crane track buckles, the heavy steel groaning before collapsing into the vats below. You roll onto a stable maintenance gantry, catching your breath as the decoy escapes into the steam exhaust. A shower of sparks rains down from the severed power cables, illuminating the foundry in harsh, strobing flashes. You have survived the trap, but she now dictates the pace of the engagement. You check your weapon and prepare for the next phase.

nodes.stake: You swing down from the rafters, landing silently on the marble floor near the fallen representative.
nodes.page: You swing down from the rafters, landing silently on the marble floor near the fallen representative. The blast doors are sealed, but you spot a service grate she kicked open to access the ventilation network. You crawl into the narrow shaft, following the scuff marks left by her boots in the decades of accumulated dust. The tunnel begins to angle upward, spiraling toward the upper levels of the opera house. You can hear her breathing just a few yards ahead in the dark.

nodes.stake: You snatch the heavy parchment from the proxy’s scarred hand, the warden's seal cold against your palm.
nodes.page: You snatch the heavy parchment from the proxy’s scarred hand, the warden's seal cold against your palm. The ink confirms everything: the serpent broker bought her debts to use her as a test against you. If you survive tonight, the slate is wiped clean for both of you, permanently. The proxy steps backward off the platform, disappearing into the churning waters of the harbor without a splash. You fold the page, the terms of your survival now clearly defined in writing.

nodes.stake: You linger near the transept, the dead man’s heavy woolen robes scratching against your collar.
nodes.page: You linger near the transept, the dead man’s heavy woolen robes scratching against your collar. A procession of mourners shuffles past the crossing, their heads bowed in silent grief. The incense in the air is thick enough to mask the metallic scent of copper still clinging to your sleeves. A widow in a dark veil pauses, mistaking you for the presiding deacon. She reaches out, seeking a word of comfort.

exits.label: Direct her to the main altar

nodes.stake: You trace the sign of the Umbra over her forehead, murmuring a generic platitude about shadows and peace.
nodes.page: You trace the sign of the Umbra over her forehead, murmuring a generic platitude about shadows and peace. She exhales a trembling breath and presses a cold silver coin into your palm before moving on. The exchange leaves you feeling exposed, your disguise suddenly feeling like a fragile shell. Across the nave, a sharp-eyed verger is watching the interaction with narrowed eyes. He begins to walk in your direction.

exits.label: Slip out through the side chapel
Stand your ground and stare him down

nodes.stake: You keep your eyes lowered and gesture vaguely toward the incense-shrouded altar at the far end of the hall.
nodes.page: You keep your eyes lowered and gesture vaguely toward the incense-shrouded altar at the far end of the hall. The widow nods, though disappointment tightens her features as she rejoins the shuffling line. Your evasion goes unnoticed by the grieving family, but the movement catches the attention of a nearby choir boy. He stares at your boots—scuffed leather, entirely wrong for a man of the cloth.

exits.label: Tuck your feet beneath the hem of your robe
Intimidate the boy with a harsh glare

nodes.stake: The side chapel is draped in velvet and lit only by a handful of sputtering votives.
nodes.page: The side chapel is draped in velvet and lit only by a handful of sputtering votives. You slip behind a marble pillar just as the verger’s heavy footsteps echo past your hiding spot. A small, ornate almsbox sits unattended against the far wall, its iron lock looking surprisingly fragile. The dead man whose clothes you wear left you with an empty coin purse, and the streets of Veridia require capital.

exits.label: Force the lock on the almsbox
Leave the coin and exit to the alley

nodes.stake: You square your shoulders, letting the heavy deacon’s cloak billow slightly as you meet the verger’s gaze.
nodes.page: You square your shoulders, letting the heavy deacon’s cloak billow slightly as you meet the verger’s gaze. Your unwavering stare carries the cold authority of a man accustomed to violence, completely at odds with a humble priest. The verger falters, his suspicion overridden by ingrained subservience. He bows his head and diverts his path toward the sacristy.

exits.label: Follow him to find a secure exit
Turn and head for the cloister doors

nodes.stake: You shuffle backward, letting the oversized hem of the stolen robes pool over your boots.
nodes.page: You shuffle backward, letting the oversized hem of the stolen robes pool over your boots. The choir boy loses interest, distracted by the echoing chant of the main choir starting their dirge. The rhythmic chanting provides excellent cover noise for your movements. You need to put distance between yourself and the congregation before the real deacon is discovered missing.

exits.label: Move toward the livery yard exit
Blend into the procession leaving the nave

nodes.stake: You lock eyes with the boy and let your expression harden into a mask of pure malice.
nodes.page: You lock eyes with the boy and let your expression harden into a mask of pure malice. He pales instantly, taking a stumbling step backward and knocking over a brass candle stand. The clatter draws the attention of half the mourners in the nave. Taking advantage of the chaos, you turn and stride swiftly toward the nearest archway.

exits.label: Push through the heavy oak exit doors

nodes.stake: You slide a small lockpick from your sleeve, working the crude iron mechanism of the almsbox.
nodes.page: You slide a small lockpick from your sleeve, working the crude iron mechanism of the almsbox. It gives with a satisfying click, revealing a handful of copper and silver marks. You pocket the coins quickly, the metal clinking softly against your thigh. The sudden wealth will pay for a safer passage, but the theft leaves a trail of evidence.

exits.label: Check the adjoining sacristy for documents

nodes.stake: The heavy doors groan as you push them open, stepping out into the damp chill of the deacon’s district.
nodes.page: The heavy doors groan as you push them open, stepping out into the damp chill of the deacon’s district. Fog rolls through the cobblestone streets, clinging to the iron gas lamps that line the thoroughfare. A pair of city watchmen stand near the corner, idly chatting while they warm their hands over a brazier. Your stolen robes afford you some camouflage, but only if you play the part.

exits.label: Approach them and offer a blessing
Cross the street to avoid them entirely

nodes.stake: The sacristy is a low-ceilinged room smelling of old parchment and dried lavender.
nodes.page: The sacristy is a low-ceilinged room smelling of old parchment and dried lavender. Heavy ledger books are stacked on a mahogany desk, recording the names of those scheduled for rites today. You spot the dead man’s name inked neatly on the open page, scheduled for a funeral service that already began. Ripping the page out will buy you a few more hours of cover.

exits.label: Tear the page from the ledger
Leave it and search the wardrobe

nodes.stake: The cloister doors lead to a covered walkway wrapped around a manicured courtyard.
nodes.page: The cloister doors lead to a covered walkway wrapped around a manicured courtyard. Rain begins to fall, tapping softly against the stone tiles and slicking the grass. A group of novice priests are hurrying across the yard, clutching texts to their chests. One of them waves at you, shouting a greeting in the old tongue.

exits.label: Ignore him and quicken your pace

nodes.stake: You navigate the dim corridors leading toward the back of the grounds.
nodes.page: You navigate the dim corridors leading toward the back of the grounds. The smell of incense fades, replaced by the earthy scent of hay and horse sweat. The livery yard is mostly empty, save for a single stable hand brushing down a massive draft horse. A cart loaded with empty wine casks is being prepped for departure.

exits.label: Bribe the stable hand for a cloak

nodes.stake: You fall into step behind the grieving family as they exit the nave.
nodes.page: You fall into step behind the grieving family as they exit the nave. The slow, rhythmic pace is agonizing, but it provides perfect anonymity among the sobbing crowd. As the procession spills out onto the main plaza, the crowd begins to disperse toward carriages and waiting servants. You are finally free of the church walls, but the city stretches out before you.

nodes.stake: You slip into the dark, cramped space of the confessional and pull the curtain shut.
nodes.page: You slip into the dark, cramped space of the confessional and pull the curtain shut. The heavy wood muffles the sounds of the nave, leaving you in absolute darkness. A moment later, the screen slides open on the other side, and a raspy voice begins to confess a litany of petty thefts. You realize the penitent is one of the local cutpurses.

nodes.stake: You walk directly toward the watchmen, raising a hand in the traditional sign of peace.
nodes.page: You walk directly toward the watchmen, raising a hand in the traditional sign of peace. They straighten up, respectfully tapping their cudgels against their breastplates. You murmur a quick prayer for their safety in the dark streets of Veridia. The older guard nods in appreciation and warns you that a murderer was reported near the opera house.

exits.label: Ask for details about the suspect
Thank them and head toward the harbor

nodes.stake: You pull the cowl of your robe lower and cross the wet cobblestones, keeping your head down.
nodes.page: You pull the cowl of your robe lower and cross the wet cobblestones, keeping your head down. The watchmen barely glance your way, used to the sight of silent clergy moving through the district. You turn into a narrow, twisting alley lined with overflowing refuse bins. The path narrows, leading toward the rear entrance of a familiar tailor shop.

nodes.stake: You carefully tear the heavy parchment from the binding, folding it into your sleeve.
nodes.page: You carefully tear the heavy parchment from the binding, folding it into your sleeve. The missing page leaves a glaring gap in the ledger, but it removes the immediate timeline of your victim. A sudden knock at the sacristy door freezes you in place. A muffled voice calls out, asking if the deacon is ready for the second reading.

nodes.stake: You ignore the ledger and open the heavy oak wardrobe in the corner.
nodes.page: You ignore the ledger and open the heavy oak wardrobe in the corner. Inside hangs a collection of fine vestments, much richer than the plain wool you currently wear. Beneath a velvet stole, you find a heavy iron key stamped with the seal of the Veridia Vault. This changes everything; the dead man was more than just a simple preacher.

exits.label: Search the pockets for a matching lockbox

nodes.stake: You offer a stiff wave, mimicking the casual gesture of a tired superior.
nodes.page: You offer a stiff wave, mimicking the casual gesture of a tired superior. The novice smiles and ducks into a nearby doorway, satisfied with the interaction. The courtyard is now empty, leaving the path to the street clear. You adjust your stolen collar and step out into the bustling thoroughfare.

exits.label: Head down to the harbor colossus

nodes.stake: You ignore the greeting entirely, pulling your cowl tight and marching forward.
nodes.page: You ignore the greeting entirely, pulling your cowl tight and marching forward. The novice halts, looking confused and slightly offended by the snub. He turns and jogs toward the sacristy, likely to report your rude behavior to a superior. Your haste has drawn exactly the kind of attention you meant to avoid.

exits.label: Break into a run for the gates

nodes.stake: You climb silently into the back of the cart, wedging yourself between two large, empty casks.
nodes.page: You climb silently into the back of the cart, wedging yourself between two large, empty casks. The wood smells sharply of cheap red wine, and the space is tight. A few minutes later, the driver cracks his whip, and the cart jolts into motion. You are carried away from the church grounds, rattling over the uneven stones of the city.

exits.label: Roll out into the street mid-transit

nodes.stake: You approach the stable hand, flashing the silver coin you acquired earlier.
nodes.page: You approach the stable hand, flashing the silver coin you acquired earlier. He eyes the heavy deacon's robes, then the coin, completely unfazed by the discrepancy. Without a word, he hands over a heavy, mud-stained drover’s cloak. You throw it over your robes, instantly breaking the distinctive silhouette of a clergyman.

exits.label: Ask him about a safe route out

nodes.stake: The press district smells of lye, hot lead, and cheap coffee.
nodes.page: The press district smells of lye, hot lead, and cheap coffee. Massive printing machines thump in a rhythmic pulse that rattles the windows of the narrow street. Paper boys dart between carts, shouting headlines about the unrest near the Exchange. The chaos of the district is the perfect place for a man to disappear.

exits.label: Buy a paper to check the news

nodes.stake: You navigate the winding streets toward the tailor’s shop, a place you know from a previous life.
nodes.page: You navigate the winding streets toward the tailor’s shop, a place you know from a previous life. The brass bell chimes as you push open the door, the scent of expensive wool and chalk dust greeting you. The tailor, a sharp-eyed man with measuring tape around his neck, looks up. He does not recognize you beneath the hood and the dead man’s clothes.

exits.label: Ask to buy a plain overcoat

nodes.stake: You sit in silence, letting the cutpurse ramble about a botched job near the harbor colossus.
nodes.page: You sit in silence, letting the cutpurse ramble about a botched job near the harbor colossus. He mentions that the guard patrols have been doubled around the Exchange roofs. He also complains about a rival gang hoarding supplies in the old livery yard. This intelligence is far more valuable than the contents of the almsbox.

exits.label: Demand a cut of his stolen goods
Absolve him and leave the booth

nodes.stake: You rap your knuckles against the wooden screen, snapping a harsh command for him to depart.
nodes.page: You rap your knuckles against the wooden screen, snapping a harsh command for him to depart. The cutpurse gasps, alarmed by the aggressive tone from a supposedly gentle confessor. You hear his boots scrambling against the floorboards as he flees the church. The nave is quiet again, but the interruption has cost you precious time.

exits.label: Exit the booth and leave the church
Wait in the booth a moment longer

nodes.stake: The older guard leans in, eager to share the gossip of the night.
nodes.page: The older guard leans in, eager to share the gossip of the night. He describes a suspect matching your exact description, right down to the height and build. They don't know about the stolen robes yet, assuming the killer is still in their original clothes. He advises you to stay clear of the opera district tonight.

exits.label: Thank him and head for the opera anyway
Take his advice and go to the press district

nodes.stake: You murmur a quiet farewell and turn your steps toward the salt-scented air of the harbor.
nodes.page: You murmur a quiet farewell and turn your steps toward the salt-scented air of the harbor. The massive bronze foot of the harbor colossus looms in the distance, a relic of a forgotten war. The docks are crawling with smugglers, sailors, and heavily armed overseers. It is dangerous ground, but the kind of danger you understand.

exits.label: Search for the porter roll station

nodes.stake: You rap your knuckles against the heavy oak back door of the tailor’s shop.
nodes.page: You rap your knuckles against the heavy oak back door of the tailor’s shop. A moment later, the peephole slides open, revealing a suspicious brown eye. You mutter a passphrase from a contact you used months ago. The heavy deadbolts slide back, and you are pulled into the warm, well-lit back room.

exits.label: Ask about the debt you are owed

nodes.stake: You find a narrow window slightly ajar, the latch rusted through.
nodes.page: You find a narrow window slightly ajar, the latch rusted through. With a hard shove, you force it up and squeeze through into a storage room smelling of mothballs. Bolts of fine silk and heavy tweed are stacked floor to ceiling. You can hear the tailor speaking with a client in the front of the shop.

exits.label: Search the room for useful garments

nodes.stake: You pitch your voice low, mimicking the gravelly tone of the man you left bleeding in the alley.
nodes.page: You pitch your voice low, mimicking the gravelly tone of the man you left bleeding in the alley. You tell the voice outside that you are in prayer and will be out shortly. Footsteps retreat down the hall, buying you a crucial window of time. The disguise is holding, but the illusion is fragile.

exits.label: Walk out the front door boldly

nodes.stake: You slide the window up and swing your legs over the stone sill.
nodes.page: You slide the window up and swing your legs over the stone sill. The drop is short, landing you in a muddy patch of the church’s herb garden. Rain continues to drizzle, turning the earth into a slippery mess. You trudge through the rosemary bushes toward a wrought-iron gate leading to the street.

exits.label: Pick the lock on the gate

nodes.stake: You pocket the heavy iron key, its weight a comforting presence against your hip.
nodes.page: You pocket the heavy iron key, its weight a comforting presence against your hip. The Veridia Vault holds secrets that could buy your way out of the city entirely. You leave the sacristy, moving with purpose through the empty cloisters. The night is young, and your destination is now clear.

exits.label: Stop at the tailor for better clothes first

nodes.stake: You rifle through the velvet vestments, your fingers finding a hidden slit in the lining.
nodes.page: You rifle through the velvet vestments, your fingers finding a hidden slit in the lining. Inside is a small, velvet-wrapped lockbox, heavy with coins and a folded letter. The letter bears the wax seal of the Exchange, addressed to the very man you are impersonating. The plot thickens, tying this humble deacon to the city's corrupt financial heart.

nodes.stake: The opera house is a beacon of gaslight and gilded brass in the center of the square.
nodes.page: The opera house is a beacon of gaslight and gilded brass in the center of the square. Carriages pull up, discharging nobles in silk masks and heavy velvet coats. You blend into the shadows of the colonnade, watching the entrance. You need to get inside, but a man in a deacon's robe will not be permitted in the stalls.

exits.label: Sneak in through the cellar doors
Bribe a ticket-taker with stolen coin

nodes.stake: The harbor colossus towers above the docks, a massive statue of a long-dead king staring out at the dark sea.
nodes.page: The harbor colossus towers above the docks, a massive statue of a long-dead king staring out at the dark sea. The air here smells of brine, rotting fish, and cheap tobacco. You find yourself near the porter's station, where exhausted laborers are signing the night roll. A clipboard hangs from a nail, unguarded for a brief second.

exits.label: Add a fake name to the porter roll
Steal the clipboard and walk away

nodes.stake: You abandon stealth and break into a hard sprint toward the main gates.
nodes.page: You abandon stealth and break into a hard sprint toward the main gates. The heavy woolen robes tangle around your legs, threatening to trip you with every step. You hear shouts erupting behind you as the novice alerts the guards. You burst through the iron gates just as they begin to swing shut, spilling out into the chaotic city streets.

exits.label: Lose yourself in the market crowd

nodes.stake: You duck into a narrow stairwell that smells heavily of damp stone and mildew.
nodes.page: You duck into a narrow stairwell that smells heavily of damp stone and mildew. The wooden door clicks shut behind you, cutting off the sounds of the courtyard. The stairs wind downward into the crypts beneath the nave. It is dark, silent, and entirely cut off from the city above.

exits.label: Wait for the commotion to pass

nodes.stake: You endure the bone-rattling ride for what feels like an hour.
nodes.page: You endure the bone-rattling ride for what feels like an hour. The cart finally grinds to a halt, and you hear the driver climb down and walk away. Peeking over the edge of the wood, you see the towering facade of the Veridia Vault. You have been delivered straight to the financial heart of the city.

exits.label: Climb out and approach the Vault

nodes.stake: You judge the speed of the cart and roll over the side, hitting the cobblestones hard.
nodes.page: You judge the speed of the cart and roll over the side, hitting the cobblestones hard. The heavy wool of the robe saves your skin, but the impact bruises your shoulder. You scramble into the shadows of a nearby doorway before anyone spots you. You are bruised and dirty, but you are finally clear of the church district.

nodes.stake: The stable hand points a calloused finger toward a narrow path leading behind the granaries.
nodes.page: The stable hand points a calloused finger toward a narrow path leading behind the granaries. He warns you that the city watch rarely patrols there, but the local gangs do. You nod your thanks, pulling the muddy drover’s cloak tight against the damp air. The heavy fabric hides the deacon's collar perfectly.

exits.label: Take the path behind the granaries
Ignore his advice and stick to the main road

nodes.stake: You turn on your heel and leave the yard, the heavy cloak dragging slightly on the wet ground.
nodes.page: You turn on your heel and leave the yard, the heavy cloak dragging slightly on the wet ground. The disguise is rudimentary, but it changes your profile enough to pass casual inspection. You merge with a group of laborers heading toward the harbor district. The night is cold, and you have a long walk ahead.

exits.label: Head to the deacon's old contact

nodes.stake: The print shop is a madhouse of noise and frantic energy.
nodes.page: The print shop is a madhouse of noise and frantic energy. Men with ink-stained hands are feeding massive sheets of paper into the pressing rollers. You slide into the room, unnoticed amid the deafening clatter of the machinery. A stack of freshly printed broadsheets sits on a nearby table, still warm to the touch.

nodes.stake: You grab a warm paper and scan the headlines in the dim light.
nodes.page: You grab a warm paper and scan the headlines in the dim light. The front page blares news of a murdered clergyman found in an alleyway just hours ago. They have found the body faster than you anticipated. Your stolen clothes are now a liability rather than a shield.

exits.label: Head to the lamplit street to hide

nodes.stake: You step forward, demanding the second fitting the dead deacon had scheduled.
nodes.page: You step forward, demanding the second fitting the dead deacon had scheduled. The tailor blinks in surprise, confused by your sudden appearance and harsh tone. He stammers an apology and waves you toward the curtained fitting room. Once inside, you realize you have cornered yourself in a room with no back exit.

exits.label: Confront the tailor about the debt
Strip off the robes and find plain clothes

nodes.stake: You drop a stolen silver mark on the counter and ask for the plainest overcoat in the shop.
nodes.page: You drop a stolen silver mark on the counter and ask for the plainest overcoat in the shop. The tailor’s eyes widen at the coin, and he quickly fetches a drab, gray wool coat. You shed the heavy deacon's robe right there in the shop, leaving it in a heap on the floor. You step back out into the night, looking like any other tired citizen of Veridia.

exits.label: Walk down to the lamplit street
Head to the empty garret to rest

nodes.stake: You lean close to the screen, whispering a threat that makes the cutpurse freeze.
nodes.page: You lean close to the screen, whispering a threat that makes the cutpurse freeze. You demand a share of his stash, leveraging the terrifying authority of a corrupted priest. He shakily slides a small leather pouch under the wooden partition. You pocket the coins, the weight a grim satisfaction.

exits.label: Leave the church with your new funds

nodes.stake: You offer a quick, traditional absolution, your voice flat and devoid of warmth.
nodes.page: You offer a quick, traditional absolution, your voice flat and devoid of warmth. The cutpurse mutters his thanks and scurries away, the sound of his boots fading into the distance. The confession booth is quiet once again, smelling faintly of cheap wine and fear.

exits.label: Wait for the nave to clear entirely

nodes.stake: You sit in the suffocating darkness of the booth for a long time.
nodes.page: You sit in the suffocating darkness of the booth for a long time. Eventually, the distant chanting of the choir ceases, and the heavy doors of the nave are barred shut. You are locked inside the church for the night. You will have to find another way out before morning prayers begin.

exits.label: Search the crypts for an exit

nodes.stake: You walk up to the group of hardened dockworkers, keeping your hands visible.
nodes.page: You walk up to the group of hardened dockworkers, keeping your hands visible. They stop their dice game, eyeing your stolen robes with a mix of suspicion and disdain. You offer to buy them a round of cheap ale in exchange for information about the outbound ships. One of them spits on the ground but nods toward a nearby tavern.

exits.label: Change your mind and walk away

nodes.stake: You bypass the dockworkers and locate the small wooden shack serving as the porter's station.
nodes.page: You bypass the dockworkers and locate the small wooden shack serving as the porter's station. The harbor master is asleep at his desk, a half-empty bottle of rum by his elbow. The porter roll is spread open, detailing the shifts for loading the massive freighter docked at pier four. This is your ticket out of Veridia.

exits.label: Forge your name on the roll

nodes.stake: The tailor wordlessly hands you a bundle of roughspun clothes, meant for a common laborer.
nodes.page: The tailor wordlessly hands you a bundle of roughspun clothes, meant for a common laborer. You strip off the heavy, blood-tainted robes of the deacon and pull on the new garments. The fit is poor, but it entirely erases your previous identity. You are no longer a man of the cloth; you are just another face in the crowd.

exits.label: Step out into the lamplit street

nodes.stake: You mention the old debt, your voice dropping to a dangerous register.
nodes.page: You mention the old debt, your voice dropping to a dangerous register. The tailor pales, wiping sweat from his forehead with a scrap of silk. He admits he doesn't have the coin, but offers you a forged transit pass instead. It is exactly what you need to move through the checkpoints near the Exchange.

nodes.stake: You crouch in the darkness among the bolts of fabric, listening to the muffled voices from the shop.
nodes.page: You crouch in the darkness among the bolts of fabric, listening to the muffled voices from the shop. The client is a city watch captain, complaining about the increased patrols in the district. He mentions that they have found a body stripped of its clothes near the nave. The hunt is officially on.

nodes.stake: You blindly rummage through the dark storage room, your hands finding a thick, woolen sailor's coat.
nodes.page: You blindly rummage through the dark storage room, your hands finding a thick, woolen sailor's coat. You pull it on over the deacon's robes, hiding the distinct collar. It is bulky and uncomfortable, but it will serve its purpose in the dark streets. You quietly force the back door open and slip into the alley.

nodes.stake: You throw the sacristy door open and stride out, your face set in a mask of pious anger.
nodes.page: You throw the sacristy door open and stride out, your face set in a mask of pious anger. The young acolyte waiting outside flinches, stammering an apology for interrupting your prayers. You sweep past him without a word, your stolen robes billowing behind you. Boldness is often the best camouflage.

exits.label: Walk straight to the main doors

nodes.stake: You work your lockpick into the rusted mechanism of the garden gate.
nodes.page: You work your lockpick into the rusted mechanism of the garden gate. The cold rain makes your fingers stiff, but the lock finally yields with a heavy click. You push the iron gate open, stepping out onto the slippery cobblestones of the street. You are free of the church grounds, but the night is far from over.

nodes.stake: You grab a heavy garden stone and smash it against the iron spikes, breaking the rusted latch.
nodes.page: You grab a heavy garden stone and smash it against the iron spikes, breaking the rusted latch. The noise is deafening in the quiet night, sure to draw the attention of the watch. You scramble over the broken gate, tearing the hem of your stolen robe in the process. You hit the ground running, plunging into the dark city.

nodes.stake: The Veridia Vault is a fortress of black stone and iron bars, guarded by mercenaries with repeating rifles.
nodes.page: The Veridia Vault is a fortress of black stone and iron bars, guarded by mercenaries with repeating rifles. You stand across the street, the stolen key burning a hole in your pocket. The front entrance is heavily watched, but the dead man's correspondence mentioned a side door used by the clergy.

nodes.stake: You break the wax seal and unfold the crisp parchment in the dim light.
nodes.page: You break the wax seal and unfold the crisp parchment in the dim light. The letter details a massive transfer of funds meant to bypass the Exchange's oversight. The deacon was not just a priest; he was a courier for the city's corrupt elite. This information is worth more than gold to the right buyer.

exits.label: Take the letter to the press district
Use it as leverage at the Vault

nodes.stake: You tuck the velvet lockbox into your deep pocket and quietly exit the sacristy.
nodes.page: You tuck the velvet lockbox into your deep pocket and quietly exit the sacristy. The weight of the box is a constant reminder of the risk you are carrying. If the watch catches you with a dead man's money, there will be no trial. You need to secure a new identity immediately.

exits.label: Head to the tailor for a disguise
Go to the safehouse to hide the box

nodes.stake: You pry open the wooden cellar doors at the rear of the opera house.
nodes.page: You pry open the wooden cellar doors at the rear of the opera house. The air inside smells of damp earth, greasepaint, and old wood. You navigate the dark basement, listening to the muffled sounds of the orchestra tuning up above. You find a rack of discarded costumes near the stairs.

exits.label: Head upstairs to the main hall

nodes.stake: You slide a stolen silver mark across the brass ticket counter.
nodes.page: You slide a stolen silver mark across the brass ticket counter. The attendant looks at the coin, then at your plain woolen robes, raising an eyebrow. He discreetly pockets the coin and hands you a ticket for the standing gallery in the back. You are in, surrounded by the elite of Veridia.

exits.label: Look for your contact in the gallery
Watch the crowd from the shadows

nodes.stake: You grab a charcoal pencil and hastily scrawl a fake name onto the porter's ledger.
nodes.page: You grab a charcoal pencil and hastily scrawl a fake name onto the porter's ledger. The handwriting is sloppy, but it blends in with the dozens of other exhausted signatures. You grab a heavy canvas sack from the pile and hoist it onto your shoulder. You are now officially a laborer on the Veridia docks.

exits.label: Carry the sack to the warehouse

nodes.stake: You slip the entire clipboard beneath your heavy woolen robes and walk away quickly.
nodes.page: You slip the entire clipboard beneath your heavy woolen robes and walk away quickly. Without the roll, the harbor master will have no record of who is supposed to be working tonight. It creates perfect chaos on the docks, slowing down the loading process and confusing the guards. You use the distraction to slip past the main checkpoint.

nodes.stake: You plunge into the crowded night market, shoving past stalls selling roasted chestnuts and cheap tin wares.
nodes.page: You plunge into the crowded night market, shoving past stalls selling roasted chestnuts and cheap tin wares. The heavy robes make you clumsy, but the sheer volume of people hides your escape perfectly. You weave through the throng until the shouts of the guards fade entirely. You are safe for the moment, lost in the heart of Veridia.

exits.label: Find a quiet place to change

nodes.stake: You dive into a pitch-black alleyway, pressing your back flat against the cold, damp brick.
nodes.page: You dive into a pitch-black alleyway, pressing your back flat against the cold, damp brick. A squad of city watchmen runs past the opening, their lanterns swinging wildly. You hold your breath, the scent of garbage and old rain thick in your nose. They do not see you, their footsteps echoing away down the street.

exits.label: Stay in the alley until dawn
Creep out and head for the street

nodes.stake: The crypts are a labyrinth of stone tombs and dusty ossuaries.
nodes.page: The crypts are a labyrinth of stone tombs and dusty ossuaries. You navigate by touch, the air growing colder the deeper you go. You eventually find a rusted iron grate covering a drainage tunnel that leads out to the harbor. It will be a tight, filthy squeeze, but it leads out of the church.

exits.label: Turn back and find another way

nodes.stake: You sit on the cold stone stairs in the dark, listening to the heavy silence of the church.
nodes.page: You sit on the cold stone stairs in the dark, listening to the heavy silence of the church. Hours seem to pass, the damp cold seeping into your bones through the stolen robes. Eventually, you hear the distant sound of the morning bells tolling. The search has either moved on, or they are waiting for daylight.

exits.label: Creep back up to the courtyard
Wait a little longer in the dark

nodes.stake: You remain huddled in the back of the cart, watching the guards patrol the front of the Vault.
nodes.page: You remain huddled in the back of the cart, watching the guards patrol the front of the Vault. The heavy robes offer little warmth against the biting wind coming off the harbor. You wait until a distraction pulls the guards toward a scuffle down the street. It is your only window of opportunity.

exits.label: Make a break for the side door
Slip away down the main avenue

nodes.stake: You drop through the rusted grate, leaving the sharp wind of Veridia behind.
nodes.page: You drop through the rusted grate, leaving the sharp wind of Veridia behind. The descent into the maintenance shaft is entirely silent, save for the echo of your own measured breathing. You are alone now, the absence of Sable’s quiet footfalls a stark reminder of the isolation you chose. A heavy, plated coal-chute angles steeply downward to your left, slick with decades of compressed dust. To your right, a narrow masonry crawlspace smells of raw earth and old copper.

nodes.stake: You brace your boots against the curved iron of the chute, controlling your slide into the absolute darkness.
nodes.page: You brace your boots against the curved iron of the chute, controlling your slide into the absolute darkness. The metal groans softly beneath your weight, a low vibration that travels directly up your spine. You spill out into a cavernous, low-ceilinged basement filled with stacked counter-ledgers, their pages swelling and rotting in the damp. A narrow, spiraling staircase leads upward toward the rooftops, while a heavy iron door sits slightly ajar, breathing stale air.

nodes.stake: The crawlspace forces you onto your hands and knees, the rough stone biting through your gloves.
nodes.page: The crawlspace forces you onto your hands and knees, the rough stone biting through your gloves. You navigate by touch, feeling the vibrations of the city machinery humming faintly through the walls. The passage eventually widens into a brick-lined storm drain, the floor slick with chemical runoff from the press district. A faint, flickering light spills from a grate above you, and a dark tunnel extends further horizontally.

nodes.stake: You push the iron door just enough to slip your shoulders through, mindful of the screeching hinges.
nodes.page: You push the iron door just enough to slip your shoulders through, mindful of the screeching hinges. The next chamber is a forgotten archive, illuminated only by a single candle resting on a wooden crate. Stacks of ruined architectural blueprints and discarded counter-ledgers form a labyrinth of rotting paper. A ladder ascends into a cramped, empty space above, while a shadowed archway leads toward the bank's substructure.

nodes.stake: You haul yourself up the rusted rungs, pressing your face against the cold iron of the grate.
nodes.page: You haul yourself up the rusted rungs, pressing your face against the cold iron of the grate. Above you is a cramped, forgotten garret, illuminated by a single dying candle resting on a stool. The room is completely silent, stripped of all furniture save for the stool and a cracked mirror leaning against the wall. A narrow window looks out toward the harbor colossus, and a wooden door hangs loosely on its hinges.

nodes.stake: The air grows colder as you approach the perimeter of the vault's substructure.
nodes.page: The air grows colder as you approach the perimeter of the vault's substructure. Massive granite blocks form the walls here, lined with intricate copper wiring that hums with low-voltage current. You spot a narrow inspection corridor that runs parallel to the main security checkpoint. Following it will take you dangerously close to the vault's primary defenses, but returning to the ledger room is your only other option.

nodes.stake: You step out into a dusty maintenance hall that runs behind the upper galleries of the theater.
nodes.page: You step out into a dusty maintenance hall that runs behind the upper galleries of the theater. Canvases and wooden frames are stacked haphazardly against the walls, discarded backgrounds from a local portraitist. The painted landscapes of Veridia's elite stare back at you, their artificial smiles unsettling in the gloom. A service elevator shaft sits empty to your left, its cables severed long ago.

exits.label: Climb down the empty elevator shaft

nodes.stake: You flatten yourself against the granite, timing your movements to the rhythmic hum of the copper wiring.
nodes.page: You flatten yourself against the granite, timing your movements to the rhythmic hum of the copper wiring. The inspection corridor narrows, forcing you to turn sideways to avoid brushing against the live currents. Up ahead, the corridor terminates at a reinforced ventilation shaft overlooking the secure area. Dropping through the vent would place you directly in the bank's most heavily guarded sector.

nodes.stake: You sift through the portraitist's discarded backgrounds, noting the precise brushstrokes and obsessive detailing of the cityscapes.
nodes.page: You sift through the portraitist's discarded backgrounds, noting the precise brushstrokes and obsessive detailing of the cityscapes. Taped to the back of a canvas depicting the Exchange roofs is a series of numbers and letters, a pigeon cipher used by the smuggling rings. Memorizing the sequence, you realize it maps a safe route through the upper structural supports. A small access hatch is concealed behind the final canvas.

exits.label: Step away and head for the studio

nodes.stake: You grip the greasy elevator rails, sliding down into the pitch black of the lower levels.
nodes.page: You grip the greasy elevator rails, sliding down into the pitch black of the lower levels. The descent burns your palms, but the silence of your approach is worth the pain. You land softly on a bed of discarded rags in the sub-basement. A heavy steel door marked with the crest of the Veridian Treasury stands before you, slightly ajar.

nodes.stake: You locate a rusted bypass panel hidden behind a layer of soot on the stone wall.
nodes.page: You locate a rusted bypass panel hidden behind a layer of soot on the stone wall. Prying it open with your knife, you expose a tangle of decaying mechanical gears and frayed wires. By manually tripping the secondary breaker, you can shut down the copper wiring in the next sector, though it might alert a technician. Alternatively, you can climb the adjacent service ladder to avoid the grid entirely.

nodes.stake: The access hatch swings open without a sound, revealing a narrow catwalk suspended above the printing press district.
nodes.page: The access hatch swings open without a sound, revealing a narrow catwalk suspended above the printing press district. The rhythmic thumping of the massive machines below vibrates through the metal grating beneath your boots. The air here is thick with the smell of ink and hot lead. You can follow the catwalk toward the communication arrays, or drop down onto the outer ridge of the Exchange.

nodes.stake: Kicking aside the oil-soaked rags, you uncover a small wooden crate bound in iron straps.
nodes.page: Kicking aside the oil-soaked rags, you uncover a small wooden crate bound in iron straps. Inside, you find a collection of brass keys and a brass-plated ledger detailing underground shipments. The ledger confirms that the tunnel network connects directly to the harbor colossus foundations. A draft of cold, salty air pulls your attention toward a narrow fissure in the foundation wall.

exits.label: Leave the ledger and enter the vault area

nodes.stake: You jam your blade into the mechanism, forcing the breaker down with a harsh metallic snap.
nodes.page: You jam your blade into the mechanism, forcing the breaker down with a harsh metallic snap. The humming of the copper wires instantly dies, plunging the corridor into profound silence. You move quickly, crossing the now-dead threshold before any automated systems can reboot or flag the anomaly. The corridor opens up into a massive, polished stone atrium that precedes the main depository.

nodes.stake: You ascend the service ladder, your boots finding precarious purchase on the slick, rusted rungs.
nodes.page: You ascend the service ladder, your boots finding precarious purchase on the slick, rusted rungs. The climb takes you up through the strata of Veridia, the stale subterranean air slowly replaced by the sharp chill of the night. You emerge into a small, wire-mesh enclosure surrounded by cooing birds. It is a pigeon cage, perched high on the side of the towering architecture.

nodes.stake: You creep along the suspended catwalk, the vibrations of the presses below masking any sound you make.
nodes.page: You creep along the suspended catwalk, the vibrations of the presses below masking any sound you make. The catwalk leads to a high, open window of a secluded garret apartment, barely illuminated by the city lights. Inside, the silhouette of a single candle flickers against the peeling wallpaper.
