nodes.page: You climb the intricate folds of the bronze cheekbone, reaching the edge of the right eye. The nest is built entirely of scavenged wood and silk, a stark contrast to the cold metal. She doesn't turn around as you pull yourself into the socket. You stand in the silence, waiting for her to acknowledge you.

nodes.stake: The corridor spirals directly into the lower cavity of the head.
nodes.page: The corridor spirals directly into the lower cavity of the head. You bypass the final set of traps, your counting flawless to the end. The soft light of a lantern spills from the hollow right eye. You step into the light, ending the climb.

nodes.stake: You break through to the exterior, scaling the bridge of the massive bronze nose.
nodes.page: You break through to the exterior, scaling the bridge of the massive bronze nose. The wind tears at your coat, but the handholds are perfect. You swing yourself around the edge of the right eye socket. Her nest is right in front of you.

nodes.stake: You detach from the safety cable and pull yourself onto the final platform.
nodes.page: You detach from the safety cable and pull yourself onto the final platform. The interior of the skull is vast, echoing with the sound of the wind outside. You can see her silhouette against the twilight of the eclipse in the right eye. The time for sneaking is over.

nodes.stake: You free climb the last stretch of the inner skull, your muscles screaming in protest.
nodes.page: You free climb the last stretch of the inner skull, your muscles screaming in protest. You haul yourself over the edge of the wooden platform built into the eye socket. She turns her head slightly, acknowledging your arrival without a word. You brush the dust from your coat and stand tall.

exits.label: Go back to the bid room

nodes.stake: You follow the chalk marks perfectly, avoiding the final collapse of the rotting floorboards.
nodes.page: You follow the chalk marks perfectly, avoiding the final collapse of the rotting floorboards. The path leads directly to a heavy canvas curtain blocking the right eye. You push the canvas aside, stepping into her private nest. The colossus groans around you as the wind picks up.

nodes.stake: You deviate from the path and climb straight up the inner cheekplate.
nodes.page:
You deviate from the path and climb straight up the inner cheekplate. The metal is smooth, forcing you to wedge yourself in a narrow seam to advance. You finally breach the floor of the eye socket, pulling yourself up into the warm light. She is waiting, her ledger open on a small table.

</user_query>

nodes.stake: You slip through the heavy side door, leaving the slate room behind to enter the deeper catacombs.
nodes.page: You slip through the heavy side door, leaving the slate room behind to enter the deeper catacombs. The passage smells faintly of sulfur and damp limestone, pressing inward with an oppressive chill. A flickering gas lamp reveals a sharp divergence in the cramped tunnel ahead. You run your hand along the brickwork, feeling for the telltale draft of the lower levels. The left path slopes toward the vault foundations, while the right tightens into a jagged fissure.

exits.label: Follow the slope toward the foundations

nodes.stake: The fissure is a tight squeeze, forcing you to turn sideways to scrape past the rough stone.
nodes.page: The fissure is a tight squeeze, forcing you to turn sideways to scrape past the rough stone. Chalk markings scar the walls, outlining structural weaknesses in the bedrock of Veridia. You press forward until the gap widens into a small, forgotten maintenance alcove. A pile of rusted iron grates sits in the corner, obscuring a heavy wooden trapdoor. You kick the grates aside to clear a path.

nodes.stake: You descend the slope, your boots finding purchase on the slick, uneven cobbles.
nodes.page: You descend the slope, your boots finding purchase on the slick, uneven cobbles. The air grows significantly colder here, carrying the sharp scent of polished brass and machine oil. Ahead, the corridor terminates at the edge of a massive, metallic structure. You recognize the familiar slope of a coal chute, but this one is thoroughly plated in steel. It completely contradicts the public blueprint of the Exchange's lower levels.

nodes.stake: The wooden trapdoor groans as you heave it upward, revealing a dark vertical shaft.
nodes.page: The wooden trapdoor groans as you heave it upward, revealing a dark vertical shaft. A rusted iron ladder descends into the gloom, its rungs slick with condensation. You test the first rung with your weight, feeling a slight shift in the metal. The shaft drops directly toward the lower sub-levels near the vault. You secure your grip and begin the perilous descent.

exits.label: Check the structural integrity of the ledge

nodes.stake: You run your fingers over the chalk lines, tracing the careful geometry left by the city architects.
nodes.page: You run your fingers over the chalk lines, tracing the careful geometry left by the city architects. The markings point toward a deliberate hollow space just behind the rock face. You tap the wall, noting the hollow thud that reverberates through the alcove. Someone intentionally weakened this section of the foundation to allow unauthorized access. You spot a loose stone block that might give way with enough force.

nodes.stake: You inspect the heavy steel plates covering the chute, noting the immaculate rivet work.
nodes.page: You inspect the heavy steel plates covering the chute, noting the immaculate rivet work. The public architectural plans insisted this sector contained only porous brickwork and standard ventilation shafts. This level of reinforcement suggests it was built to transport something much heavier and more valuable than coal. You find a hairline seam where two plates meet, offering a potential handhold. You can pry at the seam or scale the plating to reach a higher vantage point.

nodes.stake: You sift through the debris piled around the base of the mysterious plated chute.
nodes.page: You sift through the debris piled around the base of the mysterious plated chute. Broken mortar and shattered shale indicate this area was hastily excavated after the initial construction. You uncover a discarded foreman's notebook buried beneath a chunk of concrete. The pages are heavily waterlogged, but a few technical diagrams remain intact. You brush the dirt from the cover to get a better look.

exits.label: Leave the notebook and step into the dark

nodes.stake: The ladder creaks ominously with every step you take into the dark shaft.
nodes.page: The ladder creaks ominously with every step you take into the dark shaft. Rust flakes off onto your gloves, filling your nose with the scent of decaying iron. You reach a small maintenance landing roughly halfway down the drop. A narrow service tunnel branches off from the landing, leading toward the vault interior. The main ladder continues downward into complete darkness.

exits.label: Continue down the ladder into the dark

nodes.stake: You push through into a cramped, dusty alcove that runs parallel to the main vault approach.
nodes.page: You push through into a cramped, dusty alcove that runs parallel to the main vault approach. The walls here are lined with rotting wooden shelves that buckle under the weight of thick ledgers. You recognize the sigils on the bindings; these are counter-ledgers, detailing transactions the cabal kept off the official books. You already know the names of the cabal members involved, but the specific financial routing might prove useful. You slide a heavy tome from the middle shelf to examine the contents.

exits.label: Rip the recent transaction pages out
Search the alcove for more dust-covered books

nodes.stake: The iron grate is solidly embedded in the stone, its bars thick and unyielding.
nodes.page: The iron grate is solidly embedded in the stone, its bars thick and unyielding. You trace the edges of the frame, searching for a release mechanism or a weakened hinge. A rush of cold air blows through the bars, carrying the distinct sound of shifting gears. You spot a rusted lever positioned just out of reach on the other side. You wedge your arm through the gaps to try and manipulate the mechanism.

exits.label: Strain to pull the rusted lever
Climb the wall to find another route

nodes.stake: You wedge your fingers into the hairline seam, applying steady pressure against the steel plate.
nodes.page: You wedge your fingers into the hairline seam, applying steady pressure against the steel plate. The metal groans but eventually gives way, revealing a hollow cavity packed with sound-dampening insulation. You pull the insulation aside to find a hidden access hatch embedded in the chute's interior wall. The hatch is secured by a simple rotary latch that lacks a padlock. You grip the latch, preparing to breach the inner mechanism.

exits.label: Examine the rivet work on the hatch

nodes.stake: You pull yourself up the exterior of the plated chute, finding narrow footholds on the heavy rivets.
nodes.page: You pull yourself up the exterior of the plated chute, finding narrow footholds on the heavy rivets. The climb is grueling, your muscles burning as you navigate the vertical incline. You reach a narrow gap near the ceiling where the chute connects to the upper levels of the Exchange. Peering through the gap, you see a long drop down into an active ventilation shaft. You must decide whether to attempt the jump or descend.

exits.label: Squeeze through the gap and drop
Follow the external pipe alongside the chute

nodes.stake: You leave the rubble behind and step into the absolute darkness of the unlit corridor.
nodes.page: You leave the rubble behind and step into the absolute darkness of the unlit corridor. You trail your hand along the wall to guide your path, feeling the transition from brick to cold metal. The floor slopes downward, slick with an oily residue that makes your footing treacherous. You hear the faint trickling of water echoing from somewhere further down the slope. You slow your pace to avoid slipping into an unseen hazard.

exits.label: Step carefully toward the water source

nodes.stake: You step carefully onto the maintenance ledge, testing the rusted grating with your boot.
nodes.page: You step carefully onto the maintenance ledge, testing the rusted grating with your boot. The grating holds, but a precarious spiderweb of cracks spreads across the supporting masonry. A narrow service door sits at the far end of the ledge, its hinges thick with grease. You must cross the cracked stonework quickly to reach the exit. You press yourself against the wall to distribute your weight.

exits.label: Check the heavy iron hook above you

nodes.stake: You descend further down the shaft, the air growing thick and suffocating.
nodes.page: You descend further down the shaft, the air growing thick and suffocating. The ladder suddenly ends, sheared off by some past structural collapse. You dangle by your hands, feeling blindly for a foothold in the darkness below. Your boot brushes against a thick, braided rope tied to a protruding rebar. You transfer your weight to the rope to slide the rest of the way down.

exits.label: Drop directly to the solid floor

nodes.stake: You quickly tear the relevant transaction pages from the counter-ledger, folding them into your pocket.
nodes.page: You quickly tear the relevant transaction pages from the counter-ledger, folding them into your pocket. The cabal's secret financial routing is now safely in your possession. You shove the heavy tome back onto the rotting shelf, sending a cloud of dust into the air. A narrow passageway at the back of the alcove offers a route deeper into the subterranean network. You step over a collapsed timber to proceed.

nodes.stake: You sift through the thick layer of dust covering the forgotten alcove.
nodes.page: You sift through the thick layer of dust covering the forgotten alcove. Footprints indicate someone else was down here recently, examining these very same illicit ledgers. You follow the tracks past the shelving units to a heavy oak door reinforced with iron bands. The door is slightly ajar, revealing a sliver of light from the adjacent chamber. You press your eye to the gap to survey the room beyond.

exits.label: Push the heavy oak door open

nodes.stake: You find purchase on the protruding bricks, pulling yourself up toward the ceiling.
nodes.page: You find purchase on the protruding bricks, pulling yourself up toward the ceiling. The climb offers a better view of the subterranean layout, revealing a network of pipes bypassing the vault. You reach a narrow crawlspace that runs directly above the barred passage. Dust falls from the ceiling as you wedge yourself into the tight opening. You drag yourself forward on your elbows.

nodes.stake: You twist the rotary latch, feeling the internal tumblers disengage with a satisfying click.
nodes.page: You twist the rotary latch, feeling the internal tumblers disengage with a satisfying click. The access hatch swings open, revealing a completely different structural schematic than the public blueprints. You find yourself staring into a disguised storage area rather than a functional coal chute. A stack of rolled canvas paintings leans against the far wall, hastily discarded. You cross the small space to examine the artwork.

nodes.stake: You inspect the heavy rivets securing the hatch, noting their distinct lack of wear and tear.
nodes.page: You inspect the heavy rivets securing the hatch, noting their distinct lack of wear and tear. This section of the chute has rarely been opened, serving as a permanent block rather than an access point. You press your ear against the cold metal, listening for any movement within the cavity. A faint scraping sound echoes from the other side, methodical and persistent. You prepare to breach the panel and confront whatever lies beyond.

nodes.stake: You grip the thick external pipe, using it to balance as you traverse the narrow ledge.
nodes.page: You grip the thick external pipe, using it to balance as you traverse the narrow ledge. The metal is scalding hot to the touch, forcing you to shift your hands constantly to avoid burns. You follow the pipe around a sharp corner, arriving at a dead-end maintenance platform. A discarded toolbox sits open on the platform, its contents scattered across the grating. You kick the tools aside to inspect the grating below.

exits.label: Follow the pipe to the easel stand

nodes.stake: You step cautiously toward the sound of trickling water, your boots splashing lightly in shallow puddles.
nodes.page: You step cautiously toward the sound of trickling water, your boots splashing lightly in shallow puddles. A broken drainage pipe drips a steady stream of murky fluid onto the floor. The water flows into a narrow culvert that slopes sharply downward toward the vault exterior. You notice several heavy canvas bags stacked against the culvert wall, stained with dampness. You crouch down to inspect the nearest bag.

nodes.stake: You inch along the cracked masonry, keeping your body pressed tight against the cold stone.
nodes.page: You inch along the cracked masonry, keeping your body pressed tight against the cold stone. The wall bows slightly under your weight, sending a shower of loose mortar into the chasm below. You finally reach the service door, your heart pounding from the precarious crossing. The iron handle is stiff, requiring significant force to turn. You brace your boots against the doorframe to gain leverage.

nodes.stake: You grab the heavy iron hook suspended from the ceiling, testing its structural integrity.
nodes.page: You grab the heavy iron hook suspended from the ceiling, testing its structural integrity. The hook holds fast, allowing you to swing across the collapsed section of the floor. You land smoothly on the opposite platform, rolling to absorb the impact of the jump. A solid iron door blocks your path, marked with the insignia of the Exchange's maintenance crew. You step up to the door and examine the locking mechanism.

exits.label: Search the floor for a key

nodes.stake: You drop directly to the solid stone floor, landing with a heavy thud that echoes through the shaft.
nodes.page: You drop directly to the solid stone floor, landing with a heavy thud that echoes through the shaft. The impact sends a jolt up your legs, but you recover quickly and scan the darkness. A single beam of moonlight pierces the gloom, illuminating a small bronze key half-buried in the dirt. You retrieve the key, wiping the grime from its intricate teeth. You scan the surrounding walls for a corresponding lock.

exits.label: Take the key and move on

nodes.stake: You step over the collapsed timber and enter a cramped corridor lined with discarded furniture.
nodes.page: You step over the collapsed timber and enter a cramped corridor lined with discarded furniture. The air is thick with the smell of old paper and rotting wood. You continue down the passageway until it widens into a small, makeshift study. A stack of additional counter-ledgers sits on a rickety wooden desk in the center of the room. You approach the desk to see if these books contain more useful transactions.

exits.label: Investigate the shadows in the corner

nodes.stake: You turn your attention to the adjacent dusty shelf, running your gloved hand along the edge.
nodes.page: You turn your attention to the adjacent dusty shelf, running your gloved hand along the edge. The wood is splintered and brittle, threatening to collapse at the slightest pressure. You find a small, leather-bound diary tucked away behind a stack of moldy tax records. The diary is sealed with a simple brass clasp that pops open easily. You flip through the pages, searching for any relevant information about the vault.

nodes.stake: You carefully crawl along the exposed wooden beam, testing its strength before committing your weight.
nodes.page: You carefully crawl along the exposed wooden beam, testing its strength before committing your weight. The wood groans in protest, but holds firm as you traverse the gap. You reach a small ventilation grate that overlooks the antechamber to the main vault. The view provides a clear layout of the room's defensive architecture. You gently push on the grate to see if it will give way.

nodes.stake: You inspect the brickwork of the crawlspace wall, noticing a section where the mortar is unusually crumbly.
nodes.page: You inspect the brickwork of the crawlspace wall, noticing a section where the mortar is unusually crumbly. You dig your fingers into the gaps, easily prying several bricks loose from the structure. A narrow tunnel is revealed behind the wall, offering a discreet path back toward the surface tunnels. You widen the hole enough to squeeze your shoulders through. You push yourself into the newly discovered passage.

nodes.stake: You unroll the discarded canvas, revealing a detailed architectural sketch of the Exchange.
nodes.page: You unroll the discarded canvas, revealing a detailed architectural sketch of the Exchange. You study the painting closely, comparing it to the real structures you've navigated. The painter's backgrounds explicitly show the lower levels, clearly illustrating the coal-chute lie. The artwork proves the chute was always a reinforced passageway, never meant for fuel. You roll the canvas back up, memorizing the structural details.

nodes.stake: You examine the heavy wooden portrait frames leaning against the cold steel of the disguised chute.
nodes.page: You examine the heavy wooden portrait frames leaning against the cold steel of the disguised chute. The frames are ornate, clearly stolen from the upper galleries and dumped here for storage. You turn one of the frames around, discovering a rough charcoal sketch on the back of the canvas. The sketch mirrors the structural truth of the sub-levels, exposing the public blueprints as a fabrication. You trace the charcoal lines to commit the layout to memory.

nodes.stake: You scrape away the peeling paint on the access hatch, revealing a brass plate etched with a serial number.
nodes.page: You scrape away the peeling paint on the access hatch, revealing a brass plate etched with a serial number. The number corresponds to an internal security requisition rather than a standard municipal order. This proves the reinforcement of the chute was ordered directly by the cabal to protect their private assets. You brush the remaining flakes of paint from your gloves. You turn back to the scattered supplies left by the workmen.

nodes.stake: You move past the dead-end platform and step into a wider storage room filled with art supplies.
nodes.page: You move past the dead-end platform and step into a wider storage room filled with art supplies. Canvases, brushes, and easels are haphazardly piled in the corners, indicating a hastily abandoned studio. You approach the central easel, which holds a half-finished landscape of the Veridia skyline. The perspective is unusual, painted from a vantage point you recognize as the high tower. You step closer to inspect the brushwork.

nodes.stake: You investigate the damp canvas bags stacked in the culvert, untying the thick cord securing the nearest one.
nodes.page: You investigate the damp canvas bags stacked in the culvert, untying the thick cord securing the nearest one. The bag is filled with discarded painter's smocks and empty jars of turpentine. You dig deeper into the sack, finding a crumpled architectural drawing hidden among the rags. The drawing clearly shows the plated chute, providing further evidence of the cabal's deception. You pocket the drawing and stand back up.

nodes.stake: You heave the heavy service door open, its hinges shrieking in protest against the quiet of the tunnels.
nodes.page: You heave the heavy service door open, its hinges shrieking in protest against the quiet of the tunnels. You step through into a narrow stairwell that spirals upward toward the higher levels of the building. The air grows noticeably fresher as you ascend, carrying the faint scent of city smog. You reach the top of the stairs and push open a trapdoor leading to an abandoned rooftop enclosure. The enclosure contains a large, empty pigeon cage.

nodes.stake: You carefully pick the rusted lock on the iron door, feeling the tumblers snap into place one by one.
nodes.page: You carefully pick the rusted lock on the iron door, feeling the tumblers snap into place one by one. The door swings inward, granting you access to a small, forgotten communications room. Desks are lined with old telegraph equipment and piles of unsent messages. You sort through the papers on the nearest desk, looking for anything of value. You find a small, encoded strip of paper pinned to a corkboard.

nodes.stake: You search the dirt floor around the door, running your hands over the uneven ground in the gloom.
nodes.page: You search the dirt floor around the door, running your hands over the uneven ground in the gloom. Your fingers brush against a cold, metallic object half-buried near the doorframe. You pull a heavy iron key from the earth, wiping away the grime to inspect its teeth. The key looks like a perfect match for the solid door blocking your path. You insert the key into the lock and turn it.

nodes.stake: You take the small bronze key and move further down the unlit passage.
nodes.page: You take the small bronze key and move further down the unlit passage. The corridor ends at a heavy metal lockbox bolted directly to the stone wall. You insert the key into the lockbox, turning it until the mechanism releases with a sharp click. Inside, you find a collection of rolled parchment and a small, leather-bound codebook. You unroll the parchment to examine the contents.

nodes.stake: You examine the thick bindings of the counter-ledgers, noting the precise stitching used to hold the pages together.
nodes.page: You examine the thick bindings of the counter-ledgers, noting the precise stitching used to hold the pages together. You flip the book over to check the back cover, finding a hidden pocket sliced into the leather. Inside the pocket is a tightly folded piece of vellum covered in quick, handwritten notes. The notes detail the guard rotations for the antechamber directly outside the main vault. You quickly memorize the patrol timings.

nodes.stake: You investigate the heavy shadows gathered in the corner of the makeshift study.
nodes.page: You investigate the heavy shadows gathered in the corner of the makeshift study. As your eyes adjust to the gloom, you spot a small, iron-wrought table tucked away against the brickwork. A single chair sits beside it, positioned to offer a clear view of the hallway you just traversed. Someone was keeping watch here, monitoring the illicit ledgers. You step closer to inspect the tabletop for left-behind items.

nodes.stake: You step carefully onto the wooden platform overlooking the vault antechamber.
nodes.page: You step carefully onto the wooden platform overlooking the vault antechamber. The platform creaks ominously, forcing you to freeze and wait for the sound to dissipate. Below, the heavy steel door of the main vault stands resolute, flanked by intricate locking mechanisms. You calculate the distance to the floor, assessing whether a drop is feasible. You edge closer to the railing for a better view.

nodes.stake: You inch your way to the very edge of the vault overlook, bracing yourself against the cold stone wall.
nodes.page: You inch your way to the very edge of the vault overlook, bracing yourself against the cold stone wall. The sheer drop into the antechamber is intimidating, offering no easy path downward. A heavy ventilation grate is embedded in the floor of your current platform, leading directly into the room below. You test the edges of the grate, finding it loosely secured to the masonry. You prepare to remove the heavy iron cover.

nodes.stake: You drag yourself into the hidden tunnel, the rough brickwork scraping against your shoulders.
nodes.page: You drag yourself into the hidden tunnel, the rough brickwork scraping against your shoulders. The passage is incredibly narrow, forcing you to crawl on your stomach through the dense cobwebs. You navigate the tight space until you reach a section where the tunnel widens significantly. A loose brick in the wall ahead offers a potential exit back into the main corridors. You push the brick outward to test the opening.

nodes.stake: You proceed up a narrow flight of stairs, arriving in a dusty, empty garret.
nodes.page: You proceed up a narrow flight of stairs, arriving in a dusty, empty garret. The small room smells of old wax and stale air, its sloped ceiling pressing low overhead. You notice a second, half-melted candle sitting on the windowsill, its wax pooled unevenly on the wood. This garret is completely different from the one where you found the first candle, yet the arrangement is identical. You step closer to inspect the flame's remnants.

nodes.stake: You examine the painter's background details even closer, marveling at the deliberate accuracy of the strokes.
nodes.page: You examine the painter's background details even closer, marveling at the deliberate accuracy of the strokes. The artist took great care to render the subterranean levels precisely, capturing every rivet of the plated chute. This was no mere landscape; it was a documentary effort to expose the architectural lie beneath the Exchange. You commit the exact layout to memory before stepping away from the canvas. You move toward the stairs leading up to the garrets.

nodes.stake: You fully analyze the implications of the coal-chute lie exposed in the artist's work.
nodes.page: You fully analyze the implications of the coal-chute lie exposed in the artist's work. The city's public registry was completely falsified to hide this reinforced access point. You run your hand over the charcoal sketch, feeling the grit of the medium against your gloves. The sketch provides the exact dimensions of the true chute, giving you a distinct tactical advantage. You turn your attention to a loose piece of paper pinned to the easel.

nodes.stake: You pick up the preliminary sketch, holding it up to the dim light filtering through the grating.
nodes.page: You pick up the preliminary sketch, holding it up to the dim light filtering through the grating. The drawing details the hidden security measures surrounding the vault approach, marking several blind spots in the design. You fold the sketch carefully and slide it into your pocket for later reference. The studio is otherwise empty, offering a clear path toward the upper corridors. You step toward the heavy wooden door leading out.

nodes.stake: You push open the studio door, stepping out into a wide, well-lit hallway.
nodes.page: You push open the studio door, stepping out into a wide, well-lit hallway. The floor is lined with expensive carpets, muffling the sound of your footsteps as you progress. You recognize this corridor; it leads directly toward the main portraitist's gallery. You follow the hallway, keeping an eye out for any passing patrols. You reach the ornate double doors of the gallery and pause.

exits.label: Follow the light from the door

nodes.stake: You bypass the studio and head straight for the rusted iron ladder leading to the roof access.
nodes.page: You bypass the studio and head straight for the rusted iron ladder leading to the roof access. The climb is short, bringing you to a heavy trapdoor that opens onto the Exchange's slate tiles. The cold night air hits you immediately, a stark contrast to the stifling tunnels below. You carefully step out onto the sloped roof, finding purchase on the rough shingles. You survey the Veridia skyline from your new vantage point.

nodes.stake: You approach the empty pigeon cage on the abandoned rooftop, the wire mesh rusted and broken.
nodes.page: You approach the empty pigeon cage on the abandoned rooftop, the wire mesh rusted and broken. White feathers are scattered across the floor, caught in the corners by the wind. You search the base of the cage, looking for any messages left behind by the handlers. You spot a small, metal cylinder tucked beneath a broken water dish. You retrieve the cylinder and unscrew the cap to find the message inside.

nodes.stake: You examine the pigeon cipher you found pinned to the corkboard.
nodes.page: You examine the pigeon cipher you found pinned to the corkboard. This is clearly not the first strip of the code; the sequence of numbers begins mid-sentence. The tiny, precise handwriting indicates a hastily transcribed message from a different informant. You unfurl the paper completely, holding it flat against the desk to read the numerical pattern. You begin the slow process of translating the sequence.

nodes.stake: You inspect the cipher strip, noting the distinct watermark of the Veridian press on the paper.
nodes.page: You inspect the cipher strip, noting the distinct watermark of the Veridian press on the paper. The code utilizes a complex shifting substitution, but you recognize the foundational pattern. You quickly decipher the first few words, revealing a partial warning about compromised security in the lower levels. You memorize the key phrases before folding the strip away. You turn your attention to the locked drawer of the desk.

nodes.stake: You rapidly decipher the numerical code in the leather-bound book, translating the coordinates scribbled in the margins.
nodes.page: You rapidly decipher the numerical code in the leather-bound book, translating the coordinates scribbled in the margins. The numbers correspond to specific access panels leading directly into the vault antechamber. You cross-reference the coordinates with the architectural lie you discovered earlier. The complete picture of the subterranean defenses is now clear in your mind. You pocket the codebook and prepare to move on.

nodes.stake: You read the encoded message found inside the heavy metal lockbox.
nodes.page: You read the encoded message found inside the heavy metal lockbox. The parchment details a scheduled delivery of illicit funds, completely bypassing the official Exchange ledgers. The route described perfectly matches the reinforced chute you investigated. You roll the parchment back up, securing it inside your jacket. You close the lockbox and turn back toward the corridor.

nodes.stake: You take the handwritten notes and quickly memorize the guard rotations listed on the vellum.
nodes.page: You take the handwritten notes and quickly memorize the guard rotations listed on the vellum. Knowing the exact timings gives you a significant advantage for infiltrating the antechamber. You tear the notes into tiny pieces, scattering them into the dark corners of the alcove to destroy the evidence. You turn back toward the main passage, ready to put your new knowledge to use. You step quietly out of the makeshift study.

nodes.stake: You examine the heavy leather bindings of the counter-ledgers one last time, ensuring you haven't missed any hidden compartments.
nodes.page: You examine the heavy leather bindings of the counter-ledgers one last time, ensuring you haven't missed any hidden compartments. The thick thread is unbroken, confirming the books are otherwise untouched. You stack the ledgers neatly back on the desk, leaving the room exactly as you found it. The information you've gathered is sufficient for your current objective. You quietly exit the study and head back to the main path.

nodes.stake: You approach the iron-wrought table, running your hand over the smooth, cold metal surface.
nodes.page: You approach the iron-wrought table, running your hand over the smooth, cold metal surface. A set of deep scratches mars the tabletop, forming a crude map of the immediate tunnels. You trace the lines, confirming your path toward the main vault entrance. The chair beside the table has been pushed back hastily, suggesting the watcher left in a hurry. You memorize the crude map before turning away.

nodes.stake: You inspect the wooden chair, noticing one of the legs is slightly shorter than the rest.
nodes.page: You inspect the wooden chair, noticing one of the legs is slightly shorter than the rest. The imbalance would make sitting here for long periods incredibly uncomfortable, yet the wear on the seat tells a different story. You check beneath the chair, finding a small piece of chalk taped to the underside. The chalk matches the markings you found earlier in the fissure. You leave the chair and head for the exit.

nodes.stake: You grip the heavy iron grate, bracing your feet against the wooden platform.
nodes.page: You grip the heavy iron grate, bracing your feet against the wooden platform. With a strong heave, you pull the grate free from its seating, setting it quietly aside. The dark shaft below offers a direct, vertical drop into the vault antechamber. You sit on the edge of the hole, dangling your legs into the open space. You prepare to lower yourself into the room below.

nodes.stake: You push the loose brick outward, feeling it give way and tumble into the darkness beyond.
nodes.page: You push the loose brick outward, feeling it give way and tumble into the darkness beyond. The newly created hole is just large enough for you to squeeze through. You drag yourself out of the hidden tunnel, brushing the thick dust and cobwebs from your clothes. You find yourself standing in a familiar section of the surface corridors. You adjust your gear and orient yourself to the new surroundings.

nodes.stake: You inspect the second candle closely, noting the distinct smell of beeswax and sulfur lingering in the air.
nodes.page: You inspect the second candle closely, noting the distinct smell of beeswax and sulfur lingering in the air. This garret is geographically distant from the first, yet the setup implies a synchronized signal. Someone is using these candles to communicate across the upper levels of the Exchange. You gently touch the wick, finding it completely cold. You step back to survey the rest of the small room.

nodes.stake: You examine the pooled wax on the sill, picking off a loose flake to inspect the color.
nodes.page: You examine the pooled wax on the sill, picking off a loose flake to inspect the color. The wax is dyed a deep crimson, identical to the candle in the other garret. This confirms the signaling system is intentional and highly coordinated. You crush the wax flake between your fingers, letting the pieces fall to the floor. You turn your attention to the small window offering a view of the city.

nodes.stake: You inspect the artist's wax left behind on the easel, picking up a small, hardened lump.
nodes.page: You inspect the artist's wax left behind on the easel, picking up a small, hardened lump. The wax was used to seal the ends of the charcoal sticks, preventing them from smudging in the damp air. You toss the lump back onto the tray, satisfied the supplies hold no further secrets. The studio is otherwise barren, stripped of any useful tools or documents. You decide to press on toward the upper levels.

nodes.stake: You examine the burnt wick of the studio candle, rubbing the charred string between your fingers.
nodes.page: You examine the burnt wick of the studio candle, rubbing the charred string between your fingers. The soot is thick and greasy, indicating the candle was snuffed out recently rather than burning down naturally. The artist must have abandoned their work in a hurry, likely tipped off to approaching guards. You wipe the soot from your fingers onto a discarded rag. You turn toward the heavy door leading to the gallery.

nodes.stake: You follow the light spilling from the open doorway, stepping cautiously into the ornate gallery hall.
nodes.page: You follow the light spilling from the open doorway, stepping cautiously into the ornate gallery hall. The walls are lined with grand portraits of Veridia's elite, their painted eyes seeming to follow your every move. You keep to the shadows, moving silently across the thick, velvet carpet. The path leads directly to the main portraitist's studio at the end of the hall. You approach the heavy oak doors, preparing to enter.

nodes.stake: You examine the rough slate tile beneath your boots, testing its stability on the sloped roof.
nodes.page: You examine the rough slate tile beneath your boots, testing its stability on the sloped roof. The tile holds firm, allowing you to traverse the dangerous incline with relative ease. You make your way across the Exchange ridge, keeping low to avoid detection from the streets below. The wind howls across the rooftops, threatening to throw you off balance. You press forward toward the next access point.

nodes.stake: You pick up the pristine white feather from the rooftop, twirling it between your fingers.
nodes.page: You pick up the pristine white feather from the rooftop, twirling it between your fingers. The feather is completely intact, suggesting a recent arrival at the abandoned cage. You tuck the feather into your pocket as a token of your investigation. The empty cage offers no further clues, its rusted wire mesh completely barren. You turn back toward the trapdoor to descend.

nodes.stake: You unravel the cipher strip completely, noting the tiny symbol of a soaring bird stamped in the corner.
nodes.page: You unravel the cipher strip completely, noting the tiny symbol of a soaring bird stamped in the corner. The stamp confirms the message was delivered via the rooftop pigeon network. You fold the strip and secure it in your jacket, preserving the crucial intelligence it contains. The communications room holds nothing else of value for your mission. You exit the room, leaving the door unlocked behind you.

nodes.stake: You examine the small lockbox hidden in the desk drawer, testing the strength of its hinges.
nodes.page: You examine the small lockbox hidden in the desk drawer, testing the strength of its hinges. The box is solidly built, requiring a key you do not possess to open it peacefully. You decide against forcing the lock, unwilling to make unnecessary noise in the quiet tunnels. You slide the drawer shut, leaving the lockbox undisturbed. You turn your attention to the exit.

nodes.stake: You inspect the heavy iron latch securing the service panel, finding it remarkably free of rust.
nodes.page: You inspect the heavy iron latch securing the service panel, finding it remarkably free of rust. You lift the latch smoothly, pulling the panel open to reveal a direct sightline into the vault antechamber. The vantage point allows you to observe the patrol patterns without exposing yourself. You watch the guards for several minutes, memorizing their strict routine. You close the panel quietly and prepare your next move.

nodes.stake: You examine the narrow garret window, wiping the grime from the glass to peer outside.
nodes.page: You examine the narrow garret window, wiping the grime from the glass to peer outside. The window offers a perfect line of sight to the eastern tower, proving the location was chosen for visual signaling. You test the latch, finding it rusted shut from years of neglect. The window cannot be opened without breaking the glass, which would attract unwanted attention. You step back from the sill, leaving the window intact.

nodes.stake: You inspect the wooden windowsill, noting the deep gouges carved into the wood.
nodes.page: You inspect the wooden windowsill, noting the deep gouges carved into the wood. The marks look like tallies, tracking the number of times the candle signal was lit and answered. You count the marks, finding a consistent pattern that aligns with the cabal's meeting schedule. The information is useful, confirming the frequency of their clandestine gatherings. You turn away from the window, ready to move on.

nodes.stake: You examine the cracked window glass, noticing a small hole near the bottom corner.
nodes.page: You examine the cracked window glass, noticing a small hole near the bottom corner. The hole is too small for a person, but perfectly sized to pass a thin wire or a rolled message through. You trace the edges of the glass, careful not to cut yourself on the sharp shards. The setup implies a secondary method of communication if the visual signal failed. You step away from the window, satisfied with your findings.

nodes.stake: You check the heavy wooden shutter attached to the exterior of the garret window.
nodes.page: You check the heavy wooden shutter attached to the exterior of the garret window. The hinges are well-oiled, allowing the shutter to swing freely without making a sound. You pull the shutter closed, plunging the small room into complete darkness. The action confirms the signal could be hidden quickly if patrols approached the area. You push the shutter open again, letting the moonlight back in.

nodes.stake: You examine the rotting window frame, digging your fingers into the soft, spongy wood.
nodes.page: You examine the rotting window frame, digging your fingers into the soft, spongy wood. A small, hollow cavity is hidden within the frame, large enough to stash a small object. You reach inside and pull out a tiny, sealed vial of black ink. The ink matches the precise hue used on the cipher strips you discovered earlier. You place the vial back into the cavity, leaving the hidden stash undisturbed.

nodes.stake: You step through the heavy side door, leaving the noise of the foundry behind.
nodes.page: You step through the heavy side door, leaving the noise of the foundry behind. The Veridia fog clings to your coat, masking your solitary figure in the pale morning light. Houses that once tread carefully around you and Sable now see only a single man holding a heavy ledger. You trace the binding of the book, feeling the weight of the secrets pressed between its pages. The path ahead splits between the shadow of the Exchange roofs and the winding cobblestones leading toward the opera.

nodes.stake: The slate shingles of the Exchange roofs are slick with morning dew.
nodes.page: The slate shingles of the Exchange roofs are slick with morning dew. You move carefully across the incline, feeling the chill bite through your leather gloves. Beneath a loose slate near the chimney, you find a small bundle of letters wrapped in oilcloth. You have not opened them yet, but the wax seal matches the insignia of the Silk Annex. Leaving them hidden seems foolish when knowledge is your only leverage today.

nodes.stake: The cobblestones near the opera are dusted with a fine, gray residue from a recent festival.
nodes.page: The cobblestones near the opera are dusted with a fine, gray residue from a recent festival. This flash-powder street crackles faintly under your boots, a volatile reminder of the city's restless energy. You navigate the narrow alleyways, keeping the grand dome of the opera house in your peripheral vision. Ahead, a wrought-iron gate blocks the most direct route to the harbor colossus. You can either scale the adjacent wall or attempt to pick the heavy padlock.

nodes.stake: The letters contain shipping manifests and a single name circled in red ink.
nodes.page: The letters contain shipping manifests and a single name circled in red ink. This must be the name Matron Rigg fears, a ghost from the old syndicate days long thought dead. Memorizing the syllables, you fold the parchment and tuck it into your vest. Knowledge of this phantom gives you a distinct advantage if you encounter her enforcers. You continue across the rooftops, nearing a narrow gap between the Exchange and a dilapidated tailor shop.

nodes.stake: The sealed bundle goes into your coat, a mystery saved for a more desperate moment.
nodes.page: The sealed bundle goes into your coat, a mystery saved for a more desperate moment. You slide down the sloped roof, dropping onto a narrow balcony overlooking the tailor's courtyard. The morning air smells of chemical dye and wet wool. You spot an open window leading into the tailor's storage room, offering a quiet route through the building. Alternatively, the balcony connects to a rusted fire escape descending directly to the street.

nodes.stake: The bricks are cold, but the crumbling mortar provides deep handholds for your ascent.
nodes.page: The bricks are cold, but the crumbling mortar provides deep handholds for your ascent. You haul yourself over the top, dropping into a small gable nest overlooking the square. There is no sniper in it, only the remnants of discarded brass and a clear view of the vault's entrance. From here, the path splits along a precarious cornice or drops into the shadows of the alley below. The ledger weighs heavily against your ribs as you assess the drop.

nodes.stake: The lock clicks open after a few tense seconds of manipulation.
nodes.page: The lock clicks open after a few tense seconds of manipulation. You slip through the gate, entering a narrow corridor of high stone walls that amplify your footsteps. The flash-powder residue is thicker here, coating the base of the walls in a pale frost. At the end of the passage, a heavy wooden door stands ajar, revealing a staircase winding upward. You can hear the distant, rhythmic ticking of the city's main clock tower.

nodes.stake: You clear the gap with a quiet thud, landing softly on the tailor's flat roof.
nodes.page: You clear the gap with a quiet thud, landing softly on the tailor's flat roof. The ledger shifts awkwardly in your coat, reminding you of the target currently painted on your back. You move toward the edge, looking down at the bustling market square beginning to wake. A series of canvas awnings provides a potential path down, but they look frail and weathered. The alternative is a solid iron drainpipe clinging to the brickwork.

nodes.stake: You reach the street level without drawing attention from the early morning merchants.
nodes.page: You reach the street level without drawing attention from the early morning merchants. The cobblestones guide you toward the towering silhouette of the harbor colossus in the distance. Without Sable to watch your flank, every shadow stretching across the pavement seems a little longer. You pass a small tea house, noticing a figure in a heavy cloak watching you from a corner table. They make a subtle gesture toward a narrow alley beside the shop.

exits.label: Follow the figure into the alley

nodes.stake: The storage room is dark and smells strongly of camphor and old fabric.
nodes.page: The storage room is dark and smells strongly of camphor and old fabric. You navigate carefully between towering bolts of silk and velvet, keeping your steps light. A crack of light under the main door reveals shadows moving in the hallway outside. You hear low voices discussing a stolen ledger, confirming the Houses are actively hunting you. You must decide whether to slip out a side vent or force your way through the hall.

exits.label: Open the door and confront them

nodes.stake: The cornice is narrow, forcing you to press your back against the cold stone.
nodes.page: The cornice is narrow, forcing you to press your back against the cold stone. You inch along the building's face, the severe drop to the street pulling at your nerves. A sudden gust of wind threatens your balance, but you grip the masonry tighter. You reach a small balcony attached to the press building, its glass doors slightly open. Stepping inside offers shelter, but staying on the exterior keeps you off the main corridors.

nodes.stake: You land in the alley with a soft crunch of gravel underfoot.
nodes.page: You land in the alley with a soft crunch of gravel underfoot. The shadows here are deep, offering a brief respite from the exposed rooftops above. A discarded broadsheet on the ground details the recent upheaval at the foundry. You step over it, moving toward the heavy rear entrance of the city vault. The reinforced steel door requires a numerical combination you memorized from the ledger.

exits.label: Bypass the vault for the harbor

nodes.stake: The staircase leads you higher into the skeletal framework of the clock tower.
nodes.page: The staircase leads you higher into the skeletal framework of the clock tower. The massive gears grind above you, a deafening mechanical heartbeat echoing in your chest. This clock-face climb is treacherous, with thick grease coating the narrow wooden steps. You reach a platform behind the translucent glass of the clock face, offering a sprawling view of Veridia. Below, you see enforcers gathering near the opera, confirming your path is blocked.

nodes.stake: The ground floor is cluttered with discarded tools and crates of intricate clockwork parts.
nodes.page: The ground floor is cluttered with discarded tools and crates of intricate clockwork parts. You search quickly, finding nothing but dust and the sharp smell of old oil. The shadows shift, and you realize someone has followed you through the wrought-iron gate. You press yourself against a tall stack of crates, gripping the heavy ledger like a shield. The intruder's footsteps are slow and deliberate on the bare stone floor.

nodes.stake: The first awning holds your weight briefly before tearing with a sharp rip.
nodes.page: The first awning holds your weight briefly before tearing with a sharp rip. You scramble down, using the fabric to slow your descent, and hit the ground hard. Pain shoots up your leg, but you force yourself into a sprint as a merchant shouts in protest. You duck into an adjacent alleyway, leaning against the damp brick wall to recover. The path ahead leads directly toward the Silk Annex, where your enemies wait.

nodes.stake: The drainpipe holds firm as you slide down to the damp cobblestones.
nodes.page: The drainpipe holds firm as you slide down to the damp cobblestones. You dust off your coat, adjusting the ledger hidden safely beneath your lapel. A carriage rattles past, splashing gray water against the lower brickwork. You step out of the shadows, blending with the early morning commuters heading toward the press. Blending in is your only defense now that you walk completely alone.

nodes.stake: You step into the alley, and the cloaked figure approaches with their hands empty and visible.
nodes.page: You step into the alley, and the cloaked figure approaches with their hands empty and visible. They offer a simple proposition: safe passage to the upper city in exchange for a seat on the upcoming council. It is a seat offered as price for your survival, a high cost for a momentary advantage. You weigh the heavy ledger against the prospect of giving up political ground to a stranger. Accepting means an easier route to the vault; refusing means fighting your way there.

nodes.stake: You ignore the gesture, keeping your pace steady and your eyes focused forward.
nodes.page: You ignore the gesture, keeping your pace steady and your eyes focused forward. The harbor colossus looms closer, its towering bronze features obscured by the morning fog. The air smells strongly of salt and rotting fish as you enter the busy dockyards. A group of dockworkers blocks the main pier, arguing loudly over a shipping manifest. You can try to weave through the angry crowd or circle around the vast warehouses.

nodes.stake: The vent is a tight squeeze, scraping the heavy leather of your coat.
nodes.page: The vent is a tight squeeze, scraping the heavy leather of your coat. You emerge in a narrow alleyway behind the tailor's shop, breathing the cold air deeply. The ledger is safe, but your hands are covered in black soot from the exhaust. You move swiftly down the alley, heading toward the neutral territory of the central plaza. The plaza offers multiple routes, but it is heavily patrolled by the city guard.

nodes.stake: You kick the door open, the heavy wood slamming against the corridor wall with a crack.
nodes.page: You kick the door open, the heavy wood slamming against the corridor wall with a crack. The two men turn, their hands dropping to their belts, but you do not hesitate. You drive your shoulder into the first man, sending him crashing into the plaster. The second hesitates, giving you a crucial second to sprint down the narrow hallway. You burst through a side exit, tumbling out onto a low rooftop.

nodes.stake: The press building is filled with the rhythmic clatter of massive printing machines.
nodes.page: The press building is filled with the rhythmic clatter of massive printing machines. Workers move hurriedly, ignoring the solitary man walking briskly through the rows of presses. You slip past the main floor and head for the administrative offices in the back. Here, the ledger's information could be reproduced and scattered to the winds. However, doing so would alert every House to your exact location within minutes.

exits.label: Use a press to copy the ledger

nodes.stake: You follow the ledge until it terminates at a rusted iron ladder.
nodes.page: You follow the ledge until it terminates at a rusted iron ladder. The ladder descends into an enclosed courtyard littered with broken crates and refuse. You climb down quickly, your boots echoing softly on the metal rungs. At the bottom, a heavy iron door stands slightly open, leading into the lower levels of the foundry. Returning to the foundry is dangerous, but it might provide the temporary shelter you need.

nodes.stake: You dial the combination, and the heavy vault door swings open with a slow groan.
nodes.page: You dial the combination, and the heavy vault door swings open with a slow groan. Inside, rows of lockboxes line the walls, untouched and silent. You locate box 404, matching a key hidden within the spine of the ledger. Opening it reveals a stack of bearer bonds and a map detailing a secure route out of Veridia. The resources are substantial, but taking them marks you definitively as a thief.

exits.label: Leave them and just take the map

nodes.stake: The harbor path is wide and exposed, flanked by towering bronze statues of forgotten founders.
nodes.page: The harbor path is wide and exposed, flanked by towering bronze statues of forgotten founders. The colossus stands at the end of the pier, its massive shadow falling over the dark water. You reach the base of the statue, seeking the hidden entrance detailed in the ledger. A small panel in the bronze heel slides away, revealing a dark, descending staircase. The air below smells of stagnant water and ancient, grinding machinery.

nodes.stake: The climb to the belfry tests your endurance, your lungs burning in the thin, cold air.
nodes.page: The climb to the belfry tests your endurance, your lungs burning in the thin, cold air. You step onto the wooden platform beside the massive bronze bell just as it begins to toll. The vibrations rattle your teeth and blur your vision, masking any sound of approach. When the ringing stops, you see a lone enforcer standing at the top of the stairs, gripping a heavy wrench. You have no space to run, and the ledger hinders your movement.

exits.label: Throw the ledger to distract him

nodes.stake: The lower catwalk wraps around the central gearing mechanism of the massive tower.
nodes.page: The lower catwalk wraps around the central gearing mechanism of the massive tower. You move carefully along the grating, the severe drop below obscured by grease and shadows. A maintenance hatch offers a way out onto the steep slate roof of the adjacent building. Alternatively, the catwalk spirals further down into the tower's flooded basement. The basement connects to the old aqueducts, offering a damp but entirely hidden path.

nodes.stake: You wait until the intruder steps past your hiding spot, then lunge from the shadows.
nodes.page: You wait until the intruder steps past your hiding spot, then lunge from the shadows. You drive your elbow into their ribs, knocking the wind out of them instantly. They collapse onto a wooden crate, gasping for breath as you secure their wrists with a stray piece of wire. A quick search of their pockets reveals a writ signed by Matron Rigg. You leave them tied and hurry toward the stairs, your advantage temporarily restored.

nodes.stake: The Silk Annex looms ahead, its intricate façade hiding a labyrinth of deadly politics.
nodes.page: The Silk Annex looms ahead, its intricate façade hiding a labyrinth of deadly politics. You walk through the front doors, the ledger held tightly under your arm. The guards recognize you instantly, their hands moving to their sides in subtle warning. You demand to see the overseer, knowing this direct approach is a massive, desperate gamble. The heavy doors close behind you with a finalizing thud.

nodes.stake: You nod, accepting the offered seat and the heavy political compromise it represents.
nodes.page: You nod, accepting the offered seat and the heavy political compromise it represents. The figure hands you a brass token and details a route through the sewers that bypasses the checkpoints. You pocket the token, feeling the weight of the debt settling on your shoulders. The sewer entrance is just a block away, hidden beneath a heavy iron grate. You lift the grate and descend into the foul-smelling darkness.

exits.label: Turn back at the last second

nodes.stake: You turn your back on the figure, rejecting the compromise and the debt it carries.
nodes.page: You turn your back on the figure, rejecting the compromise and the debt it carries. The path ahead is harder now, but your autonomy remains completely intact. You navigate the winding streets, relying solely on the information within the ledger. A patrol of guards approaches from the opposite direction, their heavy boots loud on the cobblestones. You must find a way around them before they spot you.

exits.label: Climb a lamppost to the lower roof

nodes.stake: You push your way into the throng of dockworkers, keeping your head down to avoid attention.
nodes.page: You push your way into the throng of dockworkers, keeping your head down to avoid attention. The smell of unwashed bodies and strong tobacco masks your presence in the crowd. You bump into a burly foreman who curses loudly, but you slip past before a fight breaks out. Emerging on the other side, you find yourself at the edge of the water, near a small rowboat. The boat could take you across the harbor entirely unseen.

nodes.stake: Circling the warehouses takes longer, but keeps you away from the volatile crowd on the docks.
nodes.page: Circling the warehouses takes longer, but keeps you away from the volatile crowd on the docks. You walk through the narrow alleys between the massive storage buildings, the air thick with dust. A side door to warehouse number four is slightly ajar, revealing towering stacks of imported silk. This belongs to the Annex, and tampering here would be a dangerous provocation. The main path continues toward the shadow of the colossus.

nodes.stake: The central plaza is a vast expanse of polished stone and nervous morning energy.
nodes.page: The central plaza is a vast expanse of polished stone and nervous morning energy. You walk briskly, trying to mimic the hurried pace of the commuters heading to the exchange. A guard at the fountain locks eyes with you, his hand dropping to his side. You do not break stride, trusting the crowds to shield your exit. You reach the far side just as a shout rings out behind you.

nodes.stake: You hug the edge of the plaza, keeping to the deep shadows of the colonnades.
nodes.page: You hug the edge of the plaza, keeping to the deep shadows of the colonnades. The guards ignore the periphery, their attention focused entirely on the main thoroughfares. You slip past a beggar, dropping a coin into his cup to ensure his absolute silence. The colonnade ends at a steep set of stairs leading toward Eclipse Rise. Climbing them brings you closer to the heart of the territory you just fled.

nodes.stake: Your boots pound against the tarred roof as you sprint toward the edge of the building.
nodes.page: Your boots pound against the tarred roof as you sprint toward the edge of the building. You leap over a low parapet, landing hard on the adjoining flat roof. The pursuit sounds distant now, but you know they will fan out to find you soon. The ledger feels heavier with every step, a constant reminder of the danger you carry alone. You drop down into a narrow service alley, breathing heavily.

exits.label: Keep moving toward the solo final

nodes.stake: You dive behind a massive chimney stack just as a head pops up over the roof edge.
nodes.page: You dive behind a massive chimney stack just as a head pops up over the roof edge. You hold your breath, the ledger pressed flat against your pounding chest. The pursuer scans the rooftop, curses loudly, and descends back into the building. You remain frozen for a long minute before daring to move from your cover. The path to the faction lines is clear, provided you stay entirely out of sight.

exits.label: Head for the Eclipse ridgeline instead

nodes.stake: You locate an idle press and quickly set the type for the ledger's most damning page.
nodes.page: You locate an idle press and quickly set the type for the ledger's most damning page. The machine clatters to life, stamping the secret onto fifty fresh, ink-smudged broadsheets. You grab the stack, scattering them across the main floor as you run for the exit. Chaos erupts behind you as workers scramble to read the freshly printed scandals. You slip out the back door, leaving a trail of political ruin in your wake.

nodes.stake: The back door opens into a narrow alley choked with discarded paper and empty ink barrels.
nodes.page: The back door opens into a narrow alley choked with discarded paper and empty ink barrels. You move quickly, the absolute silence of the alley a sharp contrast to the noisy press room. A faint scraping sound above makes you look up, but the rooftops appear completely empty. You reach the end of the alley, facing the steep incline leading to Eclipse Rise. The climb is exposed, but it offers a direct route out of the lower city.

exits.label: Turn back toward the faction letters

nodes.stake: You move past the foundry doors, opting to remain in the unpredictable but open streets.
nodes.page: You move past the foundry doors, opting to remain in the unpredictable but open streets. The courtyard funnels into a narrow passage lined with derelict, crumbling buildings. A rusted gate blocks the exit, secured with a heavy chain and padlock. You can try to force the gate with a discarded iron bar lying nearby. Alternatively, you might be able to squeeze through a gap in the surrounding chain-link fence.

nodes.stake: You sweep the bearer bonds and the map into your heavy coat.
nodes.page: You sweep the bearer bonds and the map into your heavy coat. The sudden wealth is a buffer against the hardships to come, but the theft is a severe escalation. You close the lockbox, ensuring the vault looks undisturbed before slipping out quietly. The map directs you toward a hidden smuggler's path along the Eclipse ridgeline. With the ledger and the bonds, you have everything you need to completely vanish.

exits.label: Follow the map to the ridgeline
Head directly for the final exit

nodes.stake: You take only the map, leaving the bonds untouched in the cold metal box.
nodes.page: You take only the map, leaving the bonds untouched in the cold metal box. Restraint might buy you a sliver of leniency if you are caught, though you doubt it. You close the vault and study the parchment under the dim corridor light. The route details a precarious path up the Eclipse ridgeline, avoiding all known guard checkpoints. You fold the map, your solitary path forward finally clear.

nodes.stake: The stairs inside the colossus groan under your weight as you slowly descend.
nodes.page: The stairs inside the colossus groan under your weight as you slowly descend. The air grows colder, smelling heavily of brine and oxidized copper from the walls. You reach a small chamber at the base of the statue, housing a complex series of ancient gears. The ledger indicates this mechanism controls a hidden exit beneath the water line. You examine the rusted levers, knowing a single mistake could flood the chamber entirely.

exits.label: Attempt to manually turn the gears

nodes.stake: You stay on the pier, the cold wind whipping off the dark harbor waters.
nodes.page: You stay on the pier, the cold wind whipping off the dark harbor waters. The colossus offers no sanctuary today, merely standing as a silent, unhelpful witness. A group of enforcers appears at the far end of the pier, their long coats snapping in the wind. You have nowhere left to run, only the hard wood of the pier beneath your boots. You grip the ledger, preparing for the final, brutal confrontation.

nodes.stake: You drive your shoulder into the enforcer's chest before he can swing the heavy wrench.
nodes.page: You drive your shoulder into the enforcer's chest before he can swing the heavy wrench. The impact sends you both tumbling onto the hard wooden planks of the platform. You scramble up first, kicking the wrench over the edge into the darkness far below. The enforcer groans, clutching his ribs, offering you a brief window to escape. The only way forward is down the exterior bamboo scaffolding.

nodes.stake: You hurl the heavy ledger directly at his face, startling him completely.
nodes.page: You hurl the heavy ledger directly at his face, startling him completely. He raises his arms to deflect it, giving you the brief moment you need to slip past. You snatch the book off the floor as you dive down the narrow stairwell. His angry shouts echo down the shaft, but you are already descending rapidly. You burst out into the street, breathless but entirely unharmed.

nodes.stake: The hatch groans as you push it open, revealing the steep slate roof.
nodes.page: The hatch groans as you push it open, revealing the steep slate roof. You crawl out, the severe angle forcing you to move on your hands and knees. The wind is fierce up here, threatening to peel you off the building entirely. You inch toward a neighboring roof, hoping to find a safer descent to the streets. The sprawling city below looks both beautiful and deadly from this precarious height.

exits.label: Find a window to break into

nodes.stake: The basement is flooded with ankle-deep, freezing water that soaks your boots immediately.
nodes.page: The basement is flooded with ankle-deep, freezing water that soaks your boots immediately. You wade through the murk, the sound of the clock tower muffled by the heavy stone ceiling. The ledger details a connection here to the old aqueducts, a forgotten network beneath Veridia. You find a crumbling archway leading into absolute, impenetrable darkness. Lighting a match reveals a long, vaulted tunnel stretching out of sight.

nodes.stake: You leave the building quickly, stepping back onto the pale flash-powder street.
nodes.page: You leave the building quickly, stepping back onto the pale flash-powder street. The encounter has sharpened your senses, making every shadow look highly suspicious. You need to reach the faction lines before Matron Rigg's remaining enforcers coordinate a proper search. You take a narrow shortcut through a dilapidated, empty market square. The path leads straight toward the drop-off point for the sealed letters.

nodes.stake: You drop your shoulder and violently shove past the startled guards at the door.
nodes.page: You drop your shoulder and violently shove past the startled guards at the door. You sprint down the opulent hallway of the Silk Annex, boots sinking into thick, expensive carpets. Shouts erupt behind you, but you know the layout perfectly from the ledger's diagrams. You crash through a set of double doors, arriving in a quiet, sunlit study. Now, you must find the hidden exit before they breach the room.

nodes.stake: The sewers are vile, thick with the overwhelming stench of rot and industrial runoff.
nodes.page: The sewers are vile, thick with the overwhelming stench of rot and industrial runoff. You trudge along a narrow stone walkway, following the crude map etched on the brass token. Rats scatter ahead of your boots, the only movement in the oppressive gloom. An iron ladder eventually leads up to a street-level grate near the faction borders. Pushing it open, you emerge into the clean, cold night air.

nodes.stake: You slip into a dimly lit apothecary, the air heavy with dried herbs and sulfur.
nodes.page: You slip into a dimly lit apothecary, the air heavy with dried herbs and sulfur. The shopkeeper barely looks up from his mortar as you press yourself against the front window. You watch the patrol march past, their halberds glinting sharply in the streetlights. When the street is clear, you step back out, the ledger safe under your arm. The path to the solo final is now completely open.

nodes.stake: You scale the ornate lamppost, hauling yourself onto the flat roof of a low tenement.
nodes.page: You scale the ornate lamppost, hauling yourself onto the flat roof of a low tenement. You lie flat against the tar paper as the patrol passes directly below you. Their voices drift up, confirming they are actively searching for a lone man with a book. Once they are gone, you stand up and brush the dirt from your coat. The rooftops offer a straight, unimpeded run to the Eclipse ridgeline.

exits.label: Drop down and head for the letters

nodes.stake: The rowboat is untethered and wooden oars sit ready on the floorboards.
nodes.page: The rowboat is untethered and wooden oars sit ready on the floorboards. You push off, the strong current catching the small craft immediately. Rowing across the dark harbor water, the towering colossus watches your slow progress. You reach a secluded slipway on the far side, far from the searching guards. The final leg of your solitary journey awaits just up the stone steps.

exits.label: Check your letters one last time

nodes.stake: You abandon the boat idea and walk along the slippery wooden docks instead.
nodes.page: You abandon the boat idea and walk along the slippery wooden docks instead. The waves crash against the pilings, completely drowning out the sound of your footsteps. You locate a drainage pipe large enough to walk through, cutting under the dock authority building. It is a foul, dark path, but it guarantees you remain unseen. You emerge close to the final rendezvous point.

nodes.stake: The warehouse is vast and echoing, filled with wooden crates stamped with the Silk House crest.
nodes.page: The warehouse is vast and echoing, filled with wooden crates stamped with the Silk House crest. You navigate the maze of boxes, feeling the tension rise with every single step. You spot an overseer's office elevated above the floor, its glass windows completely dark. Accessing it might yield more secrets, but it significantly delays your escape. You must choose between gathering intelligence or preserving your narrowing lead.

nodes.stake: You bolt down a narrow alley, kicking over a stack of empty crates to slow pursuit.
nodes.page: You bolt down a narrow alley, kicking over a stack of empty crates to slow pursuit. The guards' heavy armor clatters as they struggle over the wooden obstacle. You take a sharp left, then a rapid right, losing yourself in the labyrinthine slums. The shouts fade into the distance, leaving you alone with the rhythmic thumping of your heart. The path to the foundry is entirely clear from here.

nodes.stake: You duck into a crowded tavern, the smell of cheap ale and sweat washing over you.
nodes.page: You duck into a crowded tavern, the smell of cheap ale and sweat washing over you. You blend into the rowdy crowd near the hearth, keeping your face turned toward the fire. Two guards burst through the door, their eyes aggressively scanning the room. A drunken patron stumbles into them, sparking a loud argument that distracts them completely. You slip out the back door while the chaos unfolds.

nodes.stake: You find a narrow alley winding away from the plaza, smelling of old rain and garbage.
nodes.page: You find a narrow alley winding away from the plaza, smelling of old rain and garbage. The path is tight, forcing you to turn sideways to squeeze past a bricked-up window. You emerge in a quiet residential district, the tall houses dark and silent. A cobblestone path leads upward toward the higher tiers of the city. You adjust your grip on the ledger and begin the long climb.

nodes.stake: The alley is quiet, save for the constant dripping of a broken pipe.
nodes.page: The alley is quiet, save for the constant dripping of a broken pipe. You lean against the damp brick, pulling the cold Veridia air into your burning lungs. The ledger feels heavy in your hands, a constant burden you cannot simply drop. You wipe sweat from your brow and review your dwindling options. The faction lines are close, but the solo path offers a definitive end.

nodes.stake: You wedge the iron bar into the padlock and heave with all your remaining strength.
nodes.page: You wedge the iron bar into the padlock and heave with all your remaining strength. The rusted metal groans before snapping with a loud crack that echoes in the courtyard. You push the gate open, stepping into a deserted street leading toward the industrial district. The noise has undoubtedly attracted attention, forcing you to move quickly. The foundry looms ahead, its massive smokestacks dark against the sky.

nodes.stake: You find a section of the fence where the iron bars are violently bent outwards.
nodes.page: You find a section of the fence where the iron bars are violently bent outwards. You exhale sharply and force yourself through the narrow gap, tearing the sleeve of your coat. You stumble into the street, dusting off the rust and grime from your shoulders. A carriage rumbles past, its distracted driver oblivious to your presence. The path ahead splits between the high ridgeline and the letters drop.

nodes.stake: You grasp the heavy iron lever and pull downwards with your full body weight.
nodes.page: You grasp the heavy iron lever and pull downwards with your full body weight. Machinery grinds in the walls, a deep vibration violently shaking the stone floor. A circular hatch in the center of the room slowly irises open, revealing dark water below. A small submersible pod bobs in the current, big enough for only one person. This is the desperate escape route the ledger promised.

exits.label: Leave it and find another way

nodes.stake: You wedge a metal bar into the main gear and push, attempting to manually force the mechanism.
nodes.page: You wedge a metal bar into the main gear and push, attempting to manually force the mechanism. The gears screech in loud protest, shedding flakes of rust, but they do not turn. Suddenly, a loud snap echoes through the chamber as the bar breaks cleanly in your hands. The mechanism is jammed permanently, cutting off this escape route entirely. You must retreat up the stairs before someone investigates the noise.

exits.label: Search the room for another exit

nodes.stake: You take a running leap off the pier, plunging into the freezing, murky water of the harbor.
nodes.page: You take a running leap off the pier, plunging into the freezing, murky water of the harbor. The severe cold shocks your system, but you swim furiously, putting distance between yourself and the pier. You surface beneath the wooden supports of a neighboring dock, gasping loudly for air. The enforcers' flashlights sweep the water, but you remain securely hidden in the shadows. You pull yourself up onto a slippery ladder.

nodes.stake: You swing over the edge, your boots finding the rickety bamboo scaffolding.
nodes.page: You swing over the edge, your boots finding the rickety bamboo scaffolding. You descend rapidly, the fragile structure swaying dangerously under your shifting weight. You reach the ground level and sprint into the nearest alley, leaving the cursing enforcer far above. The physical toll is heavy, but you have maintained your solitary advantage. The final rendezvous is just a few quiet streets away.

nodes.stake: You step firmly on his injured ribs, demanding to know exactly who sent him.
nodes.page: You step firmly on his injured ribs, demanding to know exactly who sent him. He spits blood and croaks a single, damning name: Matron Rigg. It confirms your worst fears; the old alliances are entirely broken. You leave him groaning on the platform and take the stairs down at a dead run. You need to reach the solo final before she springs her inevitable trap.

nodes.stake: You back up slightly and launch yourself across the terrifying gap between the buildings.
nodes.page: You back up slightly and launch yourself across the terrifying gap between the buildings. For a suspended second, the hard streets of Veridia spin dizzily below you. You slam into the adjacent slate roof, sliding backward until your boots hit the metal gutter. You lie there, heart hammering, profoundly grateful for your continued survival. The ridgeline is now accessible from this block.

nodes.stake: You inch toward a small attic window and smash the fragile glass with your boot.
nodes.page: You inch toward a small attic window and smash the fragile glass with your boot. Unlatching it, you slide inside, escaping the howling wind on the exposed roof. The attic is dusty and filled with forgotten furniture, completely silent and still. A trapdoor leads down into the building, offering a safer path to the street level. You check the ledger, ensuring no pages were lost in the chaotic struggle.

nodes.stake: The aqueduct is oppressive, the low arched ceiling pressing down on you.
