nodes.page: The aqueduct is oppressive, the low arched ceiling pressing down on you. The water is freezing, numbing your legs as you wade deeper into the forgotten system. You follow a series of ancient maintenance markers etched deeply into the stone walls. After what feels like hours, you see a faint grate of light above, signaling an exit. You climb a rusted ladder, emerging near the faction drop.

exits.label: Bypass the drop for the solo final

nodes.stake: You pull at a heavy volume on the shelf, desperately hoping for a concealed lever.
nodes.page: You pull at a heavy volume on the shelf, desperately hoping for a concealed lever. Nothing happens, and the angry shouts in the hallway grow significantly louder. Frustrated, you kick the base of the bookcase, revealing a hollow sound behind the wood paneling. You pry the panel away just as the study doors burst open behind you. You dive into the narrow passageway, pulling the panel shut.

nodes.stake: You tear the heavy rug back, exposing a polished hardwood floor.
nodes.page: You tear the heavy rug back, exposing a polished hardwood floor. A small brass ring sits flush with the boards, hidden perfectly beneath the weave. You pull it, opening a trapdoor that drops into a dark, steep chute. Without hesitation, you slide into the darkness just as the guards enter the room. You land hard on a pile of laundry in the deep basement.

nodes.stake: You leave the warehouse, stepping back into the damp, salty harbor air.
nodes.page: You leave the warehouse, stepping back into the damp, salty harbor air. The decision to ignore the office preserves your momentum but leaves important questions unanswered. You walk briskly toward the looming structure of the colossus at the pier's end. The fog is thickening rapidly, hiding the enforcers that surely patrol the waterfront. Your solitary journey is nearing its inevitable conclusion.

nodes.stake: You step away from the pod, unwilling to trust your life to the ancient mechanism.
nodes.page: You step away from the pod, unwilling to trust your life to the ancient mechanism. The water laps at the edges of the open hatch, a dark and unwelcoming abyss. You turn back to the stairs, determined to find a route over land instead. The climb back up is slow, your legs burning from the day's constant exertion. You emerge from the colossus, facing the cold harbor winds once more.

nodes.stake: You hurry back up the spiraling staircase, the silence of the colossus pressing in.
nodes.page: You hurry back up the spiraling staircase, the silence of the colossus pressing in. The jammed gears below mean your intended escape route is entirely useless. You reach the bronze doorway and peer out onto the wooden pier. The fog has rolled in heavily, obscuring the harbor and any potential pursuers. You must navigate the slick wooden docks to reach the mainland.

exits.label: Move through the fog to the final

nodes.stake: You frantically search the gear chamber, sweeping your hands over the cold stone walls.
nodes.page: You frantically search the gear chamber, sweeping your hands over the cold stone walls. Behind a rusted pipe, you find a narrow ventilation shaft leading upward. It is a tight fit, but sheer desperation forces you to squeeze inside. You crawl through the dust and cobwebs, ascending slowly toward the surface. You kick out a grate and tumble onto the cobblestones near the pier.

nodes.stake: You push off the pilings, swimming parallel to the shoreline to avoid detection entirely.
nodes.page: You push off the pilings, swimming parallel to the shoreline to avoid detection entirely. The cold drains your stamina rapidly, turning your limbs to heavy lead. You spot a stone embankment a hundred yards down the coast and aim for it. Hauling yourself out of the water, you collapse on the rocks, shivering violently. The ledger is soaked, but the waterproof ink firmly holds.

nodes.stake: You rifle through the dusty trunks, finding only moth-eaten clothes and old letters.
nodes.page: You rifle through the dusty trunks, finding only moth-eaten clothes and old letters. There is nothing useful here, and the delay has cost you precious minutes. You hear heavy footsteps on the wooden stairs outside the attic door. The enforcers have tracked you to the building, narrowing your escape routes. You draw a deep breath and prepare to break through them.

nodes.stake: The narrow passage smells heavily of dry rot and dead insects.
nodes.page: The narrow passage smells heavily of dry rot and dead insects. You feel your way blindly along the wooden walls, inching forward in total darkness. The path slopes downward, eventually leading you to a hidden door behind a tapestry. You step through, finding yourself in the deserted lobby of the Annex. The heavy front doors stand completely unguarded, offering a clear path out.

nodes.stake: You press yourself against the wall next to the heavy wooden door.
nodes.page: You press yourself against the wall next to the heavy wooden door. As the handle turns, you slam your weight into the wood, crushing the enforcer on the other side. He cries out and falls backward down the steep stairs. You sprint past him, leaping over his body to reach the lower landing. The path to the solo final is now a straightforward sprint.

nodes.stake: You maintain a brutal pace through the winding streets, the ledger secure in your grip.
nodes.page: You maintain a brutal pace through the winding streets, the ledger secure in your grip. Every shadow looks like a threat, every sound a potential ambush. Matron Rigg's enforcers are surely scouring the city, but you have stayed one step ahead. You reach the final checkpoint, an unassuming iron door in a blind alley. Pushing it open, you step into the darkness, ready for whatever comes next.

nodes.stake: You slip out the side door, the heavy oak clicking shut to leave you entirely alone in the quiet corridor.
nodes.page: You slip out the side door, the heavy oak clicking shut to leave you entirely alone in the quiet corridor. The buyer’s card remains face-down in your coat pocket, heavy with unspoken obligations. Shadows pool around the skirting boards, offering a familiar comfort in the empty building. No one is left to spot the seam in your alibi, leaving you free to finish the work. You can either head toward the muffled clatter of the printing presses or seek the salt air of the harbor.

nodes.stake: The scent of fresh ink and damp paper greets you as you navigate the narrow back hallways.
nodes.page: The scent of fresh ink and damp paper greets you as you navigate the narrow back hallways. You pass a discarded second type case, its brass compartments half-empty and catching the dim light. The margins of the ledgers scattered on the nearby tables are still blank, waiting for your specific touch. The press yard lies just beyond a set of frosted glass doors. You can prepare your forged additions here or move out into the yard.

nodes.stake: You descend the stone steps, letting the chill breeze from the waterfront wash over you.
nodes.page: You descend the stone steps, letting the chill breeze from the waterfront wash over you. The harbor colossus dominates the skyline, its massive bronze silhouette towering over the moored vessels. You scan the dark water, looking for the barge operating under a false name. Water laps rhythmically against the wooden pylons, masking the sound of your approach. The dockside path diverges between the cargo crates and the statue's plinth.

nodes.stake: You pull a stool to the drafting table, arranging the loose sheets with practiced care.
nodes.page: You pull a stool to the drafting table, arranging the loose sheets with practiced care. Using the tools from the second type case, you carefully align the lead letters to match the official Veridia typeface. The process is meditative, requiring absolute precision to ensure the ink dries evenly. You press the stamp down, lifting it to reveal a flawless replication. The forgery is complete, leaving you to decide your next move.

exits.label: Take the document to the buyer

nodes.stake: The press yard is a maze of discarded paper bales and empty ink barrels.
nodes.page: The press yard is a maze of discarded paper bales and empty ink barrels. You weave through the clutter, keeping your head low and your footsteps light. A wrought-iron gate stands partially open at the far end, leading out into the wider city streets. The quiet hum of Veridia's nighttime industry surrounds you, an endless machine churning in the dark. You must navigate the yard carefully to avoid the night watchman's route.

nodes.stake: The wooden planks groan slightly beneath your boots as you traverse the main dock.
nodes.page: The wooden planks groan slightly beneath your boots as you traverse the main dock. Several ships bob gently in the tide, but your eyes search for the unflagged barge. The false name painted on its hull is barely visible beneath a layer of grime. A single lantern swings from the aft deck, casting long shadows across the gangway. You step closer, checking the perimeter for any harbor inspectors.

nodes.stake: You walk toward the harbor colossus, its immense scale becoming clearer with every step.
nodes.page: You walk toward the harbor colossus, its immense scale becoming clearer with every step. The green patina of the bronze gleams faintly in the moonlight, a silent guardian over Veridia's trade. The stone base is etched with names of long-dead merchants and sailors. You trace the cold carvings with your fingertips, grounding yourself in the reality of the harbor. A narrow maintenance door sits slightly ajar at the rear of the plinth.

nodes.stake: You tuck the perfectly forged document inside your coat, securing it next to the buyer's card.
nodes.page: You tuck the perfectly forged document inside your coat, securing it next to the buyer's card. The ink is dry, and the texture of the paper matches the authentic ledgers flawlessly. You step out of the press room, the hallway stretching out toward the front offices. Matron Rigg’s usual meticulous oversight is absent, giving you the freedom to move unseen. The buyer expects you before the midnight bell chimes.

exits.label: Review the card one last time

nodes.stake: You duck behind a stack of damaged paper bales, the smell of rotting pulp filling your nose.
nodes.page: You duck behind a stack of damaged paper bales, the smell of rotting pulp filling your nose. Footsteps echo briefly on the cobblestones before fading into the neighboring alley. The press yard is quiet once again, the immediate threat of discovery passing with the wind. You shift your weight, carefully avoiding a loose iron hoop on the ground. The path to the street is clear, but the side entrance to the forge is closer.

nodes.stake: You cross the gangway, your boots making dull thuds on the damp wood of the barge.
nodes.page: You cross the gangway, your boots making dull thuds on the damp wood of the barge. The vessel is mostly empty, smelling strongly of tar and old fish scales. You find the shipping manifests pinned to a board near the helm. The records match the false name, proving the vessel is a ghost in Veridia's registry. You pull a blank sheet from your pocket to forge an additional entry.

nodes.stake: You slide between two large shipping crates, blending into the deep shadows.
nodes.page: You slide between two large shipping crates, blending into the deep shadows. From this vantage point, you have a clear view of the barge and the surrounding docks. The water slaps against the hull in a steady, hypnotic rhythm. You wait until the dockworker at the far end turns his back to inspect a broken line. The opportunity to move presents itself, clear and brief.

nodes.stake: You circle the massive base of the colossus, keeping to the edge where the light fails to reach.
nodes.page: You circle the massive base of the colossus, keeping to the edge where the light fails to reach. The sheer size of the bronze boots anchored to the stone is overwhelming up close. The air here is colder, whipped up by the currents funneling past the monument. You spot a discarded ledger lying near an old mooring ring. The margins are blank, likely dropped by a careless quartermaster.

exits.label: Leave the ledger and walk on

nodes.stake: You pull the buyer’s card from your pocket, turning it face-up in the dim hallway light.
nodes.page: You pull the buyer’s card from your pocket, turning it face-up in the dim hallway light. The embossed lettering spells out a meeting place near the Exchange roofs. You memorize the location, letting the details lock into your mind before flipping the card over again. The paper trail is secure, and your anonymity remains perfectly intact. The final delivery is all that stands between you and completion.

nodes.stake: You approach the side entrance, the heavy iron handle cold against your palm.
nodes.page: You approach the side entrance, the heavy iron handle cold against your palm. The door hinges whine slightly, but the noise is swallowed by the distant rumble of the city. Inside, the familiar smell of chemicals and hot wax washes over you. You are back in your element, where documents are unmade and rewritten at will. A fresh stack of blank certificates rests on the nearest workbench.

nodes.stake: You step out from the press yard onto the narrow cobblestone street.
nodes.page: You step out from the press yard onto the narrow cobblestone street. The fog is rolling in from the harbor, cloaking the gas lamps in pale halos. You adjust your collar against the damp cold, setting a brisk pace. The towering shadow of the colossus is visible at the end of the avenue, pointing the way forward. You can either follow the road to the docks or cut through the alleyways.

exits.label: Take the road to the docks

nodes.stake: You balance the manifest on your knee, using a charcoal pencil to add the false cargo lines.
nodes.page: You balance the manifest on your knee, using a charcoal pencil to add the false cargo lines. Your handwriting effortlessly mimics the erratic scrawl of the harbor master. The forgery blends perfectly into the page, creating a flawless fiction. No one will ever question the origin of the non-existent crates now registered to this ship. You fold your tools away, the job neatly finished.

nodes.stake: You descend the short ladder into the belly of the barge.
nodes.page: You descend the short ladder into the belly of the barge. The hold is dark and smells of stale seawater and damp canvas. You strike a match, holding it up to reveal empty crates stacked haphazardly against the hull. The vessel is a shell, operating purely on the strength of its false name. The match burns down to your fingers, forcing you to drop it onto the wet planks.

nodes.stake: You dart across the open space, reaching the adjacent pier without raising an alarm.
nodes.page: You dart across the open space, reaching the adjacent pier without raising an alarm. This section of the docks is dedicated to the smaller merchant skiffs. The rigging clinks softly in the breeze, a metallic symphony of the harbor. You spot a narrow staircase leading up toward the Exchange roofs. The high ground would offer a better view of the shipping lanes.

nodes.stake: You turn away from the docks, the chill of the water fading as you move inland.
nodes.page: You turn away from the docks, the chill of the water fading as you move inland. The streets grow tighter, the grand architecture of Veridia looming overhead. You retrace your steps toward the printing district, seeking the comfort of the familiar. The rhythmic thumping of a late-night press echoes off the brick walls. You approach the iron gate of the press yard once again.

nodes.stake: You pick up the ledger, brushing a layer of salt grit from its leather cover.

You realize the bidding war was a sham, meant to drain the coffers of the local merchant houses. Valerius was played for a fool, and Matron Rigg was robbed under her own nose.

exits.label: Search the contract for a rendezvous point
Tear the fraudulent contract to pieces

nodes.stake: You bind the broker's hands tightly to the iron rungs of the chimney sweep's ladder.
nodes.page: You bind the broker's hands tightly to the iron rungs of the chimney sweep's ladder. Taking the slate board, you wipe away the chalk tallies to erase the syndicate's local communication lines. The broker curses at you, swearing that the second mark will find her before you do. You turn away, focusing your attention on the path leading toward the grand dome of the opera.

exits.label: Navigate the roofline toward the opera
Search the broker's satchel for more clues

nodes.stake: The contract mentions a final exchange of funds taking place near the high arches of the opera house.
nodes.page: The contract mentions a final exchange of funds taking place near the high arches of the opera house. You fold the heavy parchment and weave your way across the connecting beams of the old tailor's row. The streets below are beginning to empty, the city holding its breath as the shadows lengthen. You need to reach the opera before the syndicate finalized their grip on her future.

exits.label: Leap the gap to the tailor's balcony

nodes.stake: You rip the heavy parchment into shreds, letting the wind scatter the false terms across the city.
nodes.page: You rip the heavy parchment into shreds, letting the wind scatter the false terms across the city. The act brings a small sense of satisfaction, though you know the true danger lies in whoever orchestrated the sale. You check the broker's leather satchel, finding a small iron key stamped with the same foreign mark. This key might open the lockbox containing the original payment for the gaol page.

exits.label: Toss the satchel off the roof

nodes.stake: You balance on the edge of the tailor's balcony, the iron key cold in your palm.
nodes.page: You balance on the edge of the tailor's balcony, the iron key cold in your palm. Through the glass doors, you see a master tailor outfitting three men in dark, unassuming travel cloaks. They are speaking in low, urgent tones, handing over a heavy purse of coins that clashes with the setting. These must be the syndicate's handlers, preparing to smuggle their new asset out of the city.

nodes.stake: Dropping to the cobblestones, you melt into the shadows of a narrow alley near the press building.
nodes.page: Dropping to the cobblestones, you melt into the shadows of a narrow alley near the press building. The hum of the printing machines vibrates through the soles of your boots, masking the sound of footsteps. A courier rushes past, clutching a sealed tube bearing the second mark, completely unaware of your presence. The tube likely contains the final orders regarding her deployment in Veridia.

exits.label: Follow the courier at a distance

nodes.stake: You burst through the glass doors, glass raining down as the tailor shrieks and dives for cover.
nodes.page: You burst through the glass doors, glass raining down as the tailor shrieks and dives for cover. The three men draw short, curved blades, their travel cloaks swirling as they form a defensive half-circle. You step forward, kicking a heavy cutting table into their path to disrupt their footing. The leader snarls, demanding to know who sent you to interrupt their legitimate business.

exits.label: Strike the leader with your pommel
Kick the heavy purse off the table

nodes.stake: Pressing your ear to the cold glass, you catch fragments of their hushed conversation over the street noise.
nodes.page: Pressing your ear to the cold glass, you catch fragments of their hushed conversation over the street noise. They mention Matron Rigg's incompetence and how easily the gaol page was slipped from the archives. The leader taps the heavy purse, stating it is the final bribe needed for the harbor guards tonight. If they make it to the harbor colossus, she will be gone from Veridia forever.

exits.label: Smash the glass to confront them

nodes.stake: Your pommel connects with a sickening crack, sending the leader stumbling backward into a rack of silks.
nodes.page: Your pommel connects with a sickening crack, sending the leader stumbling backward into a rack of silks. The other two hesitate, glancing between you and the spilled purse of coins now rolling across the floorboards. You use the opening to snatch a leather bound manifest from the leader's fallen coat. It details a specific ship docked under the shadow of the harbor colossus.

exits.label: Fight off the remaining two guards

nodes.stake: You shadow the men as they leave the tailor's shop, keeping to the elevated walkways of the district.
nodes.page: You shadow the men as they leave the tailor's shop, keeping to the elevated walkways of the district. They move with military precision, checking their corners and avoiding the illuminated squares near the press. They are heading directly for the harbor, relying on the forged gaol page to bypass the outer checkpoints. You must find a way to intercept them before they reach the water.

exits.label: Take a shortcut across the vault roof
Ambush them in the press alley

nodes.stake: You take a running leap across the gap, landing hard on the domed roof of the city vault.
nodes.page: You take a running leap across the gap, landing hard on the domed roof of the city vault. Scrambling up the copper plating, you gain a vantage point over the descending streets leading to the docks. The three cloaked figures are bottlenecked at a narrow bridge, arguing with a corrupt toll guard. This is your best chance to separate them and recover the original bribe money.

exits.label: Throw a loose copper slate to scatter them

nodes.stake: You duck into the alleyway behind the press, using the thunderous rhythm of the machines to mask your approach.
nodes.page: You duck into the alleyway behind the press, using the thunderous rhythm of the machines to mask your approach. As the trio passes, you step out and sweep the legs of the rearmost guard, sending him crashing to the stones. You drag him into the shadows before his companions even realize they are a man down. A quick search of his pockets reveals a map pinpointing her exact holding cell.

nodes.stake: You memorize the coordinates, noting they lead not to the harbor, but back toward the upper tiers of the tower.
nodes.page: You memorize the coordinates, noting they lead not to the harbor, but back toward the upper tiers of the tower. The entire movement to the docks is a feint designed to draw out rivals and Matron Rigg's loyalists. The true buyer has been keeping her hidden near the very center of Veridia this entire time. You leave the groaning guard and turn your sights back toward the towering spires.

nodes.stake: You pin the guard against the brickwork, a dagger pressed lightly to the collar of his tunic.
nodes.page: You pin the guard against the brickwork, a dagger pressed lightly to the collar of his tunic. He gasps, admitting the harbor plan is a decoy constructed by the syndicate's architects. The gaol page was purchased to secure her legal status, but she is being held in the old clocktower. He swears the second mark is a front for a renegade noble trying to usurp Valerius.

exits.label: Release the guard and head for the tower
Tie him up and climb the opera house

nodes.stake: You sprint through the winding, ascending streets, the massive shadow of the tower looming ever larger.
nodes.page: You sprint through the winding, ascending streets, the massive shadow of the tower looming ever larger. The air grows colder here, the lingering smell of ozone and old dust clinging to the stonework. You find a side entrance left slightly ajar, fresh chalk marks scrawled on the frame. These are different from the bids; these are warning signs left by someone who knows you are coming.

exits.label: Scale the outside of the tower

nodes.stake: You scale the ornate facade of the opera house, pulling yourself up via the stone gargoyles and window ledges.
nodes.page: You scale the ornate facade of the opera house, pulling yourself up via the stone gargoyles and window ledges. From the high roof, you have a clear, unobstructed view of the tower's mid-levels. You spot a flickering light in a supposedly abandoned maintenance room, perfectly matching the coordinates. A figure is pacing back and forth in front of the window, waiting for the finalized contract.

exits.label: Swing across the rigging to the tower

nodes.stake: You land silently on the tower's outer maintenance gangway, the wind whipping fiercely at this altitude.
nodes.page: You land silently on the tower's outer maintenance gangway, the wind whipping fiercely at this altitude. The door to the room is locked, but the hinges are rusted from years of neglect and sea salt. You jam your dagger into the gap, applying pressure until the ancient iron snaps with a sharp crack. Stepping inside, you find the room empty, save for a table covered in complex architectural blueprints.

exits.label: Examine the blueprints on the table
Search the room for hidden doors

nodes.stake: Clinging to the damp stone, you watch the pacing figure through the narrow slit of the window.
nodes.page: Clinging to the damp stone, you watch the pacing figure through the narrow slit of the window. It is not her, but a high-ranking scribe wearing the colors of the second mark. The scribe is muttering anxiously, clutching a master copy of the release terms in writing. If you can secure that master copy, you can void the entire illicit purchase of the gaol page.

nodes.stake: You snatch up the master copy from the table, scanning the dense legal text detailing her indentured servitude.
nodes.page: You snatch up the master copy from the table, scanning the dense legal text detailing her indentured servitude. The contract explicitly names the true buyer: a wealthy patron of the opera seeking to use her as a silent enforcer. The chalk bids in the lower city were a deliberate smokescreen funded by this very patron. You fold the heavy parchment, knowing this gives you immense leverage over the true buyer.

exits.label: Seek a way further up the tower
Descend to the main faction floor

nodes.stake: You slide the window up just enough to slip into the room, surprising the scribe mid-sentence.
nodes.page: You slide the window up just enough to slip into the room, surprising the scribe mid-sentence. Before they can scream, you cross the distance and clamp a hand over their mouth, wrestling the master copy free. The scribe struggles weakly, their eyes wide with terror as you inspect the documents they were protecting. The paperwork confirms the entire bidding war was orchestrated by a single, wealthy patron from the opera.

exits.label: Gag the scribe and secure the room
Force the scribe to guide you higher

nodes.stake: You leave the room behind, climbing a spiraling internal staircase that winds toward the upper levels.
nodes.page: You leave the room behind, climbing a spiraling internal staircase that winds toward the upper levels. The walls here are pristine, free from the chaotic chalk tallies of the lower corridors. You reach a heavy iron gate barring access to the observation deck, locked with a sophisticated mechanism. You can see the glow of the city below, a sprawling map of shifting loyalties and hidden wealth.

exits.label: Pick the lock on the iron gate

nodes.stake: You force the scribe down the corridor, keeping a firm grip on their collar to ensure compliance.
nodes.page: You force the scribe down the corridor, keeping a firm grip on their collar to ensure compliance. They whimper, admitting that Matron Rigg is actively tearing the lower gaol apart looking for the lost page. By holding the master terms in writing, you possess the only leverage that matters in this chaotic auction. You pause at an intersection, hearing the heavy, rhythmic footsteps of tower guards approaching.

exits.label: Shove the scribe into the guards to create a distraction
Drag the scribe into a nearby alcove

nodes.stake: You bypass the gate and step out into a massive, echoing chamber that serves as a secondary vault.
nodes.page: You bypass the gate and step out into a massive, echoing chamber that serves as a secondary vault. Piles of ledgers and historical contracts are stacked haphazardly on long wooden tables. In the center of the room, you spot the original, stolen gaol page framed in a glass display case. The buyer intended to keep it as a trophy, a symbol of outbidding Valerius and the merchant houses.

exits.label: Smash the glass and take the page
Carefully remove the hinges of the case

nodes.stake: You pull yourself into the dark, greasy confines of the old elevator shaft, balancing on the counterweights.
nodes.page: You pull yourself into the dark, greasy confines of the old elevator shaft, balancing on the counterweights. The thick cables groan slightly under your weight as you shimmy upward, bypassing the locked gates. Looking down, you see the flicker of torches as Matron Rigg’s search party sweeps the floors below. You must move quickly before they realize the prize they are looking for is above them.

exits.label: Climb faster to the next floor
Stop and listen to the search party

nodes.stake: You shatter the glass with the hilt of your dagger, the sound echoing loudly in the cavernous room.
nodes.page: You shatter the glass with the hilt of your dagger, the sound echoing loudly in the cavernous room. Snatching the original gaol page, you confirm it matches the terms in writing you found earlier. With this in hand, you can prove the syndicate's claim is fraudulent and nullify her transfer. You stuff the parchment into your satchel just as a heavy door at the far end of the vault begins to open.

nodes.stake: You carefully unpin the hinges of the display case, sliding the glass off without making a sound.
nodes.page: You carefully unpin the hinges of the display case, sliding the glass off without making a sound. The gaol page smells of old wax and fresh ink, a dangerous combination in Veridia's political climate. You tuck it away safely, ensuring the syndicate’s masterstroke is now nothing more than worthless theft. A low hum vibrates through the floorboards, signaling that the tower's main lift is ascending to your level.

exits.label: Prepare an ambush near the lift doors

nodes.stake: You slip through the side exit and find yourself on a narrow balcony overlooking the silk Exchange.
nodes.page: You slip through the side exit and find yourself on a narrow balcony overlooking the silk Exchange. The night air is cool, clearing your lungs of the vault's dusty, stagnant atmosphere. Below, the city is a labyrinth of shadows, unaware that the secret bidding war has just been overturned. You hold the leverage now, dictating who truly owns the right to claim her release.

exits.label: Head back toward the faction gatherings

nodes.stake: You press yourself against the cold stone of the central pillar, holding your breath as the lift doors rattle open.
nodes.page: You press yourself against the cold stone of the central pillar, holding your breath as the lift doors rattle open. Two enforcers step out, bearing the unfamiliar mark of the syndicate on their heavy cloaks. They walk directly toward the empty display case, their voices rising in panic as they discover the missing gaol page. This is your cue to slip away before they lock down the entire floor.

exits.label: Sneak back toward the silk balconies

nodes.stake: You backtrack through the corridors, realizing the syndicate's plan involves multiple layers of deception.
nodes.page: You backtrack through the corridors, realizing the syndicate's plan involves multiple layers of deception. The chalk bids were just phase one; phase two was securing the gaol page. The final phase involves transporting her during the chaos of the eclipse. You find a discarded ledger that maps out a route leading directly to the highest points of the tower.

exits.label: Burn the ledger to cover your tracks

nodes.stake: The route takes you through a series of abandoned architectural drafts rooms, filled with dust-covered models of Veridia.
nodes.page: The route takes you through a series of abandoned architectural drafts rooms, filled with dust-covered models of Veridia. Someone has meticulously placed a small, carved wooden token bearing the second mark on the model of the tower. They are planning to move her precisely when the city’s attention is directed at the sky. You sweep the token off the board, pocketing it as evidence of their exact timing.

exits.label: Head toward the main eclipse gathering

nodes.stake: You set the ledger alight, watching the illicit transport routes curl and blacken into ash.
nodes.page: You set the ledger alight, watching the illicit transport routes curl and blacken into ash. The glow of the small fire illuminates another chalk mark on the floor, pointing back toward the foundry. It seems a rival faction within the syndicate is also trying to intercept her transfer. The internal betrayal makes your job easier, but the chaos makes the environment far more unpredictable.

nodes.stake: You follow the secondary chalk marks, leading you down a precarious, winding maintenance stairwell.
nodes.page: You follow the secondary chalk marks, leading you down a precarious, winding maintenance stairwell. The metal grates groan under your weight, threatening to alert anyone on the floors below. You spot a figure in a heavy leather apron arguing with a syndicate guard over the payment terms in writing. The foundry workers are demanding a cut of the bribe money to keep their silence.

exits.label: Drop down onto the arguing pair
Sneak past them while they argue

nodes.stake: You drop from the grate, knocking the syndicate guard unconscious with a swift strike to the temple.
nodes.page: You drop from the grate, knocking the syndicate guard unconscious with a swift strike to the temple. The foundry worker stumbles back, raising heavy iron tongs in a defensive posture. You demand the worker hand over any paperwork they hold regarding the gaol page transaction. Shaking, the worker pulls a crumpled receipt from their apron, bearing Matron Rigg's forged signature.

exits.label: Force the worker to explain the forgery

nodes.stake: You edge along the rusted pipeworks above their heads, the heat of the lower foundry rising to meet you.
nodes.page: You edge along the rusted pipeworks above their heads, the heat of the lower foundry rising to meet you. The worker angrily brandishes a crumpled receipt, shouting that the forged signature isn't worth the paper it's printed on. The guard sneers, replying that the second mark carries enough weight to make it legitimate. You realize the entire legal foundation of her transfer is built on threats rather than actual coin.

nodes.stake: You secure the forged receipt, another piece of evidence dismantling the syndicate's claim.
nodes.page: You secure the forged receipt, another piece of evidence dismantling the syndicate's claim. With the terms in writing, the original gaol page, and the receipts, you hold complete control over the bidding narrative. Valerius and the other houses will be furious to learn how badly they were manipulated. It is time to step out of the shadows and present what you have found to the relevant parties.

exits.label: Present the evidence at the faction bid
Bring the evidence directly to the balcony

nodes.stake: The worker stammers that Matron Rigg's signature was forged by a disgraced clerk working out of the press district.
nodes.page:
The worker stammers that Matron Rigg's signature was forged by a disgraced clerk working out of the press district. The second mark was stamped over it to ensure no local magistrate would dare question its authenticity. The syndicate paid entirely in foreign favors, keeping their own coffers completely full while draining Veridia's houses. You leave the terrified worker behind, armed with the truth of the grand deception.

</user_query>

exits.label: Head up to the main faction floor
Seek her out on the high perches
